entries.name: ManageUsers
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers manageusers dotnet-type legacy administration page for user profiles, roles, and registration review. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage{aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers} t:system.web.ui.page t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ihttphandler dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 旧后台用户资料、角色和注册审核管理页面。 legacy administration page for user profiles, roles, and registration review. 页面要求角色，并只编辑能由数值 userid 规范解析到的用户。用户创建由的显式管理员 post 完成；本页不会因访问地址缺少用户名而写入数据库。角色、资料、注册审核和状态写入与运营审计由连续调用组成，不宣称跨服务原子事务；角色调整和密码重置会递增目标用户安全版本，使旧身份票据和角色 cookie 在后续请求中失效。 admins users.ascx the page requires therole and edits only a user canonically resolved by numeric userid. user creation occurs through the explicit administrator post in; this page never writes to the database merely because an address lacks a user name. role, profile, registration-review, and status writes are sequential calls with operations audit rather than a claimed cross-service atomic transaction; role changes and password resets increment the target user's security version so older authentication and role cookies are invalidated on later requests. admins users.ascx

entries.name: Page_Load
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.page_load-system.object-system.eventargs page_load dotnet-method authorizes and resolves the canonical user target, then binds user, role, and review information on the initial request. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.page_load(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.page_load-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 授权并解析规范用户目标；首次请求绑定用户、角色和审核信息。 authorizes and resolves the canonical user target, then binds user, role, and review information on the initial request. 初始化先解析并授权目标用户，再按角色编辑权限配置密码提交脚本；只有首次请求才绑定页面数据，回发动作仍由各自 handler 再次复核权限。 initialization resolves and authorizes the target user before configuring password-submission scripts for role editing; data binds only on the initial request, while each postback handler rechecks its own permission. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: Save_Click
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.save_click-system.object-system.eventargs save_click dotnet-method handles the save-button event that only returns to the portal page. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.save_click(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.save_click-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 处理仅返回门户页的保存按钮事件。 handles the save-button event that only returns to the portal page. 该动作只安全返回门户页，不保存用户资料；目标和回跳参数仍由统一初始化与安全 url 策略约束。 this action only returns safely to the portal and does not save user data; the target and return parameters remain constrained by shared initialization and safe-url policy. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: AddRole_Click
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.addrole_click-system.object-system.eventargs addrole_click dotnet-method adds the current user to a selected role of the current portal and records an operations audit without the role name. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.addrole_click(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.addrole_click-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 将当前用户加入所选的当前门户角色，并记录不含角色名称的运营审计。 adds the current user to a selected role of the current portal and records an operations audit without the role name. 所选角色必须来自当前门户角色集合；角色写入成功后才记录运营审计，二者不共享本页声明的跨服务事务。 the selected role must come from the current portal role set; operations audit is recorded only after the role write succeeds, and the two calls do not share a cross-service transaction claimed by this page. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: UpdateUser_Click
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.updateuser_click-system.object-system.eventargs updateuser_click dotnet-method updates the current user's profile extension and resets the strong-hash credential when a password is entered; audit entries do not record passwords or raw profile values. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.updateuser_click(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.updateuser_click-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 更新当前用户的资料扩展，并在填写密码时重置强哈希凭据；审计不记录密码或资料原文。 updates the current user's profile extension and resets the strong-hash credential when a password is entered; audit entries do not record passwords or raw profile values. 资料字段先按长度和单行规则归一化，再按当前加密策略解析密码并复核重置权限；资料写入、资料审计和密码审计是顺序步骤，不把异常提示解释为自动回滚。 profile fields are normalized for length and single-line form before password values are resolved under the current encryption policy and reset permission is rechecked; profile write, profile audit, and password audit are sequential steps, and an exception message does not imply automatic rollback. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: ConfigurePasswordSubmission
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.configurepasswordsubmission configurepasswordsubmission dotnet-method configures administrator password-reset submission scripts from the encryption switch. private void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.configurepasswordsubmission() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.configurepasswordsubmission portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 按加密开关配置管理员重置密码提交脚本。 configures administrator password-reset submission scripts from the encryption switch. 加密开关只决定客户端脚本和服务端提交载体；脚本 url 经过现有 javascript 编码，服务端仍必须在回发中验证密文完整性，不能把前端加密当作授权。 the encryption switch controls only the client script and server submission carrier; script urls use the existing javascript encoding, and the server must still validate encrypted fields on postback, so client encryption is not authorization.

entries.name: HasPasswordResetSubmission
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.haspasswordresetsubmission haspasswordresetsubmission dotnet-method determines whether this user-profile submission intends to reset the password. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.haspasswordresetsubmission() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.haspasswordresetsubmission portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 判断本次后台用户资料提交是否包含重置密码意图。 determines whether this user-profile submission intends to reset the password. 任一明文或密文字段非空时为。 true when any plain or encrypted field is present. true

entries.name: TryResolvePasswordResetSubmission
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.tryresolvepasswordresetsubmission-system.boolean-system.string-system.string-system.boolean tryresolvepasswordresetsubmission dotnet-method resolves administrator password-reset submission while preserving the legacy "either field means reset" semantics. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.tryresolvepasswordresetsubmission(bool passwordresetsubmitted, out string password, out string confirmpassword, out bool shouldresetpassword) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.tryresolvepasswordresetsubmission-system.boolean-system.string-system.string-system.boolean portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 解析管理员重置密码提交，保持“两框任一填写即重置”的旧语义。 resolves administrator password-reset submission while preserving the legacy "either field means reset" semantics. 有密文时要求两个字段成对存在并通过解密；仅在策略关闭时才回退读取明文控件，失败会记录受控诊断并阻止保存。 when encrypted values are present, both fields must be supplied and decrypted successfully; plain controls are read only when policy disables encryption, while failures record controlled diagnostics and stop saving. 是否存在密码重置提交意图。 whether a password-reset submission was detected. 当前请求内使用的密码。 password value for this request. 当前请求内使用的确认密码。 confirmation password value for this request. 解密或读取后是否应重置密码。 whether the password should be reset after decrypting or reading values. 提交满足当前加密策略时为。 true when the submission satisfies the current encryption policy. true

entries.name: ApproveRegistration_Click
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.approveregistration_click-system.object-system.eventargs approveregistration_click dotnet-method approves the current user's registration and records the registration-review operation. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.approveregistration_click(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.approveregistration_click-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 批准当前用户的注册申请，并记录注册审核操作。 approves the current user's registration and records the registration-review operation. 批准动作重新复核查看和编辑权限，以规范目标用户为对象；注册状态写入成功后再记录审计，异常不表示两步已被事务回滚。 the approval action rechecks view and edit permission against the canonical target user; audit follows a successful registration-state write, and an exception does not mean the two steps were transactionally rolled back. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: RejectRegistration_Click
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.rejectregistration_click-system.object-system.eventargs rejectregistration_click dotnet-method rejects the current pending registration and records the registration-review operation. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.rejectregistration_click(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.rejectregistration_click-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 拒绝当前待审核用户的注册申请，并记录注册审核操作。 rejects the current pending registration and records the registration-review operation. 拒绝动作只处理当前待审核注册；状态写入和运营审计为连续调用，失败时保留受控事件编号而不伪造成功事实。 the rejection action applies only to the current pending registration; state write and operations audit are sequential calls, and failure keeps a controlled event id without fabricating success. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: BindData
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.binddata binddata dotnet-method reads the current user's profile, registration, employee-binding, and role projections and binds the page controls. private void aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.binddata() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers.binddata portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.manageusers dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx.cs csharp 读取当前用户的资料、注册、员工绑定和角色投影并绑定页面控件。 reads the current user's profile, registration, employee-binding, and role projections and binds the page controls. 该方法只构建页面投影和按钮可见性，不授予权限、不改变业务状态；展示文本统一经过既有 html 编码路径。 this method builds page projections and button visibility only; it grants no permission and changes no business state, while display text uses the existing html-encoding path.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingedit useremployeebindingedit dotnet-type administration page for maintaining one portal-user to employee binding. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingedit dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingedit portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage{aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingedit} t:system.web.ui.page t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ihttphandler dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx.cs csharp 门户账号与员工单条绑定后台维护页。 administration page for maintaining one portal-user to employee binding. p6.3-s5 只提供单条绑定和结束当前绑定，不做批量导入、外部 hr 同步或在线身份源配置。绑定/解绑写入、目标用户安全版本失效和运营审计由连续调用组成，不宣称跨服务原子事务；成功递增安全版本后，旧登录票据和角色 cookie 才会在后续请求中按既有认证链失效。 p6.3-s5 provides only single-row binding and ending of the current binding, not bulk import, external hr synchronization, or online identity-source configuration. bind/unbind persistence, target-user security-version invalidation, and operations audit are sequential calls rather than a claimed cross-service atomic transaction; after a successful version increment, old auth tickets and role cookies expire on later requests through the existing authentication chain.

entries.name: IPortalModuleControl
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol iportalmodulecontrol dotnet-type defines the runtime-context contract that the portal dynamic loader must bind before a desktop module joins the control tree. interface aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol portal aspnet.starterkit.portal dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/iportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 定义门户动态加载器在桌面模块加入控件树前必须绑定的运行时上下文契约。 defines the runtime-context contract that the portal dynamic loader must bind before a desktop module joins the control tree. 实现此接口只是通过动态加载器接口门禁的必要条件，不证明入口、包、tab、portal 或用户权限。加载器负责提供与；模块仍须在每个读写动作处实施服务器端授权、输入验证和输出编码。 implementing this interface is only a prerequisite for passing the dynamic loader's interface gate; it proves neither entry/package trust nor tab, portal, or user authorization. the loader suppliesand, while the module must still enforce server-side authorization, input validation, and output encoding at each read or write action.

entries.name: ModuleId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.moduleid moduleid dotnet-property gets the module-instance identifier from the bound module configuration. int aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.moduleid { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.moduleid portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/iportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取已绑定模块配置中的模块实例标识。 gets the module-instance identifier from the bound module configuration. 动态加载器必须先设置；该标识只定位模块实例，不证明 portal 归属或当前用户授权，契约也不规定未绑定时的安全默认值。 the dynamic loader must setfirst; the identifier only locates a module instance, proves neither portal ownership nor current-user authorization, and the contract defines no safe default before binding.

entries.name: PortalId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.portalid portalid dotnet-property gets or sets the portal identifier bound by the dynamic loader for the current control tree. int aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.portalid { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.portalid portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/iportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置动态加载器为当前控件树绑定的 portal 标识。 gets or sets the portal identifier bound by the dynamic loader for the current control tree. 该值传递运行上下文，不验证 portal 存在性、模块归属、成员关系或权限；实现不得把赋值本身视为授权。 the value conveys runtime context and validates neither portal existence, module ownership, membership, nor permission; implementations must not treat assignment itself as authorization.

entries.name: IsEditable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.iseditable iseditable dotnet-property gets the ui-display hint for an edit entry point. bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.iseditable { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.iseditable portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/iportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取编辑入口的 ui 展示提示。 gets the ui-display hint for an edit entry point. 该布尔值只控制界面可见性，可能由全局显示选项或角色提示产生；它不替代保存、删除、管理或数据读取动作的服务器端授权。 this boolean controls ui visibility only and may derive from a global display option or role hint; it does not replace server-side authorization for save, delete, administration, or data-read actions.

entries.name: ModuleConfiguration
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.moduleconfiguration moduleconfiguration dotnet-property gets or sets the current module runtime-settings snapshot bound by the dynamic loader. aspnet.starterkit.portal.modulesettings aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.moduleconfiguration { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.moduleconfiguration portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/iportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置动态加载器绑定的当前模块运行时设置快照。 gets or sets the current module runtime-settings snapshot bound by the dynamic loader. 加载器应在模块依赖其它契约属性前提供非 null 值。该快照来自既有门户配置，不因接口赋值而被复制、持久化、重新解析或授权。 the loader should provide a non-null value before the module depends on other contract properties. the snapshot comes from existing portal configuration and is not copied, persisted, re-resolved, or authorized by interface assignment.

entries.name: Settings
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.settings settings dotnet-property gets module-instance key-value settings loaded on demand by the concrete control implementation. system.collections.hashtable aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.settings { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol.settings portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/iportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取具体控件实现按需读取的模块实例键值设置。 gets module-instance key-value settings loaded on demand by the concrete control implementation. 返回的是旧兼容数据结构，可能可变且由实现按控件实例缓存；接口不保证并发数据库更新可见、线程安全、值净化或调用方授权。 the returnedis a legacy compatibility structure that may be mutable and cached per control instance by the implementation; the interface guarantees neither visibility of concurrent database changes, thread safety, value sanitization, nor caller authorization.

entries.name: PortalAuthenticationCookies
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies portalauthenticationcookies dotnet-type centralizes portal role-cookie handling so ticket expiration, cookie expiration, and virtual-directory path rules remain consistent. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 统一处理门户角色 cookie，保持票据到期、cookie 到期和虚拟目录 path 规则一致。 centralizes portal role-cookie handling so ticket expiration, cookie expiration, and virtual-directory path rules remain consistent. cookie 使用 forms authentication 加密票据和，但当前未设置或。这些属性须在 https 部署策略与 ie9+ 兼容边界明确后通过独立配置设计，不能在此直接强制。 角色变更不会主动撤销已签发 cookie，通常在票据到期、登出或读取失败后才从数据库重建。 httponly secure samesite the cookie uses a forms authentication encrypted ticket and, but currently sets neithernor. those attributes require a separate configuration design after https deployment policy and ie9+ compatibility boundaries are settled, and must not be forced here directly. role changes do not proactively revoke issued cookies; roles are normally rebuilt from the database only after ticket expiration, sign-out, or a read failure. httponly secure samesite

entries.name: RolesCookieName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-f-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.rolescookiename rolescookiename dotnet-field cookie name used by the legacy portal to store the current user's role list. public const string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.rolescookiename dotnet:f:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.rolescookiename portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 旧门户保存当前用户角色列表的 cookie 名称。 cookie name used by the legacy portal to store the current user's role list.

entries.name: TryReadRoles
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.tryreadroles-system.web.httprequest-system.int64-system.string tryreadroles dotnet-method attempts to read roles from the role cookie; returnswhen missing, expired, undecryptable, or security-version mismatched so the caller reloads from the database. false public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.tryreadroles(system.web.httprequest request, long expectedsecurityversion, out string[] roles) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.tryreadroles-system.web.httprequest-system.int64-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 尝试从角色 cookie 读取角色；缺失、过期、解密失败或安全版本不匹配时返回，调用方应从数据库重新加载。 false attempts to read roles from the role cookie; returnswhen missing, expired, undecryptable, or security-version mismatched so the caller reloads from the database. false 当前 http 请求，可为。 null current http request; may be. null 主身份票据和数据库确认的安全版本。 security version confirmed by the main auth ticket and database. 成功时返回规范化角色数组；失败时为空数组。 normalized role array on success; otherwise an empty array. 成功读取未过期加密票据时为。 true when an unexpired encrypted ticket is read successfully. true

entries.name: WriteRolesCookie
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.writerolescookie-system.web.httpresponse-system.web.httprequest-system.string-system.int64-system.string-system.boolean writerolescookie dotnet-method writes the role cookie; non-persistent sign-in keeps a session cookie, while persistent sign-in writes an expiration time. public static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.writerolescookie(system.web.httpresponse response, system.web.httprequest request, string username, long securityversion, string[] roles, bool ispersistent) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.writerolescookie-system.web.httpresponse-system.web.httprequest-system.string-system.int64-system.string-system.boolean portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 写入角色 cookie；非持久登录保持会话 cookie，持久登录才写入过期时间。 writes the role cookie; non-persistent sign-in keeps a session cookie, while persistent sign-in writes an expiration time. 当前 http 响应。 current http response. 当前 http 请求，用于解析虚拟目录 cookie path。 current http request used to resolve the virtual-directory cookie path. 认证票据中的用户登录名称。 user sign-in name stored in the authentication ticket. 当前用户安全版本。 current user security version. 要写入票据的角色集合。 role collection to write into the ticket. 是否写为持久 cookie。 whether to write a persistent cookie.

entries.name: ExpireRolesCookie
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.expirerolescookie-system.web.httpresponse-system.web.httprequest expirerolescookie dotnet-method immediately expires the role cookie for the current request path; path must match the write path. public static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.expirerolescookie(system.web.httpresponse response, system.web.httprequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.expirerolescookie-system.web.httpresponse-system.web.httprequest portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 让当前请求路径下的角色 cookie 立即失效；path 必须与写入时一致。 immediately expires the role cookie for the current request path; path must match the write path. 当前 http 响应。 current http response. 当前 http 请求，用于解析虚拟目录 cookie path。 current http request used to resolve the virtual-directory cookie path.

entries.name: GetCookiePath
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.getcookiepath-system.web.httprequest getcookiepath dotnet-method resolves the application path for the role cookie; root sites and virtual directories must use the same rule for writing and expiration. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.getcookiepath(system.web.httprequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.getcookiepath-system.web.httprequest portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 根据当前请求解析角色 cookie 的应用程序路径；根站点和虚拟目录必须与写入、失效操作使用同一规则。 resolves the application path for the role cookie; root sites and virtual directories must use the same rule for writing and expiration. 当前 http 请求，可为。 null current http request; may be. null 可用于 cookie path 的非空路径；无法确定时返回根路径。 / a non-empty cookie path; returns the root pathwhen it cannot be determined. /

entries.name: BuildRoleData
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.buildroledata-system.int64-system.string buildroledata dotnet-method encodes the security version and role collection as role-ticket userdata; the format must remain compatible with the parser. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.buildroledata(long securityversion, string[] roles) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.buildroledata-system.int64-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 把安全版本和角色集合编码为角色票据的 userdata；编码格式必须与解析端保持兼容。 encodes the security version and role collection as role-ticket userdata; the format must remain compatible with the parser. 当前用户的安全版本，用于使旧角色票据失效。 current user security version, used to invalidate stale role tickets. 要写入票据的角色集合。 role collection to store in the ticket. 包含版本分隔符和规范化角色数据的 userdata 字符串。 userdata string containing the version separator and normalized role data.

entries.name: TryParseRoleData
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.tryparseroledata-system.string-system.int64-system.string tryparseroledata dotnet-method parses the security version and role segment from role-ticket userdata; rejects the ticket when its format is incomplete or the version is invalid. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.tryparseroledata(string value, out long securityversion, out string roledata) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies.tryparseroledata-system.string-system.int64-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookies dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookies.cs csharp 解析角色票据 userdata 中的安全版本和角色片段；格式不完整或版本无法解析时拒绝使用该票据。 parses the security version and role segment from role-ticket userdata; rejects the ticket when its format is incomplete or the version is invalid. 待解析的票据 userdata。 ticket userdata to parse. 成功时返回票据携带的安全版本；失败时为。 0 ticket security version on success;on failure. 0 成功时返回角色数据片段；失败时为空字符串。 role-data segment on success; an empty string on failure. userdata 同时包含有效安全版本和角色分隔符时为。 true when userdata contains a valid security version and role separator. true

entries.name: PortalAuthenticationCookieSettings
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings portalauthenticationcookiesettings dotnet-type reads current system settings and produces transport-security attributes for identity and role cookies. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookiesettings.cs csharp 读取当前系统设置并产出身份与角色 cookie 的传输安全属性。 reads current system settings and produces transport-security attributes for identity and role cookies. 本类只负责读取设置与委托裁定，不创建或写入 cookie；安全约束（samesite 取 none 必须配合 secure）统一由 portalauthenticationcookiepolicy 裁定。设置缺失、无法解析或读取异常一律回落为默认（不下发 secure、不下发 samesite），绝不因配置问题阻断登录。 this class only reads settings and delegates the decision; it never creates or writes cookies. security constraints (samesite=none requires secure) are decided centrally by portalauthenticationcookiepolicy. missing, unparsable, or failing settings always fall back to the default (neither secure nor samesite emitted) and never block sign-in because of configuration problems.

entries.name: Resolve
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings.resolve resolve dotnet-method reads current configuration and resolves cookie transport-security attributes; read failures fall back to defaults without blocking sign-in. public static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcookiesecurityoptions aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings.resolve() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings.resolve portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookiesettings.cs csharp 读取当前配置并解析 cookie 传输安全属性；读取失败时回落默认，不阻断登录。 reads current configuration and resolves cookie transport-security attributes; read failures fall back to defaults without blocking sign-in. 可直接供 cookie 写入点消费的安全属性决策结果。 security-attribute decision result that cookie write sites can consume directly.

entries.name: ApplyTo
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings.applyto-system.web.httpcookie applyto dotnet-method applies the currently resolved transport-security attributes to the specified cookie; unset leaves samesite untouched so the framework default is preserved. public static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings.applyto(system.web.httpcookie cookie) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings.applyto-system.web.httpcookie portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalauthenticationcookiesettings dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalauthenticationcookiesettings.cs csharp 把当前解析出的传输安全属性应用到指定 cookie；unset 时不触碰 samesite，保持框架默认。 applies the currently resolved transport-security attributes to the specified cookie; unset leaves samesite untouched so the framework default is preserved. 要应用属性的 cookie；为 null 时直接返回。 cookie to apply attributes to; returns directly when null.

entries.name: PortalNavigationEntryRenderer
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationentryrenderer portalnavigationentryrenderer dotnet-type renderer that connects the entry visibility policy to the admin page header action area (the web side assembles the context while the policy stays in the component layer). class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationentryrenderer dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationentryrenderer portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalnavigationentryrenderer.cs csharp 把入口可见性策略接入 admin 页头动作区的渲染器（web 侧组装上下文，策略本身仍在组件层）。 renderer that connects the entry visibility policy to the admin page header action area (the web side assembles the context while the policy stays in the component layer). 本类型只输出导航类入口；页面自身的写库主操作（新增用户、新增角色、新增 tab 等）与既有服务器控件由页面自身保留，不在本渲染器范围内。可见入口为 0 时返回空字符串，使动作区容器整体不渲染。 this type emits navigation entries only; page-owned persistence actions (add user, add role, add tab) and existing server controls stay owned by the page and are out of scope. when no entry is visible it returns an empty string so the action container is not rendered at all.

entries.name: RenderActions

entries.name: PortalEmptyStateRenderer
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalemptystaterenderer portalemptystaterenderer dotnet-type renders the "list has zero rows" state as a single in-table hint row. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalemptystaterenderer dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalemptystaterenderer portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalemptystaterenderer.cs csharp 把"列表零条"这一状态渲染为表格内的单行提示。 renders the "list has zero rows" state as a single in-table hint row. p74.3 起供业务前后台列表复用。设计约束：① 空态必须是**表格内的一行**（表头保留、视觉连续），故输出 `/` 而非独立区块；② 样式类 `portal-empty-state` 作用于**内部的** —— 直接放在上会与表格既有的 `` 同属性竞争，而二者特异性相同或后者更高，居中会失效（真实渲染实测）；③ 调用方负责判断"空"与"筛选无结果"的**文案差异**，以及"读取失败"**不得**退化为空态。有数据时返回空字符串，使调用方无需分支。 tr td td div td .xxx td { text-align: left } reused by front-end and admin business lists starting with p74.3. design constraints: (1) the empty state must be a **row inside the table** so the header stays and the list reads continuously, hence `/` output rather than a detached block; (2) the `portal-empty-state` class applies to a**inside** the— putting it on theitself competes with existing `rules at equal or higher specificity, which breaks centering (measured in a real render); (3) the caller owns the **wording difference** between "no data" and "no matches", and must never degrade a **read failure** into an empty state. when rows exist the method returns an empty string so callers need no branch. tr td div td td .xxx td { text-align: left }

rowcount, string message, int columncount) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalemptystaterenderer.render-system.nullable-system.int32-system.string-system.int32 portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalemptystaterenderer t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalemptystaterenderer dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalemptystaterenderer.cs csharp 渲染零条记录时的表格内提示行；有数据或调用方要求抑制时返回空字符串。 renders the in-table hint row for a zero-row result; returns an empty string when rows exist or when the caller asks to suppress it. 列表已渲染的行数：大于 0 表示有数据，等于 0 表示"查询成功但没有记录"，表示**抑制空态**——调用方处在失败或不可用路径（此时页面已给出错误提示，再渲染"暂无"会把故障说成没有数据）。仅当表体在失败时仍然可见（例如后台页只清空列表、不隐藏表格）才需要传；失败时整块区域被隐藏的调用方传 0 即可。 null null the number of rows already rendered: greater than zero means data exists, zero means "the query succeeded with no records", andmeans **suppress the empty state** because the caller is on a failure or unavailable path (the page already shows an error, and rendering "nothing here" would present a fault as absent data). passonly where the table body stays visible on failure (for example an admin page that merely clears the list without hiding the table); callers that hide the whole area on failure can pass 0. null null 提示文案，由调用方按"无数据"或"筛选无结果"选定；输出前按 html 规则编码，空白值退化为空文本。 the hint wording chosen by the caller for "no data" or "no matches"; it is html-encoded before output and blank values degrade to empty text. 当前表格的列数，用作；小于 1 时按 1 处理，避免产生非法单元格。 colspan the current table's column count used as; values below 1 are treated as 1 so no invalid cell is produced. colspan 内嵌空态提示的标记；有数据或被抑制时为空字符串。 tr themarkup carrying the empty-state hint, or an empty string when rows exist or the state is suppressed. tr

entries.name: PortalCollaborationParticipantText
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcollaborationparticipanttext portalcollaborationparticipanttext dotnet-type renders a collaboration item's participant set as human-readable display text, mapping role keys to localized role names. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcollaborationparticipanttext dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcollaborationparticipanttext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalcollaborationparticipanttext.cs csharp 把协同事项的参与人集合渲染为人可读的展示文本：角色键映射为本地化角色名。 renders a collaboration item's participant set as human-readable display text, mapping role keys to localized role names. p74.4 起供前台工作台与后台协同事项页共用。此前两处各自把 `` 原样拼进界面（形如 `张三 (collaborator)`），把内部标识符暴露给终端用户，且空集合与空字段回退为硬编码英文 `(none)`。本类统一处理三件事：① 已知角色键 → 本地化角色名（词表来自）；② **未知角色键 → 回退为原始键**，不臆造译文（与全局既有做法一致）；③ 空集合与空字段 → 本地化占位文本。角色词表是**领域事实**而非某个页面的私有词条，故角色名与占位文案使用 `collaboration_*` / `common_*` 共享键，不按页面各造一套。输出文本**不在此处编码**，由标记层的编码绑定（`<%#: %>`）负责，避免二次编码。 participantrolekey shared by the front-end workbench and the admin collaboration page starting with p74.4. both sites previously interpolated `` verbatim (for example `zhang (collaborator)`), exposing an internal identifier to end users, and fell back to a hard-coded english `(none)` for empty sets and blank fields. this type centralizes three things: (1) a known role key becomes a localized role name (the vocabulary comes from); (2) an **unknown role key falls back to the raw key** rather than inventing a translation, matching established practice elsewhere; (3) an empty set or blank field becomes the localized placeholder. the role vocabulary is a **domain fact** rather than one page's private wording, so role names and the placeholder use shared `collaboration_*` / `common_*` keys instead of per-page copies. output is **not encoded here**; the markup's encoded binding (`<%#: %>`) owns that, which avoids double encoding. participantrolekey

entries.name: PortalModuleCatalog
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog portalmodulecatalog dotnet-type restricted validator for trusted-deployment module-package directories and manifests. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 受信任部署模块包目录与 manifest 的受限校验器。 restricted validator for trusted-deployment module-package directories and manifests. p3.2 只发现受信任部署流程写入的 `.ascx` 包目录。它不上传、不解压、不写入、不执行 dll 或脚本，也不自动加载外部资源。manifest 通过不表示当前 profile 允许、状态表已启用、页面已授权或控件已加载；这些后续门禁由独立运行时路径处理。 p3.2 discovers only `.ascx` package directories written by a trusted deployment process. it does not upload, unzip, write, execute dlls or scripts, or auto-load external resources. a passing manifest does not mean that the current profile allows it, the state table enables it, a page is authorized, or a control has loaded; separate runtime paths handle those later gates.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.trygettrustedpackage-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackage-system.string trygettrustedpackage dotnet-method 按稳定包标识读取一个已验证部署模块包。 reads one validated deployment module package by stable package identifier. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.trygettrustedpackage(string packageid, out aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackage package, out string reason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.trygettrustedpackage-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackage-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 按稳定包标识读取一个已验证部署模块包。 reads one validated deployment module package by stable package identifier. 模块包标识。module package identifier. 成功时返回已验证模块包。validated module package when successful. 失败时返回不含物理路径的原因。failure reason without physical paths. 是否找到并验证该模块包。whether the module package was found and validated.

entries.name: TryResolveModule
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryresolvemodule-aspnet.starterkit.portal.modulesettings-system.web.httpcontext-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleruntimedescriptor-system.string tryresolvemodule dotnet-method resolves controlled desktop entry, package state, and cache identity from module-instance settings. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryresolvemodule(aspnet.starterkit.portal.modulesettings modulesettings, system.web.httpcontext context, out aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleruntimedescriptor descriptor, out string reason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryresolvemodule-aspnet.starterkit.portal.modulesettings-system.web.httpcontext-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleruntimedescriptor-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 从模块实例设置解析受控桌面入口、包状态和缓存身份。 resolves controlled desktop entry, package state, and cache identity from module-instance settings. 这是运行时组合入口，不重做 manifest 校验、状态表实现或页面授权。它先规范化实例路径，再委托桌面入口解析，以保持页面加载、后台挂载与其它调用方的同一解析顺序。 this is the runtime-composition entry and does not reimplement manifest validation, state-table implementation, or page authorization. it normalizes the instance path first and then delegates to desktop-entry resolution so page loading, admin mounting, and other callers preserve the same resolution order. 当前已读取的模块实例设置；本方法只消费其桌面源路径。 current module-instance settings already read by the caller; this method consumes only its desktop-source path. 可选 http 上下文，仅传给后续 profile/状态解析边界。 optional http context passed only to later profile/state-resolution boundaries. 可进入后续流程时返回受控描述；已禁用包也返回描述符。 returns a controlled descriptor when it may enter later processing; disabled packages also return a descriptor. 解析失败或禁用时的受控非敏感原因。 controlled non-sensitive reason when resolution fails or the package is disabled. 路径/profile/部署边界通过时为 true；true 不等同于已加载或当前用户已获授权。 true when path, profile, and deployment boundaries pass; true does not mean loaded or authorized for the current user.

entries.name: TryResolveDesktopSource
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryresolvedesktopsource-system.string-system.web.httpcontext-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleruntimedescriptor-system.string tryresolvedesktopsource dotnet-method resolves a module runtime descriptor by desktop entry and applies the startup profile gate. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryresolvedesktopsource(string desktopsource, system.web.httpcontext context, out aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleruntimedescriptor descriptor, out string reason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryresolvedesktopsource-system.string-system.web.httpcontext-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleruntimedescriptor-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 按桌面入口解析模块运行描述，并应用启动期 profile gate。 resolves a module runtime descriptor by desktop entry and applies the startup profile gate. 此方法供页面加载和后台新增模块共同使用，避免“运行时禁止但后台仍可新增”的不一致。它依次组合路径、core/legacy/受信任部署分类、profile 与状态事实；它不加载控件、不注入样式，也不实施页面授权。 this method is shared by page loading and admin module creation so the system does not allow creation of entries that runtime would later block. it composes path, core/legacy/validated-deployment classification, profile, and state facts in sequence; it does not load a control, inject styles, or enforce page authorization. 旧定义表或模块实例中的桌面控件路径；必须先通过共享路径规范化。 desktop control path from the legacy definition table or module instance; it must first pass shared path normalization. 仅传给 profile/状态解析边界的可选 http 上下文；它不是授权结论。 optional http context passed only to profile/state-resolution boundaries; it is not an authorization conclusion. 路径与 profile/部署边界通过时的受控运行描述；已禁用包仍返回描述。 controlled runtime descriptor when path and profile/deployment boundaries pass; disabled packages still return a descriptor. 失败或禁用时的受控非敏感原因，不含物理路径、连接或异常细节。 controlled non-sensitive reason when failed or disabled, with no physical path, connection, or exception detail. 入口通过路径/profile/部署边界时为 true；true 不表示已加载或已授权。 true when the entry passes path/profile/deployment boundaries; true does not mean loaded or authorized.

entries.name: GetActiveStyleResources
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.getactivestyleresources-system.web.httpcontext getactivestyleresources dotnet-method gets css candidates for enabled trusted module packages in the current front-end portal tab. public static system.collections.generic.ilist<aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulestyleresource> aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.getactivestyleresources(system.web.httpcontext context = null) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.getactivestyleresources-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 获取当前前台门户 tab 中已启用受信任模块包的 css 候选。 gets css candidates for enabled trusted module packages in the current front-end portal tab. 本方法消费已完成路径、profile 和状态 gate 的运行描述符，只输出受信任且已启用包的 manifest css 资源候选。它不重新校验 manifest、不注入 link 标记、不加载控件、不实施导航或页面授权；实际 head 注入由 master page 的独立边界负责。 this method consumes runtime descriptors that have already passed path, profile, and state gates, and outputs candidates only for manifest css resources of trusted enabled packages. it does not revalidate manifests, inject link markup, load controls, enforce navigation, or enforce page authorization; actual head injection belongs to the master page's separate boundary. 可选 http 上下文；未提供时使用当前上下文，二者均不可用时返回空只读集合。 optional http context; the current context is used when omitted, and an empty read-only collection is returned when neither is available. 按活动 tab 顺序保留首次出现项、大小写无关去重的站内 css 候选只读集合；后台请求、无活动 tab 或解析期间受控异常可能返回空集合，受控异常发生前已累计的候选会被保留。 read-only site-local css candidates that retain first occurrence in active-tab order and are de-duplicated case-insensitively; administration requests, no active tab, or a controlled resolution exception can return an empty collection, while candidates accumulated before a controlled exception are retained.

entries.name: IsValidPackageId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isvalidpackageid-system.string isvalidpackageid dotnet-method 判断包标识是否满足稳定 ascii 契约。 determines whether a package identifier meets the stable ascii contract. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isvalidpackageid(string packageid) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isvalidpackageid-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 判断包标识是否满足稳定 ascii 契约。 determines whether a package identifier meets the stable ascii contract. 待校验包标识。package identifier to validate. 包标识是否可安全用于状态表和缓存键。whether the identifier is safe for the state table and cache keys.

entries.name: TryReadPackage
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryreadpackage-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackage-system.string tryreadpackage dotnet-method reads and validates one trusted-deployment module package by directory name. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryreadpackage(string directoryname, out aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackage package, out string reason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.tryreadpackage-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackage-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 按目录名读取并验证一个受信任部署模块包。 reads and validates one trusted-deployment module package by directory name. 该私有读取链只验证既有部署内容，不安装、修复或修改任何文件；成功也不代替 profile、状态表、路由或页面授权。 this private read chain validates existing deployment content only and never installs, repairs, or modifies files; success also does not replace profile, state-table, routing, or page-authorization gates. `desktopmodules` 直接子目录的候选名称；必须先通过受控目录名规则。 candidate name of an immediate `desktopmodules` child directory; it must first pass the controlled directory-name rule. 成功时返回不可变受信任包快照；失败时保持 null。 returns an immutable trusted-package snapshot when successful; it remains null on failure. 不含物理路径、原始 manifest 或异常详情的受控失败原因。 controlled failure reason that contains no physical path, raw manifest, or exception detail. 目录、manifest、入口和资源均通过当前受控校验时为 true。 true when the directory, manifest, entry, and resources all pass current controlled validation.

entries.name: IsSchemaVersionSupported
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isschemaversionsupported-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject isschemaversionsupported dotnet-method validates whether the module manifest schemaversion is currently supported. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isschemaversionsupported(newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject manifest) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isschemaversionsupported-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 验证模块 manifest schemaversion 是否为当前支持版本。 validates whether the module manifest schemaversion is currently supported. 已解析但尚未被信任的 manifest 对象。 parsed but not yet trusted manifest object. 仅当 schemaversion 是当前受控整数版本时为 true。 true only when schemaversion is the current controlled integer version.

entries.name: ReadRequiredString
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readrequiredstring-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject-system.string-system.int32 readrequiredstring dotnet-method reads a required string manifest property. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readrequiredstring(newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject manifest, string propertyname, int maximumlength) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readrequiredstring-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject-system.string-system.int32 portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 读取必填字符串 manifest 属性。 reads a required string manifest property. 已解析但尚未被信任的 manifest 对象。 parsed but not yet trusted manifest object. 代码定义的固定属性名，不来自请求或 manifest 值。 code-defined fixed property name, not a request or manifest value. 接受前的最大字符长度。 maximum character length before acceptance. 修剪后的非空字符串。 trimmed non-empty string. 属性缺失、为 null、非字符串、超长或修剪后为空时引发，由受控包读取回退处理。 raised when the property is missing, null, non-string, overlong, or empty after trimming; the controlled package-read fallback handles it.

entries.name: ReadOptionalString
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readoptionalstring-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject-system.string-system.int32 readoptionalstring dotnet-method reads an optional string manifest property with type and length checks. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readoptionalstring(newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject manifest, string propertyname, int maximumlength) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readoptionalstring-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject-system.string-system.int32 portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 读取可选字符串 manifest 属性，并执行类型和长度检查。 reads an optional string manifest property with type and length checks. 已解析但尚未被信任的 manifest 对象。 parsed but not yet trusted manifest object. 代码定义的固定属性名，不来自请求或 manifest 值。 code-defined fixed property name, not a request or manifest value. 接受前的最大字符长度。 maximum character length before acceptance. 缺失/null 时为稳定空文本，否则为通过类型、修剪和长度检查的文本。 stable empty text when missing/null; otherwise text that passed type, trimming, and length checks. 属性不是字符串或超过固定长度时引发，由受控包读取回退处理。 raised when the property is not a string or exceeds the fixed length; the controlled package-read fallback handles it.

entries.name: ReadAndValidateResources
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readandvalidateresources-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject-system.string readandvalidateresources dotnet-method reads and validates site-local static resources declared by a module package. private static system.collections.generic.ilist<string> aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readandvalidateresources(newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject manifest, string packagepath) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.readandvalidateresources-newtonsoft.json.linq.jobject-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 读取并验证模块包声明的站内静态资源。 reads and validates site-local static resources declared by a module package. 已通过前置 schema/字段检查、但资源声明仍待验证的 manifest。 manifest that passed prior schema/field checks but whose resource declarations still require validation. 已验证包目录的物理根路径。 physical root path of the validated package directory. 保持 manifest 顺序的只读包内资源相对路径列表。 read-only list of package-relative resource paths preserving manifest order. 资源数组、条目、路径、物理文件或扩展名不满足当前部署契约时引发。 raised when the resource array, item, path, physical file, or extension violates the current deployment contract.

entries.name: IsValidResourcePath
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isvalidresourcepath-system.string isvalidresourcepath dotnet-method validates that a resource path is package-relative and contains no external url or directory escape. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isvalidresourcepath(string resource) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isvalidresourcepath-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 验证资源路径为包内相对路径，且不包含外部 url 或目录逃逸。 validates that a resource path is package-relative and contains no external url or directory escape. 已修剪并以正斜杠表示的 manifest 资源相对路径。 trimmed manifest resource-relative path expressed with forward slashes. 路径是非空包内相对路径且不包含 url 或点段逃逸时为 true。 true when the path is a non-empty package-relative path without a url or dot-segment escape.

entries.name: IsAllowedResourceExtension
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isallowedresourceextension-system.string isallowedresourceextension dotnet-method determines whether the resource extension is an allowed css or image type for module packages. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isallowedresourceextension(string resource) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isallowedresourceextension-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 判断资源扩展名是否属于当前模块包允许的 css 或图片类型。 determines whether the resource extension is an allowed css or image type for module packages. 已验证为包内相对路径的资源文本。 resource text already validated as package-relative. 扩展名属于当前 css 或图片 allowlist 时为 true。 true when the extension belongs to the current css or image allowlist.

entries.name: HasManifestCandidate
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.hasmanifestcandidate-system.string hasmanifestcandidate dotnet-method determines whether a legacy module path sits under a candidate package directory with a manifest. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.hasmanifestcandidate(string source) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.hasmanifestcandidate-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 判断一个旧模块路径是否位于带 manifest 的候选包目录下。 determines whether a legacy module path sits under a candidate package directory with a manifest.

entries.name: IsAdminRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isadminrequest-system.web.httpcontext isadminrequest dotnet-method determines whether the current request is an administration page so front-end module styles are not loaded there. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isadminrequest(system.web.httpcontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.isadminrequest-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 判断当前请求是否为后台页面，以避免后台维护页加载前台模块样式。 determines whether the current request is an administration page so front-end module styles are not loaded there. 已由样式候选入口确认非空的当前 http 上下文。 current http context already confirmed non-null by the style-candidate entry point. 当应用相对执行路径以 ~/admin/ 开头时为 true；该结果仅控制样式候选输出，不授予或拒绝后台访问。 true when the app-relative execution path starts with ~/admin/; the result controls style-candidate output only and neither grants nor denies administration access.

entries.name: GetChildPath
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.getchildpath-system.string-system.string getchildpath dotnet-method resolves a child path inside a root directory and rejects directory escape. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.getchildpath(string rootpath, string childpath) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog.getchildpath-system.string-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecatalog dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackage.cs csharp 在根目录内解析子路径，并拒绝目录逃逸。 resolves a child path inside a root directory and rejects directory escape. 经调用方选择的受控物理根路径。 controlled physical root path selected by the caller. 待解析的受控子路径；调用方仍须在此 helper 前执行自己的格式规则。 controlled child path to resolve; callers still must apply their own format rules before this helper. 规范化后仍位于根目录下的物理子路径。 normalized physical child path that remains below the root directory. 组合并规范化后路径不在根目录下时引发。 raised when the combined and normalized path is not below the root directory.

entries.name: PortalModuleProfileResolver
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver portalmoduleprofileresolver dotnet-type resolves the module profile and package set allowed by the current deployment environment. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmoduleprofileresolver.cs csharp 解析当前部署环境允许的模块 profile 与模块包集合。 resolves the module profile and package set allowed by the current deployment environment. p20.3 的解析器只读取 web.config / 环境 json appsettings，不读取数据库设置表，也不提供在线启停能力。它表达“当前部署允许哪些能力进入门户”，模块状态表随后再表达“允许范围内是否启用”。 the p20.3 resolver reads only web.config / environment json appsettings. it does not read the database setting table or provide online switching. it represents which capabilities this deployment allows into the portal; the module state table then represents enablement inside that allowed scope.

entries.name: NotAllowedReasonPrefix
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-f-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver.notallowedreasonprefix notallowedreasonprefix dotnet-field stable reason prefix used when a package is not allowed by the current profile. public const string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver.notallowedreasonprefix dotnet:f:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver.notallowedreasonprefix portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmoduleprofileresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmoduleprofileresolver.cs csharp 未进入当前 profile 时写入诊断原因的稳定前缀。 stable reason prefix used when a package is not allowed by the current profile.

entries.name: Resolve

entries.name: PortalModulePackageStates
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates portalmodulepackagestates dotnet-type restricted enabled-state store for deployed module packages. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackagestates.cs csharp 已部署模块包的受限启用状态存储。 restricted enabled-state store for deployed module packages. 本存储不写入模块文件。读取状态表不存在或失败时，已验证包保持默认启用，以避免未迁移旧库阻断门户；后台写入会明确失败并提示执行迁移。仅验证包标识格式，调用方必须先通过确认受信任部署包存在；现有目录页已遵守此顺序。 this store never writes module files. when the state table is missing or unreadable, validated packages remain enabled by default so an unmigrated legacy database cannot block the portal; administration writes fail explicitly and request migration.validates only package-id format, so callers must first confirm a trusted deployed package through; the existing catalog page follows that order.

entries.name: Read
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates.read-system.string-system.web.httpcontext read dotnet-method reads the restricted state snapshot of one validated deployed module package. public static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestatereadresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates.read(string packageid, system.web.httpcontext context = null) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates.read-system.string-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepackagestates dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepackagestates.cs csharp 读取一个已验证部署模块包的受限状态快照。 reads the restricted state snapshot of one validated deployed module package. 状态表仅在受信任部署、profile gate 和包校验之后表达允许范围内的启停。读取结果不授予访问、不确认模块已加载，且不应被直接调用者用来绕过这些独立门禁。 the state table expresses enablement within the allowed scope only after trusted deployment, profile gating, and package validation. a read result grants no access, confirms no module load, and must not be used by direct callers to bypass those independent gates. 调用方已通过受信任目录确认的稳定包标识；此方法只拒绝格式非法的值，不重新验证 manifest 或物理目录。 stable package identifier already confirmed by the caller through the trusted catalog; this method rejects only format-invalid values and does not revalidate the manifest or physical directory. 仅传给受限异常诊断的可选 http 上下文；它不参与包、profile 或页面授权。 optional http context passed only to restricted exception diagnostics; it does not participate in package, profile, or page authorization. 读取可用性与默认或显式快照：可用缺行返回未配置的默认启用状态；不可用或格式非法时状态为空。 read availability and the default or explicit snapshot: an available missing row returns an unconfigured default-enabled state; unavailable or format-invalid input has no state.

entries.name: Save

it does not make an unknown package loadable, but should be avoided as a new calling pattern. successful state persistence also does not mean the current request loads the package: profile gating, trusted deployment, and page authorization remain independent. 调用方已按受信任目录确认的稳定包标识；本方法仍只验证格式。 stable package identifier already confirmed by the caller through the trusted catalog; this method still validates only its format. 要保存的状态表启用标志；它不越过当前 profile、部署或授权门禁。 enabled flag to persist in the state table; it does not bypass current profile, deployment, or authorization gates. 可选非敏感管理员备注；净化后为空时写入数据库 null。 optional non-sensitive administrator note; it writes database null when empty after sanitization. 用于受限操作人字段和异常诊断的可选 http 上下文。 optional http context for restricted actor fields and exception diagnostics. 安全写入结果；不包含连接串、sql 或异常详情。 safe write result; it contains no connection-string, sql, or exception detail.

entries.name: PortalModulePathValidator
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator portalmodulepathvalidator dotnet-type validates a desktop-module relative path before it reaches web forms. loadcontrol class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepathvalidator.cs csharp 校验进入 web forms的桌面模块相对路径。 loadcontrol validates a desktop-module relative path before it reaches web forms. loadcontrol 此校验器只允许或下的站内控件，拒绝绝对路径、外部 url 和父目录跳转。它缩小旧动态加载机制的路径边界，不替代模块写操作、页面访问或部署信任授权。 desktopmodules/ admin/ .ascx this validator permits only site-localcontrols underorand rejects absolute paths, external urls, and parent traversal. it narrows the path boundary of the legacy dynamic loader; it does not replace authorization for module writes, page access, or deployment trust. .ascx desktopmodules/ admin/

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator.trynormalizedesktopsource-system.string-system.string-system.string trynormalizedesktopsource dotnet-method validates and normalizes a desktop module-control path. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator.trynormalizedesktopsource(string source, out string normalizedsource, out string errormessage) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator.trynormalizedesktopsource-system.string-system.string-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulepathvalidator dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulepathvalidator.cs csharp 校验并规范化桌面模块控件路径。 validates and normalizes a desktop module-control path. 来自旧模块定义或 manifest 的原始路径。 raw path from a legacy module definition or manifest. 成功时为不带前缀、使用正斜杠的站内相对路径。 ~/ on success, a site-relative path without theprefix and with forward slashes. ~/ 失败时供受控管理界面或诊断使用的说明，不包含物理路径。 failure explanation for controlled administration ui or diagnostics, without physical paths. 路径是否满足当前动态加载边界。 whether the path meets the current dynamic-loading boundary.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit portaloperationaudit dotnet-type portal operations-audit facade: best-effort records traceable low-sensitivity facts after a business action succeeds and provides compatibility degradation for legacy schemas without blocking business. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portaloperationaudit.cs csharp 门户运营审计门面：在业务动作成功后尽力记录可追溯的低敏事实，并为旧 schema 提供不阻断业务的兼容降级。 portal operations-audit facade: best-effort records traceable low-sensitivity facts after a business action succeeds and provides compatibility degradation for legacy schemas without blocking business. 审计追溯高价值状态变化，但不替代运行时错误日志。旧数据库缺少审计表、连接不可用或写入失败时，本门面只记录诊断并保持已成功业务动作的结果，不回滚或重试业务动作。 auditing traces high-value state changes but does not replace runtime error logging. when a legacy database lacks the audit table, the connection is unavailable, or a write fails, this facade records diagnostics only and preserves the already-successful business outcome without rolling it back or retrying it.

entries.name: Record
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit.record-system.string-system.string-system.string-system.string-system.string-system.web.httpcontext-system.string-system.string record dotnet-method best-effort writes one operations-audit record for a high-value state change; it records a success fact by default (outcome="success"), and security-critical required events (authentication failures, authorization failures) may pass outcome="failure" to record a genuine failure fact. public static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit.record(string category, string action, string targettype, string targetid, string summary, system.web.httpcontext context = null, string relatedeventid = null, string outcome = "success") dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit.record-system.string-system.string-system.string-system.string-system.string-system.web.httpcontext-system.string-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaloperationaudit dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portaloperationaudit.cs csharp 尽力写入一条高价值状态变化的运营审计记录；默认记录成功事实（outcome="success"），安全类必需事件（认证失败、授权失败）可显式传入 outcome="failure" 以记录真实的失败事实。 best-effort writes one operations-audit record for a high-value state change; it records a success fact by default (outcome="success"), and security-critical required events (authentication failures, authorization failures) may pass outcome="failure" to record a genuine failure fact. 稳定分类，例如 registration 或 useradministration。 stable category, such as registration or useradministration. 稳定动作，例如 submit、approve 或 addrole。 stable action, such as submit, approve, or addrole. 被操作资源的稳定类型。 stable type of the operated resource. 可安全审计的非敏感目标标识。 non-sensitive target identifier that is safe to audit. 不含口令、token 或业务正文的低敏摘要。 low-sensitivity summary without passwords, tokens, or business body text. 可选 http 上下文，用于受限读取动作人和请求元数据及诊断关联。 optional http context used for restricted actor/request metadata and diagnostic correlation. 可选的既有诊断事件编号，不复制事件正文。 optional existing diagnostics event identifier; its body is not copied. 动作结果的稳定值；默认 "success"。安全类必需事件（认证失败、授权失败）传入 "failure" 以记录真实的失败事实，任何情况下都不伪造成功记录。 stable action-outcome value; defaults to "success". security-critical required events (authentication failures, authorization failures) pass "failure" to record a genuine failure fact; a success record is never fabricated under any circumstance.

entries.name: Query

entries.name: PortalPage`1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1 portalpage`1 dotnet-type base class providing theme pre-initialization and unity dependency injection for portal web forms pages. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t> dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1 portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.web.ui.page t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ihttphandler dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalpage.cs csharp 为门户 web forms 页面提供主题预初始化与 unity 依赖注入的基类。 base class providing theme pre-initialization and unity dependency injection for portal web forms pages. 生命周期保持既有顺序：先在选择唯一原生 theme，再注入当前请求依赖， 最后调用。该顺序直接影响 web forms 主题资源加载和页面控件树构建， 不能因为派生页 ui 需要或文档化整理而随意重排。 the lifecycle keeps the existing order:selects the single native theme first, injects current-request dependencies next, and finally calls. this order directly affects web forms theme resource loading and page control-tree construction, so derived-page ui needs or documentation cleanup must not casually reorder it. 供 unity buildup 使用的具体页面类型。 concrete page type supplied to unity buildup.

entries.name: OnPreInit
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1.onpreinit-system.eventargs onpreinit dotnet-method applies the theme and builds dependencies during page pre-initialization. protected override void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t>.onpreinit(system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1.onpreinit-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalpage.cs csharp 在页面预初始化阶段应用主题并装配依赖。 applies the theme and builds dependencies during page pre-initialization. 主题必须在 web forms 加载 app_themes 资源前设置。主题解析器自身负责可信包验证和安全回退； 本方法不读取查询字符串来选择主题，也不改变 tab 覆盖优先级。 the theme must be set before web forms loads app_themes resources. the theme resolver handles trusted package validation and safe fallback; this method does not read query strings to choose a theme or alter tab-override precedence. 预初始化事件参数。 pre-initialization event arguments.

entries.name: ShouldApplyPortalTheme
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1.shouldapplyportaltheme shouldapplyportaltheme dotnet-property indicates whether the current page should load the portal web forms theme. protected virtual bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t>.shouldapplyportaltheme { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1.shouldapplyportaltheme portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalpage.cs csharp 指示当前页面是否应加载门户 web forms 主题。 indicates whether the current page should load the portal web forms theme. 普通页面应保持默认值；仅无 html 外壳的下载、流式响应或极少数兼容页面可覆写为， 以避免 web forms 在没有的页面上强制注入主题样式。 false <head runat="server" /> normal pages should keep the default value. only download, streaming-response, or rare compatibility pages without an html shell should override this to, avoiding web forms stylesheet injection on pages that do not have. false <head runat="server" />

entries.name: InjectDependencies
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1.injectdependencies injectdependencies dotnet-method performs page dependency injection through the unity container exposed by the current http application instance. protected virtual void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t>.injectdependencies() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage-1.injectdependencies portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalpage.cs csharp 使用当前 http 应用实例公开的 unity 容器执行页面依赖注入。 performs page dependency injection through the unity container exposed by the current http application instance. 当前请求或容器访问器不可用时保持历史静默返回；若访问器存在但容器为空则抛出异常， 以便全局异常和诊断流程记录配置错误。 when the current request or container accessor is unavailable, the historical behavior is a silent return. when an accessor exists but its container is null, an exception is thrown so the global error and diagnostics flow can record the configuration problem.

entries.name: BuildUpControl
