entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldiagnostics.unhandled-system.exception-system.web.httpcontext unhandled dotnet-method records an unhandled exception and returns the diagnostics event id shown to users. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldiagnostics.unhandled(system.exception exception, system.web.httpcontext context = null) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldiagnostics.unhandled-system.exception-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldiagnostics t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldiagnostics dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portaldiagnostics.cs csharp 记录未处理异常，并返回可展示给用户的诊断事件编号。 records an unhandled exception and returns the diagnostics event id shown to users. 可选未处理异常；详情由写入链净化、限长后才可进入诊断条目。 optional unhandled exception; its detail may enter a diagnostics entry only after write-pipeline sanitization and capping. 可选 http 上下文；缺失时不附加请求字段。 optional http context; no request fields are appended when absent. 可用于向用户关联支持请求的诊断事件编号，而非异常详情。 the diagnostics event id that may correlate a support request for a user, not exception detail.

entries.name: CheckSqlConnection

entries.name: AreAdminLogDetailsEnabled

entries.name: PortalNavigationSettings
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationsettings portalnavigationsettings dotnet-type typed reader for navigation-visibility settings (adr 0026 decision 2). class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationsettings dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationsettings portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalnavigationsettings.cs csharp 导航可见性设置的强类型读取器（adr 0026 决策二）。 typed reader for navigation-visibility settings (adr 0026 decision 2). 只通过已登记定义读取（数据库覆盖 → appsettings → 代码默认），不直接读取原始配置键，也不判定任何授权。 任何解析失败都退回"不隐藏任何页签"的保守默认，确保配置错误永远不会把导航清空。 本类不缓存结果：底层 `portalruntimesettings` 已按定义做受控解析，缓存失效策略由消费方（导航渲染层）决定。 reads only through registered definitions (database override → appsettings → code default); it never reads raw configuration keys directly and never decides authorization. any parse failure falls back to the conservative default of hiding nothing, so a configuration error can never empty the navigation. this class does not cache: the underlying `portalruntimesettings` already resolves per definition, and the consumer (navigation renderer) owns cache invalidation.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver portalthemeresolver dotnet-type resolves and applies the portal web forms theme. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 解析并应用门户 web forms 主题。 resolves and applies the portal web forms theme. 原生 theme 只承担每页唯一基底；tab 和模块差异通过稳定 css scope 表达。主题值必须对应已部署且通过 manifest 校验的可信包，不能由查询字符串、远程 url 或脚本决定。解析优先级保持 tab 覆盖、数据库运行设置、appsettings、default；结果只在当前 httpcontext.items 中缓存，不构成跨请求主题缓存。 native theme provides the one base theme per page only; tab and module variations use stable css scopes. theme values must resolve to a deployed package that passes manifest validation and cannot be selected by query strings, remote urls, or scripts. resolution priority remains tab override, database runtime setting, appsettings, and default. results are cached only in the current httpcontext.items, not across requests.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-f-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.themenamesettingkey themenamesettingkey dotnet-field stable setting key used to configure the current portal theme. public const string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.themenamesettingkey dotnet:f:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.themenamesettingkey portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 用于配置当前门户主题的稳定设置键。 stable setting key used to configure the current portal theme.

entries.name: TraceCategory
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-f-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracecategory tracecategory dotnet-field restricted diagnostic category for theme fallback, without users, paths, or raw configuration. private const string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracecategory dotnet:f:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracecategory portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 主题回退的受限诊断分类，不包含用户、路径或配置原文。 restricted diagnostic category for theme fallback, without users, paths, or raw configuration.

entries.name: ThemeContextKey

entries.name: TraceLock
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-f-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracelock tracelock dotnet-field synchronization lock protecting the process-local fallback-warning de-duplication set. private static readonly object aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracelock dotnet:f:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracelock portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 保护进程内回退告警去重集合的同步锁。 synchronization lock protecting the process-local fallback-warning de-duplication set.

entries.name: WarnedFallbacks
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-f-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.warnedfallbacks warnedfallbacks dotnet-field set of recorded restricted fallback keys, preventing repeated diagnostics for the same theme and reason. private static readonly system.collections.generic.hashset<string> aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.warnedfallbacks dotnet:f:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.warnedfallbacks portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 已记录的受限回退键集合，避免同一主题/原因重复污染诊断。 set of recorded restricted fallback keys, preventing repeated diagnostics for the same theme and reason.

entries.name: ApplyTheme
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.applytheme-system.web.ui.page applytheme dotnet-method resolves and applies the single native theme during page preinit. public static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemecontext aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.applytheme(system.web.ui.page page) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.applytheme-system.web.ui.page portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 在页面 preinit 阶段解析并应用唯一原生 theme。 resolves and applies the single native theme during page preinit. 调用方应在调用本方法，使 web forms 在加载 app_themes 资源前得到主题。它不会重新排序页面依赖注入，也不会从 url 接受主题覆盖。 preinit callers should invoke this method duringso web forms receives the theme before loading app_themes resources. it neither reorders page dependency injection nor accepts theme overrides from a url. preinit 接收主题的 web forms 页面。 web forms page receiving the theme. 本请求的完整主题上下文。 complete theme context for this request. 页面实例为 null 时抛出。 thrown when the page instance is null.

entries.name: ResolveThemeContext
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvethemecontext-system.web.httpcontext resolvethemecontext dotnet-method resolves the current request theme context and caches the result in httpcontext. public static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemecontext aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvethemecontext(system.web.httpcontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvethemecontext-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 解析当前请求的主题上下文并在 httpcontext 中缓存结果。 resolves the current request theme context and caches the result in httpcontext. admin 请求不读取 tab 覆盖。覆盖表不可用时保留已解析全局主题；无效覆盖也不阻断请求，而是记录受限告警。 admin requests do not read tab overrides. when the override table is unavailable, the resolved global theme remains; an invalid override also does not block the request and records a restricted warning. 当前 http 上下文。 current http context. 最终主题与 css scope 信息。 final theme and css-scope information.

entries.name: GetCurrentThemeContext
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.getcurrentthemecontext-system.web.httpcontext getcurrentthemecontext dotnet-method returns the resolved theme context for this request, or null when it has not been resolved. public static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemecontext aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.getcurrentthemecontext(system.web.httpcontext context = null) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.getcurrentthemecontext-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 返回当前请求已解析的主题上下文；尚未解析时返回 null。 returns the resolved theme context for this request, or null when it has not been resolved. 当前 http 上下文。 current http context. 已缓存的主题上下文，或 null。 cached theme context, or null.

entries.name: ResolveThemeName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvethemename-system.web.httpcontext resolvethemename dotnet-method resolves the final theme name; retained for health checks and legacy call sites. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvethemename(system.web.httpcontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvethemename-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 解析最终主题名；保留给健康检查和旧调用点使用。 resolves the final theme name; retained for health checks and legacy call sites. 当前 http 上下文。 current http context. 合法且已验证的主题目录名称。 valid and verified theme directory name.

entries.name: GetCurrentCssClass
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.getcurrentcssclass-system.web.httpcontext getcurrentcssclass dotnet-method gets stable theme and tab css classes written to the master body. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.getcurrentcssclass(system.web.httpcontext context = null) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.getcurrentcssclass-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 获取写入 master body 的稳定主题与 tab css class。 gets stable theme and tab css classes written to the master body. 正常门户页面在已解析主题。若调用过早而无上下文缓存，本方法只返回 default scope，不在渲染阶段重新读取数据库或配置。 preinit normal portal pages resolve the theme during. when called too early without a context cache, this method returns only the default scope and does not reread database or configuration during rendering. preinit 当前 http 上下文。 current http context. 仅含受控 ascii class 的文本。 text containing controlled ascii classes only.

entries.name: ResolveTrustedThemeName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvetrustedthemename-system.string-system.web.httpcontext-system.string resolvetrustedthemename dotnet-method resolves a candidate theme name to a validated deployed theme, falling back to default and recording a restricted warning on failure. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvetrustedthemename(string requestedthemename, system.web.httpcontext context, out string fallbackreason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.resolvetrustedthemename-system.string-system.web.httpcontext-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 把候选主题名解析为已验证部署主题，失败时回退 default 并记录受限告警。 resolves a candidate theme name to a validated deployed theme, falling back to default and recording a restricted warning on failure.

entries.name: ToThemeSource

entries.name: IsAdminRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.isadminrequest-system.web.httpcontext isadminrequest dotnet-method determines whether the current request is an administration page, which does not participate in tab theme overrides. private static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.isadminrequest(system.web.httpcontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.isadminrequest-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 判断当前请求是否为后台页，后台页不参与 tab 主题覆盖。 determines whether the current request is an administration page, which does not participate in tab theme overrides.

entries.name: TryGetActiveTabId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.trygetactivetabid-system.web.httpcontext trygetactivetabid dotnet-method reads the active tab identifier from the current portal context, returning null when unavailable. private static int? aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.trygetactivetabid(system.web.httpcontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.trygetactivetabid-system.web.httpcontext portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 从当前门户上下文读取活动 tab 标识，无法取得时返回 null。 reads the active tab identifier from the current portal context, returning null when unavailable.

entries.name: NormalizeCssSegment
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.normalizecsssegment-system.string normalizecsssegment dotnet-method converts a theme, pane, or package identifier into a stable css class segment. private static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.normalizecsssegment(string value) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.normalizecsssegment-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 把主题、pane 或包标识转换为稳定 css class 片段。 converts a theme, pane, or package identifier into a stable css class segment.

entries.name: TraceFallback
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracefallback-system.web.httpcontext-system.string-system.string tracefallback dotnet-method records a theme fallback warning and de-duplicates by requested theme and reason. private static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracefallback(system.web.httpcontext context, string requestedtheme, string fallbackreason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver.tracefallback-system.web.httpcontext-system.string-system.string portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalthemeresolver dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalthemeresolver.cs csharp 记录主题回退告警，并按请求主题和原因去重。 records a theme fallback warning and de-duplicates by requested theme and reason.

entries.name: IContainerAccessor
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor icontaineraccessor dotnet-type defines the composition contract that exposes unity-container access to portal runtime components. interface aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor portal aspnet.starterkit.portal dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/icontaineraccessor.cs csharp 定义向门户运行时公开 unity 容器访问的组合契约。 defines the composition contract that exposes unity-container access to portal runtime components.

entries.name: Container
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor.container container dotnet-property gets the unity container supplied by the current composition root. unity.iunitycontainer aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor.container { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor.container portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/icontaineraccessor.cs csharp 获取当前组合根提供的 unity 容器。 gets the unity container supplied by the current composition root. 该属性只暴露依赖解析入口，不代表调用方可以绕过页面授权、生命周期或注册契约直接创建任意服务。 this property exposes only the dependency-resolution entry point; callers must not treat it as permission to bypass page authorization, lifecycle rules, or registration contracts.

entries.name: CachedPortalModuleControl
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet-type web forms container that caches inner module html output by module instance and caller-supplied controlled runtime identity. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 按模块实例和调用方提供的受控运行身份缓存模块内部 html 输出的 web forms 容器。 web forms container that caches inner module html output by module instance and caller-supplied controlled runtime identity. 调用方必须在生命周期使用前绑定模块配置、portal、受控桌面入口和缓存身份。正缓存时间会复用内部输出，受信任包版本与状态修订可由隔离；缓存键只区分模块实例和当前编辑角色判断，不按具体用户隔离。该容器不实施 tab/模块授权，也不编码模块生成的 html，因此模块不得把仅对单一用户可见的敏感内容放入共享缓存输出。 the caller must bind module configuration, portal, controlled desktop entry, and cache identity before lifecycle use. a positive cache duration reuses inner output, whilecan isolate trusted-package version and state revision; the key distinguishes only the module instance and current edit-role check, not individual users. this container neither enforces tab/module authorization nor encodes module-generated html, so modules must not place user-private sensitive content in shared cached output.

entries.name: ModuleConfiguration
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.moduleconfiguration moduleconfiguration dotnet-property gets or sets the runtime settings snapshot for the current module. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.modulesettings aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.moduleconfiguration { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.moduleconfiguration portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置当前模块的运行时设置快照。 gets or sets the runtime settings snapshot for the current module. 调用方必须在读取、计算、构造子控件或渲染前提供非 null 值。setter 保留对象引用，不验证缓存时间、角色、入口或模块授权。 the caller must provide a non-null value before reading, computing, constructing child controls, or rendering. the setter retains the object reference and validates neither cache duration, roles, entry, nor module authorization.

entries.name: ModuleId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.moduleid moduleid dotnet-property gets the module-instance identifier from the bound module configuration. public int aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.moduleid { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.moduleid portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 从已绑定模块配置获取模块实例标识。 gets the module-instance identifier from the bound module configuration. 该值直接投影，既不生成新标识，也不证明模块属于当前 portal 或当前用户已获授权。 the value directly projects; it neither creates a new identifier nor proves that the module belongs to the current portal or is authorized for the current user. 尚未绑定 moduleconfiguration 时访问该属性。 the property is accessed before moduleconfiguration is bound.

entries.name: PortalId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.portalid portalid dotnet-property gets or sets the current portal identifier subsequently passed to the dynamic module control. public int aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.portalid { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.portalid portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置随后传递给动态模块控件的当前 portal 标识。 gets or sets the current portal identifier subsequently passed to the dynamic module control. 该属性只保存调用方上下文，不验证 portal 存在性或成员关系，也不单独加入缓存键。 this property only retains caller context; it validates neither portal existence nor membership and is not independently added to the cache key.

entries.name: DesktopSource
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.desktopsource desktopsource dotnet-property gets or sets the desktop-control entry already resolved by the module catalog. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.desktopsource { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.desktopsource portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置已由模块目录解析的桌面控件入口。 gets or sets the desktop-control entry already resolved by the module catalog. 非空值必须来自的运行描述符；本容器不会再次验证 manifest、profile、包状态或路径。空值仅触发中既有的旧模块定义路径规范化兼容。 a nonempty value must come from the runtime descriptor produced by; this container does not revalidate manifest, profile, package state, or path. an empty value only triggers the existing legacy module-definition path normalization in.

entries.name: CacheIdentity

entries.name: CreateChildControls
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.createchildcontrols createchildcontrols dotnet-method constructs the module child control on a cache miss and reuses cached output on a hit. protected override void aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.createchildcontrols() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.createchildcontrols portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 在缓存未命中时构造模块子控件，在命中时复用已缓存输出。 constructs the module child control on a cache miss and reuses cached output on a hit. 调用方应先提供受控桌面入口、缓存身份、portal 和模块配置。命中缓存时本方法不构造子控件；未命中时仅加载该入口并执行接口/配置注入。加载失败会记录诊断并留下空模块区域，避免单个模块阻断门户页；它不改写模块定义、包状态、缓存键或过期策略。 the caller must first provide a controlled desktop entry, cache identity, portal, and module configuration. on a cache hit this method does not construct child controls; on a miss it loads only that entry and performs interface/configuration injection. a load failure records diagnostics and leaves an empty module region so one module cannot block the portal page; it does not rewrite module definitions, package state, cache keys, or expiry policy.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.render-system.web.ui.htmltextwriter render dotnet-method writes module output to the current response and creates or reuses an asp.net cache entry when caching is enabled. protected override void aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.render(system.web.ui.htmltextwriter output) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol.render-system.web.ui.htmltextwriter portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.cachedportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/cachedportalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 把模块输出写入当前响应，并在启用缓存时创建或复用 asp.net 缓存项。 writes module output to the current response and creates or reuses an asp.net cache entry when caching is enabled. 零缓存时间直接委托基类渲染。正缓存时间在未命中时先把子控件树渲染到内存字符串，再以本地加配置秒数作为绝对过期时间写入，无缓存依赖且无滑动过期；命中时直接复用字符串。最终使用输出已渲染 html，不在本层重新编码、授权或净化模块内容。 a zero cache duration delegates directly to base rendering. on a positive-duration miss, the child-control tree is first rendered to an in-memory string and inserted with localplus configured seconds as absolute expiration, with no cache dependency and no sliding expiration; a hit reuses the string. the finalemits already-rendered html without re-encoding, authorizing, or sanitizing module content at this layer. 接收模块 html 的当前响应写入器；本方法不拥有或释放它。 current response writer receiving module html; this method neither owns nor disposes it.

entries.name: PortalModuleControl`1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1 portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet-type base class providing portal/module context, edit-entry hints, lazy settings loading, and current-request dependency injection to dynamically loaded desktop modules. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1 portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.web.ui.usercontrol t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.iattributeaccessor t:system.web.ui.inonbindingcontainer t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.iusercontroldesigneraccessor t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 为动态加载的桌面模块提供 portal/模块上下文、编辑入口提示、设置懒加载和当前请求依赖注入的基类。 base class providing portal/module context, edit-entry hints, lazy settings loading, and current-request dependency injection to dynamically loaded desktop modules. 动态加载器必须在模块使用上下文属性前设置和。派生控件在自己的初始化代码读取注入依赖前必须先调用 base.oninit；本基类在该调用中先保留 web forms 基类顺序，再使用当前请求容器注入成员。仅是实例内 ui 提示，所有实际读写仍需独立服务器端授权。 the dynamic loader must setandbefore the module uses context properties. a derived control must call base.oninit before reading injected dependencies in its own initialization code; this base class first preserves web forms base ordering and then injects members from the current-request container.is only a per-instance ui hint, and every actual read or write still requires independent server-side authorization. 由当前请求 unity 容器用于成员注入的具体模块类型；派生类应传入自身类型。 concrete module type used by the current-request unity container for member injection; a derived class should supply its own type.

entries.name: ModulesConfig
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.modulesconfig modulesconfig dotnet-property gets the module-settings read service injected by the current-request unity container. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.imodulesdb aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t>.modulesconfig { private get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.modulesconfig portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取由当前请求 unity 容器注入的模块设置读取服务。 gets the module-settings read service injected by the current-request unity container. 动态控件不由常规页面容器构造，因此显式请求成员注入。派生类只有在调用 base.oninit 后才能依赖该属性；服务只负责读取设置，不证明模块或用户授权。 dynamic controls are not constructed by the normal page container, soexplicitly requests member injection. a derived class may depend on this property only after calling base.oninit; the service only reads settings and proves neither module nor user authorization.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.moduleid moduleid dotnet-property gets the module-instance identifier from the bound module configuration. public int aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t>.moduleid { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.moduleid portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 从已绑定模块配置获取模块实例标识。 gets the module-instance identifier from the bound module configuration. 该值只投影，不生成标识、不验证 portal 归属，也不代表用户授权。 the value only projects; it neither generates an identifier, validates portal ownership, nor represents user authorization. 动态加载器尚未绑定 moduleconfiguration。 the dynamic loader has not yet bound moduleconfiguration.

entries.name: PortalId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.portalid portalid dotnet-property gets or sets the current portal identifier bound by the dynamic loader. public int aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t>.portalid { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.portalid portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置动态加载器绑定的当前 portal 标识。 gets or sets the current portal identifier bound by the dynamic loader. 该属性仅传递运行上下文，不验证 portal 存在性、模块归属、成员关系或权限。 this property only conveys runtime context and validates neither portal existence, module ownership, membership, nor permission.

entries.name: IsEditable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.iseditable iseditable dotnet-property gets the ui hint indicating whether this control instance displays an edit entry point. public bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t>.iseditable { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.iseditable portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取当前控件实例是否显示编辑入口的 ui 提示。 gets the ui hint indicating whether this control instance displays an edit entry point. 首次读取将全局 alwaysshoweditbutton 展示选项与当前请求对的角色布尔判断合并，并把结果以 1/2 缓存在本控件实例。后续读取不重新获取 portal 设置、角色或模块配置；该提示不能授权保存、删除、管理或数据读取。 the first read combines the global alwaysshoweditbutton display option with the current request's boolean role check against, then caches the result as 1 or 2 in this control instance. subsequent reads do not re-fetch portal settings, roles, or module configuration; the hint cannot authorize save, delete, administration, or data reads. 角色分支需要模块配置但动态加载器尚未绑定 moduleconfiguration。 the role branch requires module configuration before the dynamic loader has bound moduleconfiguration.

entries.name: ModuleConfiguration
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.moduleconfiguration moduleconfiguration dotnet-property gets or sets the current module runtime-settings snapshot bound by the dynamic loader. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.modulesettings aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t>.moduleconfiguration { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.moduleconfiguration portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 获取或设置动态加载器绑定的当前模块运行时设置快照。 gets or sets the current module runtime-settings snapshot bound by the dynamic loader. 调用方必须在读取、或前提供非 null 值。setter 只替换引用，保留既有编辑提示和已加载设置状态，因此生命周期内不应在首次消费后重新绑定。 the caller must provide a non-null value before reading,, or. the setter only replaces the reference and retains existing edit-hint and loaded-settings state, so rebinding should not occur after first consumption within the lifecycle.

entries.name: Settings
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.settings settings dotnet-property loads module key-value settings on demand and caches them within the current control instance. public system.collections.hashtable aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t>.settings { get; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol-1.settings portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol<t> t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol`1 dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/components/portalmodulecontrol.cs csharp 按需读取并在当前控件实例内缓存模块键值设置。 loads module key-value settings on demand and caches them within the current control instance. 当内部值为 null 时，使用已注入的和已绑定读取；只有非 null 结果会避免下次重读。返回的是旧式可变引用，不做复制、值净化或线程安全包装，也不自动感知数据库并发更新。读取设置不等于授权使用其中的路径、html 或其它值。 when the internal value is null, the property reads through injectedand bound; only a non-null result prevents another read. it returns the legacy mutablereference without copying, value sanitization, or thread-safety wrapping and does not automatically observe concurrent database changes. reading settings does not authorize use of paths, html, or other contained values. 访问发生在 moduleconfiguration 绑定或 oninit 依赖注入之前。 access occurs before moduleconfiguration binding or oninit dependency injection.

entries.name: OnInit

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault desktopdefault dotnet-type 将当前 tab 的已授权模块动态装配到门户页面窗格的主页面。 main page that dynamically assembles authorized modules for the current tab into portal layout panes. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage{aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault} t:system.web.ui.page t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ihttphandler dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx.cs csharp 将当前 tab 的已授权模块动态装配到门户页面窗格的主页面。 main page that dynamically assembles authorized modules for the current tab into portal layout panes. 模块入口会先通过解析。已验证部署包遵从启用状态；旧模块仍以受限路径兼容加载。 单个模块解析或加载失败只记录诊断并跳过该模块，不应终止整个页面请求。 each module entry is first resolved by. validated deployment packages obey enabled state, while legacy modules remain compatible through constrained paths. a single module resolution or load failure records diagnostics and skips that module; it should not terminate the entire page request.

entries.name: Page_Init
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault.page_init-system.object-system.eventargs page_init dotnet-method performs tab entry checks and assembles sign-in and loadable modules into their panes during page initialization. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault.page_init(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault.page_init-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopdefault dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx.cs csharp 在页面初始化阶段完成 tab 入口检查，并把登录控件和可加载模块装配到对应窗格。 performs tab entry checks and assembles sign-in and loadable modules into their panes during page initialization. tab 角色入口检查和主页匿名 signin 注入是独立的页面访问边界。其后模块装配仅消费已经受控解析的运行描述符：解析或加载一个模块失败会记录诊断并跳过该模块，不终止整页；解析成功也不替代 tab 授权或模块自身写操作授权。 tab-role entry checks and home-page anonymous signin injection are separate page-access boundaries. the subsequent module assembly consumes only controlled runtime descriptors: failure to resolve or load one module records diagnostics and skips that module without terminating the page; successful resolution does not replace tab authorization or a module's own write-operation authorization. web forms 初始化事件源；处理逻辑不依赖其具体类型。 web forms initialization event source; the handler does not depend on its concrete type. 初始化事件参数，随后原样交由页面生命周期使用。 initialization event arguments subsequently used by the page lifecycle as supplied.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage portalmasterpage dotnet-type theme css-scope host for the portal default master page. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.web.ui.masterpage t:system.web.ui.usercontrol t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.iattributeaccessor t:system.web.ui.inonbindingcontainer t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.iusercontroldesigneraccessor dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master.cs csharp 门户默认 master page 的主题 css 作用域宿主。 theme css-scope host for the portal default master page. 页面 theme 已在 portalpage.preinit 中确定。本类只在渲染前把已解析主题和门户 tab 转为受控 body class，不读取查询字符串、不重新选择 theme，也不使 genericerrorpage 依赖主题解析。主题包 resources 列表不在此处作为通用资源协议处理；本类仅按模块 catalog 结果加载当前 tab 已启用模块包声明的 css。 page theme is decided in portalpage.preinit. this class only converts the resolved theme and portal tab into controlled body classes before rendering; it does not read query strings, reselect theme, or make genericerrorpage depend on theme resolution. the theme-package resources list is not handled here as a general resource protocol; this class loads only css declared by enabled module packages used by the current tab.

entries.name: AddModulePackageStyles
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage.addmodulepackagestyles addmodulepackagestyles dotnet-method attaches final css candidates for enabled trusted module packages in the current tab to the page header. private void aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage.addmodulepackagestyles() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage.addmodulepackagestyles portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmasterpage dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master.cs csharp 将当前 tab 已启用受信任模块包的最终 css 候选附加到页面 header。 attaches final css candidates for enabled trusted module packages in the current tab to the page header. 资源候选的 manifest 信任、启用过滤和去重由模块 catalog 完成；本方法只将结果转换为固定 stylesheet 属性的 server 控件，并使用应用虚拟目录解析其站内路径。它不加载 theme manifest 资源、外部 url 或 javascript，不复验候选，也不实施页面授权；无 page 或 header 时保持既有静默跳过。 manifest trust, enabled filtering, and de-duplication of resource candidates are completed by the module catalog; this method only converts the results into server controls with fixed stylesheet attributes and resolves their site-local paths against the application virtual directory. it does not load theme-manifest resources, external urls, or javascript, revalidate candidates, or enforce page authorization; it retains the existing silent skip when page or header is absent.

when resolution falls through or the current user may not access the hosting tab it returns an empty string and the markup shows the degraded hint instead. private string aspnet.starterkit.portal.myworkitems.resolveitemurl(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkiteminfo item) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.myworkitems.resolveitemurl-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkiteminfo portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.myworkitems t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.myworkitems dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/myworkitems/myworkitems.ascx.cs csharp 解析待办对应业务对象的前台可达地址；解析落空或当前用户无权访问承载页签时返回空串，由标记层改为降级提示。 resolves the front-end reachable url of the business object behind a work item; when resolution falls through or the current user may not access the hosting tab it returns an empty string and the markup shows the degraded hint instead. p77.3 取代原 t3 判定（2026-09-29 的「三类业务在前台恒不可达、故恒返回空串」）。原判定只看到「没有可静态解析的前台深链」，**漏掉了运行期反查**：模块实例归属的页签本就登记在库中，可按「业务类型 → 能力键 → 主责模块包 → 已验证桌面入口 → 模块定义 → 模块实例 → 承载页签」逐环反查，再用当次请求的角色检查确认可达性（见）。命中即产出地址，任一环落空即降级为提示；后台的 admin 映射与这里的普通用户可达性判定互不替代。 admin/workitems.aspx p77.3 supersedes the original t3 verdict (2026-09-29: every kind is unreachable in the front end, so always return an empty string). that verdict saw only that no statically resolvable front-end deep link exists and **missed the runtime reverse lookup**: the tab owning a module instance is already registered in the database, so the chain from business kind to capability key to primary module package to validated desktop entry to module definition to module instance to hosting tab can be walked, and the current request's role check then confirms reachability (see). a full pass yields a url while any failed link degrades to the hint. the admin mapping onand this ordinary-user reachability decision do not substitute for each other. admin/workitems.aspx 待办投影；为或业务类型未知时按降级处理。 null the work-item projection; avalue or an unknown business kind degrades. null 可导航的应用相对地址；不可达时为空串。 a navigable application-relative url, or an empty string when unreachable.

entries.name: Help
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.help help dotnet-type static "help and notes" content module. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.help dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.help portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalmodulecontrol{aspnet.starterkit.portal.help} t:system.web.ui.usercontrol t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.iattributeaccessor t:system.web.ui.inonbindingcontainer t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.iusercontroldesigneraccessor t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalmodulecontrol dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/help/help.ascx.cs csharp 「帮助与说明」静态内容模块。 static "help and notes" content module. 本模块刻意做成**纯静态**：不读取数据库、不读取任何系统设置、不判定授权、不接受请求参数， 因此可以安全地对匿名访客渲染。内容固化在控件标记里，**不提供后台编辑入口**——这是 adr 0027 的边界： 后台可编辑的 html 片段在净化方案落地前不得公开给匿名访客；帮助内容改为随代码发布，从根上消除该 xss 面。 可见性仍由页签的 `accessroles` 决定，本控件不参与授权判断。 this module is deliberately **purely static**: it reads no database, no system setting, performs no authorization decision, and accepts no request parameter, so it can be rendered safely to anonymous visitors. its content is fixed in the control markup with **no administration editing surface** — that is the adr 0027 boundary: administrator-editable html fragments must not be exposed to anonymous visitors before a sanitization decision exists, so help content ships with the code and removes that xss surface entirely. visibility is still governed by the tab's `accessroles`; this control never participates in authorization.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.viewdocument viewdocument dotnet-type compatibility page that emits legacy database document content as an attachment. designer partial container for the document-download page; the page writes the response stream through code-behind and declares no generated fields. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.viewdocument dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.viewdocument portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpage{aspnet.starterkit.portal.viewdocument} t:system.web.ui.page t:system.web.ui.templatecontrol t:system.web.ui.control t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ui.iparseraccessor t:system.web.ui.iurlresolutionservice t:system.web.ui.idatabindingsaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontrolbuilderaccessor t:system.web.ui.icontroldesigneraccessor t:system.web.ui.iexpressionsaccessor t:system.web.ui.inamingcontainer t:system.web.ui.ifilterresolutionservice t:system.web.ihttphandler dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/viewdocument.aspx.cs csharp 以附件方式输出历史数据库文档内容的兼容页面。 文档下载页的 designer partial 容器；页面通过 code-behind 写响应流，不声明生成字段。 compatibility page that emits legacy database document content as an attachment. designer partial container for the document-download page; the page writes the response stream through code-behind and declares no generated fields. 当前不再提供数据库文件上传；本页仅保留已存在内容的下载兼容。它不构成私有文件授权服务， 后续若恢复数据库存储或引入按 tab/模块的下载授权，必须重新设计访问控制和审计边界。 database file upload is currently unavailable; this page retains download compatibility for existing content only. it is not a private-file authorization service. any restored database storage or tab/module download authorization must redesign access-control and audit boundaries.

entries.name: BuildTabDisplayName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopportalbanner.buildtabdisplayname-aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem buildtabdisplayname dotnet-method resolves the tab display name by the current ui culture (chinese column / english column / other-languages json column). protected string aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopportalbanner.buildtabdisplayname(aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem tab) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopportalbanner.buildtabdisplayname-aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopportalbanner t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.desktopportalbanner dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopportalbanner.ascx.cs csharp 按当前界面文化解析页签显示名（中文列 / 英文列 / 其它语言 json 列）。 resolves the tab display name by the current ui culture (chinese column / english column / other-languages json column). 页签名本地化前，这一行就是 `boundtab.tabname`；本地化后必须经解析器，否则英文界面会显示中文页签名。 解析器内部降级到中文列，因此这里不再判空 —— 但**门控键不走本方法**，键仍由 `navigationkey` 派生， 否则"同一个页签在不同语言下键不同"会让 registry 失配。 before tab names were localized this line was simply `boundtab.tabname`; afterwards it must go through the resolver, or an english ui would show chinese tab names. the resolver degrades to the chinese column internally, so no blank check is needed here — but the **gate key never goes through this method**: the key still derives from `navigationkey`, otherwise "the same tab having different keys per language" would break registry matching. 当前绑定的页签。 currently bound tab. 该界面文化下的页签显示名。 tab display name for the current ui culture.

entries.name: Global
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global global dotnet-type asp.net application-lifecycle entry point and request-context composer for the portal. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global portal aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.web.httpapplication t:system.object t:system.componentmodel.icomponent t:system.idisposable t:system.web.ihttpasynchandler t:system.web.ihttphandler t:system.web.irequestcompletednotifier t:system.web.util.isynccontext t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.icontaineraccessor dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 门户 asp.net 应用程序生命周期入口与请求级上下文装配器。 asp.net application-lifecycle entry point and request-context composer for the portal. 本类初始化 unity、外置连接串和运行级服务，并处理请求上下文、认证角色和未处理异常。启动阶段可执行连接可用性探针，请求阶段可撤销过期身份票据并重建角色 cookie；它不是业务授权或配置写入 api。新增全局行为时必须评估启动失败、错误泄漏、身份失效和所有请求的兼容影响。 this class initializes unity, external connection strings, and runtime services, and handles request context, authenticated roles, and unhandled errors. startup may probe connection availability; request processing may revoke stale tickets and rebuild the role cookie. this is not a business-authorization or configuration-write api, so new global behavior must consider startup failure, error disclosure, identity revocation, and compatibility across every request.

entries.name: Application_Start
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_start-system.object-system.eventargs application_start dotnet-method handles application startup and composes configuration, the container, and runtime infrastructure services. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_start(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_start-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 处理应用程序启动事件，并装配配置、容器和运行级基础服务。 handles application startup and composes configuration, the container, and runtime infrastructure services. 该方法会读取配置、注册依赖并触发受控 sql 可用性检查；异常继续沿既有 asp.net 启动失败路径传播。它不执行业务迁移、修复数据或记录连接串秘密，调用方不能把启动完成误解为页面授权已完成。 this method reads configuration, registers dependencies, and performs the existing controlled sql-availability check; exceptions continue through the established asp.net startup-failure path. it does not run business migrations, repair data, or log connection-string secrets, and startup completion must not be treated as page authorization. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: RegisterPasswordPolicyOptionsProvider
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.registerpasswordpolicyoptionsprovider registerpasswordpolicyoptionsprovider dotnet-method connects web-layer runtime system settings to the component-layer password policy. private static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.registerpasswordpolicyoptionsprovider() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.registerpasswordpolicyoptionsprovider portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 把 web 层运行期系统设置接入组件层密码策略。 connects web-layer runtime system settings to the component-layer password policy. 位于独立组件项目，不能反向依赖 web 配置读取器；因此启动期通过委托注入当前有效策略。读取失败时策略类自身会回退到硬下限默认值。 lives in the independent components project and must not depend back on the web configuration resolver, so startup injects a delegate for the effective policy. the policy class falls back to its hard lower-bound defaults if reads fail.

entries.name: RegisterPasswordIterationPolicyProvider
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.registerpassworditerationpolicyprovider registerpassworditerationpolicyprovider dotnet-method registers the password-hash target iteration-count provider. private static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.registerpassworditerationpolicyprovider() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.registerpassworditerationpolicyprovider portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 注入密码哈希目标迭代次数提供器。 registers the password-hash target iteration-count provider. 位于独立组件项目，不能反向依赖 web 配置读取器；因此启动期通过委托注入当前目标迭代次数。读取失败或配置低于硬下限时，策略类自身会回退到硬下限 210000。 lives in the independent components project and must not depend back on the web configuration resolver, so startup injects a delegate for the target iteration count. the policy class falls back to its hard lower bound of 210000 if reads fail or configuration is lower.

entries.name: Application_End
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_end-system.object-system.eventargs application_end dotnet-method handles application shutdown and disposes the unity container. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_end(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_end-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 处理应用程序结束事件，并释放 unity 容器。 handles application shutdown and disposes the unity container. 关闭阶段只释放当前进程持有的 unity 容器；启动失败时容器可能为空，释放操作必须保持幂等且不重新解析服务。 shutdown only releases the unity container held by the current process; startup may have left it null, so disposal must remain idempotent and must not resolve services again. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: BuildItemWithCurrentContext``1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.builditemwithcurrentcontext-1-system.web.ui.control builditemwithcurrentcontext``1 dotnet-method uses the current unity container to perform late dependency injection on an existing web forms control instance. public static void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.builditemwithcurrentcontext<t>(system.web.ui.control ctrl) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.builditemwithcurrentcontext-1-system.web.ui.control portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 用当前 unity 容器为既有 web forms 控件实例执行后期依赖注入。 uses the current unity container to perform late dependency injection on an existing web forms control instance. web forms 通常先由 asp.net 创建页面和控件，再进入项目代码；因此构造函数注入在旧页面里不可用。本方法把 unity 的限定为“补充已注册属性依赖”的兼容入口，不负责创建控件，也不改变控件生命周期。 buildup 该兼容入口假定容器已由启动阶段建立，并把异常和生命周期责任保留给既有 unity/web forms 调用方；它不创建控件、不提供授权判断，也不吞掉未注册依赖错误。 web forms usually lets asp.net create pages and controls before project code runs, so constructor injection is unavailable in legacy pages. this method limits unityto the compatibility role of filling registered property dependencies; it does not create controls or change their lifecycle. buildup this compatibility entry assumes the container was created during startup and leaves exception and lifecycle responsibility with the existing unity/web forms caller; it does not create controls, perform authorization, or hide unregistered-dependency errors. 已由 web forms 生命周期创建的控件实例。 control instance already created by the web forms lifecycle. 控件或页面的实际类型，用于 unity buildup。 actual control or page type used for unity buildup.

entries.name: Application_BeginRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_beginrequest-system.object-system.eventargs application_beginrequest dotnet-method handles the beginrequest event for each request and establishes the current portalsettings and request culture. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_beginrequest(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_beginrequest-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 处理每个请求的 beginrequest 事件，建立当前 portalsettings 与请求文化。 handles the beginrequest event for each request and establishes the current portalsettings and request culture. portalsettings 会写入当前，供同一请求内的页面、控件和组件读取。查询参数只用于选择活动 tab，上下文构造阶段必须使用安全默认值，具体页面再处理非法目标。 httpcontext portalsettings is stored in the currentfor pages, controls, and components in the same request. query parameters select the active tab only; context construction must use safe defaults, and individual pages then handle invalid targets. httpcontext 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: Application_Error
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_error-system.object-system.eventargs application_error dotnet-method handles unhandled application errors, records a diagnostics event id, and redirects to the generic error page according to deployment switches. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_error(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_error-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 处理未捕获的应用程序错误，记录诊断事件编号，并按部署开关转向通用错误页。 handles unhandled application errors, records a diagnostics event id, and redirects to the generic error page according to deployment switches. 通用错误页仅展示符合运行时编号格式的事件 id；详细错误仅能在显式配置且本地请求时保留，不能把异常正文、连接串或其他运行时细节直接返回给普通访问者。 异常先进入诊断净化链，再按通用错误页、显式详细错误开关和本地请求条件决定是否保留 asp.net 详细响应。重定向只携带受控事件编号，不把异常对象或连接串写回响应。 the generic error page displays only event ids matching the runtime format. detailed errors are retained only for explicitly configured local requests; exception bodies, connection strings, and other runtime details must not be returned directly to ordinary visitors. the exception first enters the diagnostic-sanitization path; the handler then decides whether to retain asp.net details based on the generic-error target, the explicit detailed-error switch, and local-request status. redirects carry only a controlled event id and never write the exception object or connection string to the response. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: Application_AuthenticateRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_authenticaterequest-system.object-system.eventargs application_authenticaterequest dotnet-method handles the application's authenticaterequest event and builds a role-bearingfor authenticated requests. protected void aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_authenticaterequest(object sender, system.eventargs e) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global.application_authenticaterequest-system.object-system.eventargs portal aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.global t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.global dotnet hia-document api/portal.hia.json src/portal/global.asax.cs csharp 处理应用程序的 authenticaterequest 事件，为已认证请求构造包含角色的。 handles the application's authenticaterequest event and builds a role-bearingfor authenticated requests. 先校验身份票据中的安全版本是否与数据库一致，再读取加密的cookie；角色 cookie 缺失、过期、无法解密或安全版本不匹配时从数据库读取角色并重建。此方法不创建 hia 用户模型，只维持当前 web forms 请求级身份兼容。 portalroles 安全版本读取失败、返回 0 或与票据不一致时统一撤销当前认证上下文；角色 cookie 只作为可重建的缓存，不是独立授权事实。 the security version in the authentication ticket is validated against the database before the encryptedcookie is read. when the role cookie is missing, expired, undecryptable, or security-version mismatched, roles are loaded from the database and the cookie is rebuilt. this method does not create an hia user model; it maintains current web forms request-identity compatibility. portalroles when the security-version read fails, returns 0, or disagrees with the ticket, revoke the current authentication context uniformly; the role cookie is only a rebuildable cache, not an independent authorization fact. 事件源。 event source. 事件数据。 event data.

entries.name: GetApplicationPath

a non-positive value means the identity is missing and the decision denies directly. 服务端按角色或协同管理员权限计算出的管理员标记；该标记只延续既有集中查看能力，仍受上游权限门禁约束。 administrator flag computed by the server from roles or the collaboration-admin permission; the policy itself never touches a permission collection. added in w72 so the read boundary aligns with the existing write eligibility.

entries.name: CollaborationItemDataScopePolicy
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy collaborationitemdatascopepolicy dotnet-type pure decision policy for collaboration-item data-scope visibility: it answers "is this row visible" only from server-resolved evidence. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/collaborationitemdatascopepolicy.cs csharp 协同事项数据范围可见性的纯决策策略：只依据服务端已解析的证据回答"这条数据是否可见"。 pure decision policy for collaboration-item data-scope visibility: it answers "is this row visible" only from server-resolved evidence. 本类型是 p63.1 数据范围契约的唯一判定入口，供列表与详情共用，保证两条读取路径使用同一规则。判定遵循 fail-closed：证据缺失、身份缺失或范围信息不足时一律拒绝，而不是放行或返回"部分可见"。本策略不读取数据库、不解析配置、不接触 http 上下文，因此可在单测中直接验证。 this type is the single decision entry point of the p63.1 data-scope contract, shared by list and detail reads so both paths use one rule. the decision is fail-closed: missing evidence, missing identity, or insufficient scope information always denies rather than allows or returns a "partially visible" state. the policy reads no database, no configuration, and no http context, so it can be verified directly in unit tests.

entries.name: CanView
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy.canview-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationiteminfo-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascope canview dotnet-method decides whether the current actor may view the specified collaboration item through the ownership, participant, and organization dimensions. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy.canview(aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationiteminfo item, aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascope scope) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy.canview-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationiteminfo-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascope portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdatascopepolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/collaborationitemdatascopepolicy.cs csharp 按归属、参与人和组织三个维度判定当前动作人是否可见指定协同事项。 decides whether the current actor may view the specified collaboration item through the ownership, participant, and organization dimensions. 维度判定顺序为：管理员延续既有集中查看能力 → 归属（发起人或负责人用户）→ **负责人角色键**（w72 新增，与既有写资格对齐）→ 参与人集合 → 组织范围。组织维度要求事项组织单元标识存在且落在可见集合内；事项未标注组织或可见集合为空时该维度不授予可见性。 the dimension order is: administrator continues the existing centralized viewing capability, then ownership (initiator or owner user), then the **owner role key** (added in w72 to align with the existing write eligibility), then the participant set, then the organization scope. the organization dimension requires the item to carry an organization-unit identifier that falls inside the visible collection; an item without an organization unit or an empty visible collection grants nothing through this dimension. 待判定的协同事项投影；为空引用时判定失败。 collaboration-item projection to evaluate; a null reference fails the decision. 服务端解析出的当前动作人数据范围快照；为空引用时判定失败。 server-resolved data-scope snapshot of the current actor; a null reference fails the decision. 任一维度成立时为；证据不足或全部维度不成立时为，且不区分"不存在"与"无权访问"。 true false when any dimension holds;when evidence is insufficient or all dimensions fail, without distinguishing "does not exist" from "not authorized". true false

entries.name: IPortalWorkItemDb
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb iportalworkitemdb dotnet-type data-access contract for the lightweight approval/work-item foundation. interface aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 轻量审批/待办基础的数据访问契约。 data-access contract for the lightweight approval/work-item foundation. p12.3 第一版只负责业务对象到待办记录的最小投影，不实现 bpm、转办、会签或外部通知。该门面不校验业务对象权限，也不与调用方的业务事务形成原子边界；调用方必须先完成授权和领域写入，并把待办失败作为补充能力降级处理。 the first p12.3 version only projects business objects into minimal work-item records; it does not implement bpm, delegation, co-signing, or external notifications. this facade validates neither business-object authorization nor an atomic boundary with the caller's domain transaction. callers must authorize and persist the domain action first, then treat work-item failures as degradation of supplemental capability.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.isschemaavailable isschemaavailable dotnet-method checks whether the current data source can access both the work-item and event tables. bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.isschemaavailable() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.isschemaavailable portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 检查当前数据源能否同时访问待办表和事件表。 checks whether the current data source can access both the work-item and event tables. 返回值是一次可用性探测，不保证随后写入成功，也不证明当前用户有权读取或处理任何业务对象。表缺失、元数据查询失败或连接异常都可表现为。 false the result is a point-in-time availability probe. it guarantees neither a later successful write nor authorization for the current user to read or handle any business object. missing tables, metadata-query failures, and connection failures may all appear as. false 两个表在探测时均可访问为；否则为。 true false when both tables are accessible at probe time; otherwise. true false

entries.name: EnsureWorkItem
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.ensureworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest ensureworkitem dotnet-method creates a work item for a business object or reuses its newest unfinished work item. aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.ensureworkitem(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.ensureworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 为业务对象创建待办，或复用其最新的未完成待办。 creates a work item for a business object or reuses its newest unfinished work item. 调用方仍拥有请求对象；实现可复制、裁剪和补默认值，但不得依赖本方法完成业务授权。复用路径不会承诺刷新既有标题、摘要、指派或到期时间。调用方应根据判断结果，不把可展示消息当作授权或幂等令牌。 the caller retains ownership of the request object. an implementation may copy, trim, and default its values, but this method must not be relied on for business authorization. the reuse path does not promise to refresh an existing title, summary, assignment, or due time. callers should inspectand must not treat its display message as authorization or an idempotency token. 创建参数；当前实现接受空引用并返回失败结果，必填业务键、标题和办理主体由数据层归一化后校验。 creation parameters. the current implementation accepts a null reference and returns a failure result; the data layer normalizes and validates the required business key, title, and assignee. 成功时包含可复用或新建的待办标识；验证、架构或运行失败时返回低敏失败结果。 a low-sensitivity result containing the reused or newly created work-item identifier on success, or a failure for validation, schema, or runtime errors.

entries.name: CompleteBusinessWorkItem
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.completebusinessworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest completebusinessworkitem dotnet-method updates the unfinished work item for a business object to the caller-supplied target status and records an event. aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.completebusinessworkitem(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.completebusinessworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 把业务对象对应的未完成待办更新为调用方指定的目标状态并记录事件。 updates the unfinished work item for a business object to the caller-supplied target status and records an event. 该契约不更新业务对象、不验证状态迁移，也不检查事件类型或目标状态是否来自稳定常量。调用方必须先完成领域动作和授权，并传入受控的与值；重复调用在没有未完成待办时可返回失败。 this contract neither updates the business object, validates a state transition, nor checks that event and target-status values come from the stable constants. callers must first complete and authorize the domain action, then supply controlledandvalues. a repeated call may fail when no unfinished work item remains. 状态更新参数；当前实现接受空引用并返回失败结果，且会复制、裁剪并补齐时间与操作者默认值。 state-update parameters. the current implementation accepts a null reference and returns a failure result, and it copies, trims, and defaults the time and actor values. 成功时包含被更新待办标识；未找到未完成待办、验证、架构或运行失败时返回低敏失败结果。 a low-sensitivity result containing the updated work-item identifier on success, or a failure when no unfinished item is found or validation, schema, or runtime processing fails.

entries.name: GetAdminWorkItems
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.getadminworkitems-system.string-system.int32 getadminworkitems dotnet-method reads a bounded, newest-first query snapshot of administration work items. system.collections.generic.ilist<aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkiteminfo> aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.getadminworkitems(string status, int take) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.getadminworkitems-system.string-system.int32 portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 读取后台待办的有界、最新优先查询快照。 reads a bounded, newest-first query snapshot of administration work items. 本方法不实施后台页面授权；调用方必须先限制访问。返回列表及其 dto 是可变的时间点投影，不自动反映并发更新。当前实现对架构不可用或查询异常返回空列表，因此空列表不能区分“没有数据”和“读取失败”。 this method does not enforce administration-page authorization; callers must restrict access first. the returned list and dtos are mutable point-in-time projections and do not automatically reflect concurrent updates. the current implementation returns an empty list for unavailable schema or query failures, so an empty result cannot distinguish “no data” from “read failure.” 精确状态筛选；空白表示全部。当前实现只裁剪文本，不校验是否为常量。 exact status filter; blank means all statuses. the current implementation only trims the text and does not validate it againstconstants. 期望最大条数；当前实现对非正数使用 50，并把上限限制为 200。 requested maximum row count; the current implementation uses 50 for non-positive values and caps the count at 200. 最新优先的可变待办投影列表；读取失败时也可为空。 a mutable newest-first list of work-item projections, which may also be empty when reading fails.

entries.name: GetWorkItemEvents
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.getworkitemevents-system.int64-system.int32 getworkitemevents dotnet-method reads a newest-occurrence-first event snapshot for the specified work item. system.collections.generic.ilist<aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemeventinfo> aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.getworkitemevents(long workitemid, int take) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb.getworkitemevents-system.int64-system.int32 portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 读取指定待办最近发生优先的事件快照。 reads a newest-occurrence-first event snapshot for the specified work item. 待办标识只用于查询定位，不证明调用方可查看对应业务对象。返回事件是可变历史投影，不能替代当前状态或授权事实。当前实现对非法标识、架构不可用或查询异常均返回空列表。 the work-item identifier is only a query locator and does not prove that the caller may view the associated business object. returned events are mutable historical projections and cannot replace current-state or authorization facts. the current implementation returns an empty list for invalid identifiers, unavailable schema, and query failures. 正数待办标识；非正数返回空列表。 positive work-item identifier; a non-positive value yields an empty list. 期望最大条数；当前实现对非正数使用 20，并把上限限制为 200。 requested maximum row count; the current implementation uses 20 for non-positive values and caps the count at 200. 最近发生优先的可变事件投影列表；非法输入或读取失败时也可为空。 a mutable newest-occurrence-first list of event projections, which may also be empty for invalid input or read failures.

src/portal.components/iportalworkitemdb.cs csharp 读取指派给指定用户或其持有角色键的待办快照，用于前台"我的待办"聚合入口。 reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "my to-do items" aggregation entry. 命中条件为"指派用户标识等于当前用户"或"指派角色键落在传入的受控键集合内"。本契约不解析角色成员关系：键集合必须由调用方用既有授权能力解析后传入，避免数据层越权推导归属。传入的用户标识非正数且键集合为空时按 fail-closed 返回成功但空的结果，不退化成全量查询。结果显式区分"成功且无命中"与"读取失败"，供前台分别呈现空态与失败态。 a row matches when the assigned user identifier equals the current user, or when the assigned role key falls inside the supplied controlled key set. this contract does not resolve role membership: the caller must resolve the key set with existing authorization capability and pass it in, so the data layer never infers ownership beyond its authority. when the supplied user identifier is non-positive and the key set is empty, the method fails closed and returns a successful but empty result instead of degrading to an unrestricted query. the result explicitly separates "succeeded with no matches" from "read failure" so a front end can render empty and failure states separately. 当前门户用户标识；非正数表示不按用户标识命中，此时仅按角色键命中。 the current portal user identifier. a non-positive value disables matching by user identifier, leaving role-key matching only. 当前用户持有的受控角色或权限键集合；可为空引用或空集合。空白项被丢弃，重复项被合并，数量超出实现上限的部分被截断。 the controlled role or permission keys held by the current user. it may be null or empty. blank entries are discarded, duplicates are merged, and entries beyond the implementation cap are truncated. 精确状态筛选；空白表示仅未完成（）。当前实现只裁剪文本，不校验是否为常量。 exact status filter; blank means unfinished items only (). the current implementation only trims the text and does not validate it againstconstants. 期望最大条数；当前实现对非正数使用 50，并把上限限制为 200。 requested maximum row count; the current implementation uses 50 for non-positive values and caps the count at 200. 包含成功标记与最新优先待办投影的查询结果；架构不可用或查询异常时返回失败结果且列表为空。 a query result carrying the success flag and the newest-first work-item projections; unavailable schema or query failures yield a failed result with an empty list.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitSaveRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.organizationunitsaverequest organizationunitsaverequest dotnet-type administration save request for an organization unit. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.organizationunitsaverequest dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.organizationunitsaverequest portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/organizationunitsaverequest.cs csharp 组织单元后台保存请求。 administration save request for an organization unit. `organizationunitid` 为零表示新增。更新时必须携带页面读取到的 `originalupdatedutc`，由数据层执行轻量并发保护。父级存在性、自引用、循环关系和名称必填仍在数据层统一校验。 an `organizationunitid` of zero means creation. updates must carry the `originalupdatedutc` read by the page so the data layer can perform lightweight concurrency protection. parent existence, self-parenting, cycles and required names are still validated centrally by the data layer.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaladministrationpolicy.isprotectedadministrationtabname-system.string-system.string isprotectedadministrationtabname dotnet-method decides whether a tab is the protected core administration tab by its **navigation stable key** (preferred) or display name (fallback). public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaladministrationpolicy.isprotectedadministrationtabname(string tabname, string navigationkey) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaladministrationpolicy.isprotectedadministrationtabname-system.string-system.string portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaladministrationpolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaladministrationpolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portaladministrationpolicy.cs csharp 按**导航稳定键**（优先）或显示名称（回退）判断 tab 是否为受保护的核心后台 tab。 decides whether a tab is the protected core administration tab by its **navigation stable key** (preferred) or display name (fallback). 为什么必须引入稳定键：页签名（`tabname`）已支持多语言，显示名会随界面文化改变甚至被管理员改成中文， 而"后台入口保护""禁止重命名""后台 tab 排到最后"这些策略都按名识别。若继续按显示名判定， 把 admin 改成"后台管理"的那一刻，保护就会静默失效 —— 这正是页签名本地化最危险的连带破坏点。 迁移脚本 `portalcfg_tabmodulemultilingualnames.sql` 已把既有页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署零回归。 why a stable key is required: tab names (`tabname`) are now multilingual, so the display name changes with the ui culture and can even be renamed to chinese by an administrator, while "administration entry protection", "rename blocked", and "keep the administration tab last" all recognize by name. if recognition stayed on the display name, the moment `admin` became "后台管理" the protection would silently stop working — the most dangerous knock-on effect of localizing tab names. migration
