entries.name: PortalDisplayNameResolver
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldisplaynameresolver portaldisplaynameresolver dotnet-type resolves database-carried display names (chinese column / english column / other-languages json column) by ui culture. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldisplaynameresolver dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portaldisplaynameresolver portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portaldisplaynameresolver.cs csharp 按界面文化解析数据库承载的显示名（中文列 / 英文列 / 其它语言 json 列）。 resolves database-carried display names (chinese column / english column / other-languages json column) by ui culture. 存在理由：门户壳层与模块正文走 `app_globalresources/lang.*` 资源，而页签名（`portalcfg_tabs.tabname`）与 模块标题（`portalcfg_modules.moduletitle`）是数据库单列文本，**不随语言切换**，于是同一张卡片里出现 "英文标题 + 中文正文"的中英混排。本解析器把这两类文本接入与资源同源的文化判定，混排才有解。 列设计（用户 2026-10-18 裁定）：中文一列、英文一列、其它所有语言合并为一个 json 列。 中文列复用既有列（`tabname` / `moduletitle`）而不是新增列 —— 既有列 `not null` 且是所有渲染点的默认来源， 复用它才能保证"永远有值可显示"。 解析顺序： 1. 两字母语言码 `zh`（含 zh-cn / zh-tw 等区域变体）→ 中文列，缺失回落英文列； 2. 两字母语言码 `en` → 英文列，缺失回落中文列； 3. 其它文化 → json 列按"完整文化名 → 父文化名 → 两字母码"三级匹配； 4. 三级都未命中 → 回落中文列 → 回落英文列 → 空字符串。 该回退链与既有 `portalnavigationentry.getdisplayname` 的语义一致（中文文化取中文、英文文化取英文、 一侧缺失回落另一侧），避免两套显示名解析逻辑对同一文化给出不同结论。 证明边界：本类型只证明"按文化选出最合适的显示文本"，**不证明**文本本身翻译正确、 json 键是受支持的文化（键名白名单属于语言管理功能），也不做任何授权判断。 reason it exists: the portal shell and module body text come from `app_globalresources/lang.*` resources, while tab names (`portalcfg_tabs.tabname`) and module titles (`portalcfg_modules.moduletitle`) are single-column database text that **does not follow the language switch**, producing "english title + chinese body" inside one card. this resolver connects those texts to the same culture decision the resources use, which is what makes the mixing fixable. column design (user decision, 2026-10-18): one chinese column, one english column, and one json column for every other language. the chinese side reuses the existing columns (`tabname` / `moduletitle`) rather than adding new ones — those columns are `not null` and are the default source of every renderer, so reusing them guarantees there is always something to display. resolution order: 1. two-letter language code `zh` (including zh-cn / zh-tw and other regional variants) → chinese column, falling back to the english column when missing; 2. two-letter code `en` → english column, falling back to the chinese column when missing; 3. any other culture → three-tier json lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code"; 4. no hit → chinese column → english column → empty string. that fallback chain matches the existing `portalnavigationentry.getdisplayname` semantics (chinese cultures take the chinese name, english cultures the english one, and a missing side falls back to the other), so two display-name resolvers cannot disagree about the same culture. proof boundary: this type proves only that "the most suitable display text was selected for the culture". it does **not** prove the text is a correct translation, that json keys are supported cultures (that allowlist belongs to language administration), and it makes no authorization decision.

whether to raise an alarm is the caller's decision based on `diagnostic`. 中文列兼默认回退列的值。 value of the chinese column, which is also the default fallback. 英文列的值。 value of the english column. 其它语言列；以文化名为键的 json 对象文本，可为空。 other-languages column: culture-keyed json object text, may be empty. 目标界面文化；为空时使用当前线程界面文化。 target ui culture; when null the current thread ui culture is used. 降级原因；正常命中或无其它语言可查时为空字符串。调用方可把它写入诊断日志，不应直接显示给用户。 fallback reason; an empty string on a normal hit or when no other languages exist. callers may write it to a diagnostic log but should not show it to users. 可直接显示的文本；全部候选为空时返回空字符串。 text ready to display; entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.buildtabentrykey-system.string buildtabentrykey dotnet-method builds the stable entry key from a portal-configuration tab name; a blank name yields an empty string, meaning there is no tab key to evaluate. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.buildtabentrykey(string tabname) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.buildtabentrykey-system.string portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.cs csharp 由门户配置中的 tab 名构造稳定入口键；空白名返回空字符串，表示没有可判定的 tab 键。 builds the stable entry key from a portal-configuration tab name; a blank name yields an empty string, meaning there is no tab key to evaluate. 门户配置中的 tab 名称。 tab name from portal configuration. 稳定入口键；tab 名为空白时为空字符串。 stable entry key; empty when the tab name is blank.

entries.name: BuildTabEntryKey
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.buildtabentrykey-system.string-system.string buildtabentrykey dotnet-method builds the stable entry key of a main-navigation tab; the **navigation stable key takes precedence**, falling back to the tab display name when absent. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.buildtabentrykey(string tabname, string navigationkey) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.buildtabentrykey-system.string-system.string portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.cs csharp 构造主导航 tab 的稳定入口键；**导航稳定键优先**，缺失时回退到 tab 显示名称。 builds the stable entry key of a main-navigation tab; the **navigation stable key takes precedence**, falling back to the tab display name when absent. 为什么需要稳定键：页签名本地化后，同一页签在不同界面文化下显示名不同（`首页` / `home`）， 管理员还可以把它改成任意文本。若键仍由显示名派生，registry 里登记的 `tab.home` 会在中文界面下失配， 门控静默退化为"未登记即放行" —— 那不是安全的放行，而是**权限检查凭空消失**。 迁移脚本已把存量页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署的 `tab.*` 键逐字节不变。 why a stable key is needed: once tab names are localized, the same tab displays differently per ui culture (`首页` / `home`), and an administrator can rename it to anything. if the key were still derived from the display name, the registered `tab.home` would fail to match under the chinese ui and the gate would silently degrade to "unregistered means allowed" — which is not a safe allow but the **vanishing of a permission check**. the migration backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments keep their `tab.*` keys byte-identical. 门户配置中的 tab 名称，作为稳定键缺失时的回退。 tab name from portal configuration, used as the fallback when the stable key is absent. 导航稳定键；为空时回退到 tab 名称。 navigation stable key; the tab name is used when it is blank. 稳定入口键；tab 名与稳定键均为空白时为空字符串。 stable entry key; empty when both the tab name and the stable key are blank.

entries.name: IsTabGateEnabled
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.istabgateenabled-system.string istabgateenabled dotnet-method parses the raw configuration value of the main-navigation tab gate switch; off is the default and only explicit truthy values enable it. public static bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.istabgateenabled(string configuredvalue) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.istabgateenabled-system.string portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.cs csharp 解析主导航 tab 门控开关的原始配置值；关闭是默认值，只有显式的真值才启用。 parses the raw configuration value of the main-navigation tab gate switch; off is the default and only explicit truthy values enable it. 配置中的开关原始文本；由调用方读取，本策略不访问配置源。 raw switch text from configuration, read by the caller because this policy never touches configuration sources. 显式启用时为；空白或不能识别时为。 true false only for explicit enablement;when blank or unrecognized. true false

entries.name: GetTabBlockedReason
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.gettabblockedreason-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitycontext gettabblockedreason dotnet-method decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; a reason code is returned only when the tab is registered and its dependencies are unsatisfied. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.gettabblockedreason(string tabname, aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitycontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.gettabblockedreason-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitycontext portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.cs csharp 判定门户配置中的 tab 是否被入口 gate 阻断；只有"已登记且依赖不满足"才返回原因码。 decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; a reason code is returned only when the tab is registered and its dependencies are unsatisfied. 本方法刻意采用与动作区相反的失败方向：未登记 tab、空白名或上下文缺失一律**放行**。原因是主导航在调用本方法前已按角色过滤，放行不会泄露超权入口；反之若 gate 故障导致全部 tab 消失，会把"治理增强"变成可用性事故。阻断判定本身仍复用统一的六步可见性判定，不另立规则。 this method deliberately fails in the opposite direction from the action area: an unregistered tab, a blank name, or a missing context is always allowed. the main navigation has already been filtered by role before this call, so allowing cannot leak an over-permissioned entry, whereas losing every tab to a gate fault would turn a governance improvement into an availability incident. the blocking decision itself still reuses the shared six-step visibility evaluation rather than defining new rules. 门户配置中的 tab 名称。 tab name from portal configuration. 当前用户与部署状态；为 null 时按放行处理（见备注）。 current user and deployment state; treated as allowed when null (see remarks). 阻断原因码；放行时为。 null blocked reason code;when the tab is allowed. null

entries.name: GetTabBlockedReason
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.gettabblockedreason-system.string-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitycontext gettabblockedreason dotnet-method decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; the registry lookup uses the **navigation stable key**, falling back to the display name only when it is absent. public static string aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.gettabblockedreason(string tabname, string navigationkey, aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitycontext context) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.gettabblockedreason-system.string-system.string-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitycontext portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalnavigationvisibilitypolicy.cs csharp 判定门户配置中的 tab 是否被入口 gate 阻断；阻断判定按**导航稳定键**查 registry，缺失时才回退到显示名。 decides whether a portal-configuration tab is blocked by the entry gate; the registry lookup uses the **navigation stable key**, falling back to the display name only when it is absent. 本方法刻意采用与动作区相反的失败方向：未登记 tab、空白名或上下文缺失一律**放行**。原因是主导航在调用本方法前已按角色过滤，放行不会泄露超权入口；反之若 gate 故障导致全部 tab 消失，会把"治理增强"变成可用性事故。阻断判定本身仍复用统一的六步可见性判定，不另立规则。 这也解释了为什么必须传稳定键：放行兜底很安全，但"因为显示名本地化导致查不到登记项"而放行，等于让一条治理规则无声消失。 this method deliberately fails in the opposite direction from the action area: an unregistered tab, a blank name, or a missing context is always allowed. the main navigation has already been filtered by role before this call, so allowing cannot leak an over-permissioned entry, whereas losing every tab to a gate fault would turn a governance improvement into an availability incident. the blocking decision itself still reuses the shared six-step visibility evaluation rather than defining new rules. this is also why the stable key must be passed: the allow-fallback is safe, but allowing *because a localized display name missed the registry* silently removes a governance rule. 门户配置中的 tab 名称，作为稳定键缺失时的回退。 tab name from portal configuration, used as the fallback when the stable key is absent. 导航稳定键；为空时回退到 tab 名称。 navigation stable key; the tab name is used when it is blank. 当前用户与部署状态；为 null 时按放行处理（见备注）。 current user and deployment state; treated as allowed when null (see remarks). 阻断原因码；放行时为。 null blocked reason code;when the tab is allowed. null

entries.name: PortalBusinessApplicationTransitions
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalbusinessapplicationtransitions portalbusinessapplicationtransitions dotnet-type the single source of truth for the business-application state machine: action-to-target mapping, legal source statuses, and generation of the administration review sql status predicate. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalbusinessapplicationtransitions dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalbusinessapplicationtransitions portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalbusinessapplicationtransitions.cs csharp 业务申请状态机的**单一事实源**：动作到目标状态、合法来源状态，以及后台审核 sql 状态谓词的生成。 the single source of truth for the business-application state machine: action-to-target mapping, legal source statuses, and generation of the administration review sql status predicate. 与协同事项的同构（`w64` 已建立该判据）。本表刻意**保留既有语义**：approve / return / reject / close 四个审核动作的合法来源都是 `submitted` / `inreview`，与显式化之前的硬编码窗口完全一致；显式化不是改语义，调整 close 的合法来源属独立决策。`resubmit` 为申请人自助动作，来源为 `returned`，目标为 `submitted`，且**不进入**后台审核谓词。 structurally identical tofor collaboration items, following the criterion established in w64. this table deliberately preserves existing semantics: the four review actions approve / return / reject / close all accept `submitted` / `inreview`, exactly matching the hard-coded window that preceded this explicitization. making the table explicit does not change semantics, and adjusting the legal sources of close is a separate decision. `resubmit` is an applicant self-service action from `returned` to `submitted` that deliberately stays out of the administration review predicate.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcollaborationitemtransitions portalcollaborationitemtransitions dotnet-type explicit legal-transition table of the collaboration-item finite-state machine, serving as the single source of truth for status, action, and target status. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcollaborationitemtransitions dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalcollaborationitemtransitions portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalcollaborationitemtransitions.cs csharp 协同事项有限状态机的显式合法迁移表，作为状态/动作/目标状态的单一事实源。 explicit legal-transition table of the collaboration-item finite-state machine, serving as the single source of truth for status, action, and target status. 本类是 p64 状态机显式化的核心：把原先散落在 sql 字符串与if-链中的两份事实收敛成一份可单测的数据。动作到目标状态在当前设计中唯一（即同一动作不论从哪个当前状态出发，目标相同），因此与可由本表派生；数据库写入守卫的 sql 谓词也由生成，避免与表漂移。本类不读取数据库、不依赖 http 上下文，可在单测中直接验证。 mapactiontostatus mapactiontostatus this class is the core of the p64 state-machine explicitization: it collapses the two earlier fact copies—the sql string and theif-chain—into one testable dataset. the action-to-target mapping is unique in the current design (an action always reaches the same target regardless of the source status), soandderive from this table; the sql predicate used as the database write guard is also generated byto avoid drift. the class reads no database and depends on no http context, so it can be verified directly in unit tests. mapactiontostatus mapactiontostatus

entries.name: PortalPasswordPolicy
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpasswordpolicy portalpasswordpolicy dotnet-type portal password-complexity policy for the enterprise user lifecycle registration, account-creation, and password-reset entry points. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpasswordpolicy dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalpasswordpolicy portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalpasswordpolicy.cs csharp 门户密码复杂度策略，用于企业用户生命周期的注册、建号和重置密码入口。 portal password-complexity policy for the enterprise user lifecycle registration, account-creation, and password-reset entry points. 组件层保留 8 位/3 类作为硬下限；web 层可在启动时注入运行期策略选项，让系统管理设置 能控制更高强度的最小长度、类别数量、弱口令字典和账号上下文词限制。此类型不处理历史密码、 失败锁定或客户端加密协议。 the component layer keeps 8 characters / 3 categories as the hard lower bound. the web layer may inject runtime policy options on startup so system settings can control stronger minimum length, category count, weak-password dictionary checks, and account-context-word restrictions. this type does not handle password history, failure lockout, or client-side encryption protocols.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.employeeprofilecorrectionwritebackpolicy employeeprofilecorrectionwritebackpolicy dotnet-type pure-function policy for employee-profile correction write-back: it decides whether a field can be applied automatically and maps the proposed value onto an employee save request. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.employeeprofilecorrectionwritebackpolicy dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.employeeprofilecorrectionwritebackpolicy portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/employeeprofilecorrectionwritebackpolicy.cs csharp 员工资料更正回写的纯函数策略：判定字段是否可自动回写，并把建议值映射到员工保存请求。 pure-function policy for employee-profile correction write-back: it decides whether a field can be applied automatically and maps the proposed value onto an employee save request. 本策略不访问数据库、不依赖会话或权限，只做字段名与值的判定与映射，因此可被单测完整覆盖。设计要点：① 字段名必须由服务端二次校验，不信任调用方传入值；② 只有能直接映射到的低敏字段才允许自动回写；③ 需要另行解析且可能造成错误指派的字段必须显式标记为"需人工处理"，避免"审核通过但未生效"的静默失败。 this policy touches no database and depends on no session or permission; it only judges field names and maps values, so unit tests can cover it completely. design points: (1) field names must be re-validated server-side and caller-supplied values are not trusted; (2) only low-sensitivity fields that map directly ontomay be applied automatically; (3) fields that need extra resolution and could cause a wrong assignment must be explicitly marked as requiring manual handling, so approval never silently fails to take effect.

entries.name: PortalOrganizationTreeExpander
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalorganizationtreeexpander portalorganizationtreeexpander dotnet-type pure-function subtree expander for the organization adjacency list; it touches no database and depends on no session or permission. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalorganizationtreeexpander dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalorganizationtreeexpander portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalorganizationtreeexpander.cs csharp 组织邻接表的纯函数子树展开器，不访问数据库、不依赖会话或权限。 pure-function subtree expander for the organization adjacency list; it touches no database and depends on no session or permission. 把展开做成纯函数是为了让"组织范围"这一安全相关语义可以在没有数据库的环境中被单测覆盖；数据层仍然负责取数、停用过滤与失败处理。展开按广度优先进行，并用深度上限与"已访问"集合双重保护，即使写入侧的防环被绕过也不会无限递归。 expansion is a pure function so that the security-relevant "organization scope" semantics can be unit tested without a database; the data layer still owns retrieval, inactive filtering, and failure handling. expansion is breadth-first with both a depth cap and a visited set, so a malformed cycle cannot cause unbounded recursion even if the write-side cycle guard were bypassed.

entries.name: PortalWorkItemQueryResult
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemqueryresult portalworkitemqueryresult dotnet-type read-only result of a work-item query that distinguishes "zero rows found" from "read failure". class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemqueryresult dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemqueryresult portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalworkitemqueryresult.cs csharp 待办查询的只读结果，用于区分"查到零条"与"读取失败"。 read-only result of a work-item query that distinguishes "zero rows found" from "read failure". 既有待办读取契约把架构缺失与查询异常统一返回空列表，因此空列表无法区分"没有数据"和"读取失败"。本类型把成功标记与投影列表放在一起，使前台能够分别呈现空态与失败态，而不必把异常细节暴露给用户。列表本身仍是可变的时间点投影，不自动反映并发更新。 the established work-item read contracts return an empty list both for unavailable schema and for query failures, so an empty result cannot distinguish "no data" from "read failure". this type pairs a success flag with the projection list so a front end can render empty and failure states separately without exposing exception details to the user. the list itself remains a mutable point-in-time projection and does not automatically reflect concurrent updates.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult portalworkitemresult dotnet-type low-sensitivity result snapshot of a lightweight work-item write. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalworkitemresult.cs csharp 轻量待办写入的低敏结果快照。 low-sensitivity result snapshot of a lightweight work-item write. 该结果把输入验证、架构不可用、未命中和运行异常统一收敛为成功标识与可展示消息；它不携带异常、sql 或授权事实。调用方必须检查，不能仅根据消息或待办标识推断业务动作结果。 the result collapses input validation, unavailable schema, no-match outcomes, and runtime failures into a success flag and display-safe message; it carries no exception, sql, or authorization facts. callers must inspectand must not infer the domain-action result from the message or identifier alone.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemstatuses portalworkitemstatuses dotnet-type stable values for lightweight work-item states. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemstatuses dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemstatuses portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalworkitemstatuses.cs csharp 轻量待办状态的稳定值。 stable values for lightweight work-item states. 待办状态只描述任务处理状态，不替代业务对象自身的领域状态。这里的字符串会写入数据库、审计和文档，不能随意重命名；本类也不定义合法迁移、终态、超期计算或授权规则，调用方必须在领域边界另行执行这些判断。 work-item status describes task handling only and does not replace the business object's domain status. these strings are persisted to the database, audit records, and documentation, so they must not be casually renamed. this class defines neither legal transitions, terminal states, expiration calculation, nor authorization rules; callers must enforce those decisions at the domain boundary.

entries.name: PortalWorkItemTargetResolver
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemtargetresolver portalworkitemtargetresolver dotnet-type resolves a work item's business kind into the hosting tab that the ordinary user may access in the current request. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemtargetresolver dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemtargetresolver portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalworkitemtargetresolver.cs csharp 把待办的业务类型反查为普通用户在**当次请求**下有权限访问的承载页签。 resolves a work item's business kind into the hosting tab that the ordinary user may access in the current request. 反查链：业务类型 → 能力键 → 主责模块包 → 已验证桌面入口 → 模块定义 → 模块实例 → 承载页签 → **角色检查**。链路每一环都可能是"部署未挂载""注册缺失"或"当前用户无权"，因此每一环都返回独立原因码而不是抛错或猜测地址；只有全链通过才产出可导航目标。**不扩权**：解析只读取既有注册与角色事实，不授予任何权限，也不改写模块或页签配置。 reverse lookup chain: business kind to capability key to primary module package to validated desktop entry to module definition to module instance to hosting tab to a role check. every link may fail because the deployment has not mounted the module, the registration is missing, or the current user lacks access, so each link returns its own reason code instead of throwing or guessing a url; only a fully passing chain yields a navigable target. no privilege is widened: resolution reads existing registration and role facts, grants nothing, and rewrites no module or tab configuration.

entries.name: PortalSecurity
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalsecurity portalsecurity dotnet-type provides legacy portal role checks, module-edit decisions, and a historical password-digest helper. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalsecurity dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalsecurity portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iportalsecurity dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/portalsecurity.cs csharp 提供旧门户的角色检查、模块编辑判定和历史密码摘要辅助方法。 provides legacy portal role checks, module-edit decisions, and a historical password-digest helper. 模块编辑必须同时满足父 tab 的访问角色与模块的编辑角色。使用无盐 md5， 仅为既有用户数据兼容保留；新密码体系不得采用该方法，后续迁移需支持旧摘要验证后的渐进强哈希更新。 内部延期项登记（四分法：**可实治范围之外的真实待办**）——判定依据：本项目新密码体系已改用 pbkdf2（见 `portalpasswordhasher`），本条指的是**存量 md5 摘要账号**的渐进升级，属数据迁移而非注释可闭合项，故不在本周期实治。 所有者：密码体系专题（下一 cycle 入口）。再入条件：出现任一即启动 —— ① 需要支持旧摘要账号登录时自动 rehash；② md5 兼容面被要求收敛或下线；③ 安全评审把无盐 md5 列为必须处置项。再入时须先出只读盘点（存量 md5 账号数、登录成功率），再定迁移批次，禁止无盘点直接改写。 module editing requires both parent-tab access roles and module edit roles.uses unsalted md5 and remains only for existing user-data compatibility; new password systems must not use it, and a later migration must support gradual strong-hash updates after legacy-digest verification. internal deferred-item registration (four-way split: **a real work item outside the actionable range**) — basis: this project's new password system already uses pbkdf2 (see `portalpasswordhasher`); this entry concerns the gradual upgrade of **existing md5-digest accounts**, which is a data migration rather than something a comment can close, so it is not remediated in this cycle. owner: the password-system workstream (entry point in the next cycle). re-entry conditions — start when any applies: 1) legacy-digest accounts must be rehashed automatically at sign-in; 2) the md5 compatibility surface is required to shrink or retire; 3) a security review lists unsalted md5 as a must-fix. on re-entry, first produce a read-only inventory (count of md5 accounts, sign-in success rate) before deciding migration batches; never rewrite without that inventory.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEndRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest useremployeebindingendrequest dotnet-type request for ending a current active binding between a portal user and an employee. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingendrequest.cs csharp 结束门户账号与员工当前有效绑定的请求。 request for ending a current active binding between a portal user and an employee. 该对象只描述解绑动作，不承载权限。调用方必须先确认操作者可维护账号员工绑定，并确保解绑不会误删历史关系记录。 this object only describes an unbinding action and does not carry permission. callers must first confirm that the operator may maintain user-employee bindings and ensure the action does not delete historical relationship records by mistake.

entries.name: BindingId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.bindingid bindingid dotnet-property the binding identifier to end. public int aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.bindingid { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.bindingid portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingendrequest.cs csharp 要结束的绑定记录标识。 the binding identifier to end. 数据层会按此标识定位当前有效绑定；不存在或已结束时应返回低敏失败结果。 the data layer uses this identifier to locate the current active binding; missing or already-ended records should produce a low-sensitivity failure result.

entries.name: Reason
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.reason reason dotnet-property non-sensitive unbinding reason. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.reason { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.reason portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingendrequest.cs csharp 非敏感解绑说明。 non-sensitive unbinding reason. 原因会进入审计或后台提示摘要，调用方应避免填入密码、证件号、私人联系方式等敏感信息。 the reason may enter audit records or administration summaries, so callers should avoid passwords, identity numbers, private contact information, and other sensitive content.

entries.name: ActorName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.actorname actorname dotnet-property the operator identifier ending the binding. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.actorname { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest.actorname portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingendrequest dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingendrequest.cs csharp 执行解绑的操作者标识。 the operator identifier ending the binding. 该字段用于审计和历史记录，不作为授权依据；权限必须来自当前请求身份和后台权限判断。 this field is for audit and history only, not authorization; authorization must come from the current request identity and administration permission checks.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingSaveRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest useremployeebindingsaverequest dotnet-type request for creating a current active binding between a portal user and an employee. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingsaverequest.cs csharp 门户账号与员工建立当前有效绑定的请求。 request for creating a current active binding between a portal user and an employee. 该请求只描述“为某个门户账号建立或更新当前有效员工绑定”的意图；账号权限、员工状态、工号唯一性和审计落库由后台服务与数据库层执行。员工号可用于业务识别和可选登录入口，但不是认证凭据；原因字段只允许写低敏说明，不得包含密码、cookie、证件号或其他敏感凭据。 this request only describes the intent to create or update the current active employee binding for one portal account; account authorization, employee status, employee-code uniqueness, and audit persistence are enforced by admin services and the database layer. the employee code can be used for business identification and optional sign-in, but it is not a credential; the reason field is only for low-sensitivity notes and must not contain passwords, cookies, identity numbers, or other sensitive credentials.

entries.name: EmployeeCode
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.employeecode employeecode dotnet-property employee code to bind; it is an enterprise business identifier and may participate in sign-in identifier resolution, but it must not be treated as a password or security token. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.employeecode { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.employeecode portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingsaverequest.cs csharp 要绑定的员工号；它是企业业务标识，也可能参与登录标识解析，但不能被当作密码或安全令牌。 employee code to bind; it is an enterprise business identifier and may participate in sign-in identifier resolution, but it must not be treated as a password or security token.

entries.name: Reason
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.reason reason dotnet-property low-sensitivity binding reason or note entered by the administrator; this field enters the audit context and should explain the change without carrying sensitive information. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.reason { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.reason portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingsaverequest.cs csharp 管理员填写的低敏绑定原因或备注；该字段会进入审计语境，内容应能解释变更原因，但不能承载敏感信息。 low-sensitivity binding reason or note entered by the administrator; this field enters the audit context and should explain the change without carrying sensitive information.

entries.name: ActorName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.actorname actorname dotnet-property display identifier of the administrator performing the binding; it is used only for audit and diagnostics and is not an authorization source. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.actorname { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest.actorname portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.useremployeebindingsaverequest dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/useremployeebindingsaverequest.cs csharp 执行绑定操作的管理员显示标识；它只用于审计与诊断记录，不作为授权判断依据。 display identifier of the administrator performing the binding; it is used only for audit and diagnostics and is not an authorization source.

entries.name: IRoleItem
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem iroleitem dotnet-type contract for a legacy portal role item. interface aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iroleitem.cs csharp 旧门户角色项契约。 contract for a legacy portal role item. 该接口用于后台角色列表、模块编辑角色选择和用户角色分配。角色名称仍为旧角色体系的显示/匹配值； 权限判断应通过统一授权服务或角色解析工具完成，不应只依赖页面局部字符串比较。 this interface is used by administration role lists, module edit-role selectors, and user role assignment. role names remain display/matching values from the legacy role system; authorization should go through shared authorization services or role parsing helpers instead of page-local string comparison alone.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem.portalid portalid dotnet-property portal identifier that owns the role. int aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem.portalid { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem.portalid portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iroleitem.cs csharp 角色所属门户标识。 portal identifier that owns the role.

entries.name: RoleName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem.rolename rolename dotnet-property role name used for display and legacy role-string matching. string aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem.rolename { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem.rolename portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.iroleitem dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/iroleitem.cs csharp 角色名称；用于显示和旧角色字符串匹配。 role name used for display and legacy role-string matching.

entries.name: ITabItem
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem itabitem dotnet-type describes the lightweight base field contract for a portal tab. interface aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/itabitem.cs csharp 描述门户 tab 页签基础字段的轻量契约。 describes the lightweight base field contract for a portal tab. 该接口面向旧后台页签管理和数据读取，不负责解析角色串、加载页面模块或决定主题继承。 this interface targets legacy tab administration and data reads. it does not parse role strings, load page modules, or decide theme inheritance.

entries.name: TabOrder
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-p-aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem.taborder taborder dotnet-property sort value of the tab within its sibling navigation group; null means the save flow may keep its default order. int? aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem.taborder { get; set; } dotnet:p:aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem.taborder portal.components aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.itabitem dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.hia.json src/portal.components/itabitem.cs csharp 页签在同级导航中的排序值；为空时表示保存流程可沿用默认顺序。 sort value of the tab within its sibling navigation group; null means the save flow may keep its default order.

entries.name: TabName

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-t-aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb businessapplicationdb dotnet-type abstract business-application data-access implementation backed by. class aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb dotnet:t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal t:system.object t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.ibusinessapplicationdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/businessapplicationdb.cs csharp 基于的抽象业务申请数据访问实现。 abstract business-application data-access implementation backed by. p19.4 第一版只处理低敏纯文本申请、单层审核状态和流程事件事实；待办投影与运营审计由页面层在业务事实写入成功后旁路记录。本类负责受控 sql 数据访问，不负责当前用户授权，也不把申请事实、待办投影和运营审计扩展为一个跨门面原子事务。 the first p19.4 version handles only low-sensitivity plain-text applications, one-level review states, and workflow-event facts; page code records work-item projections and operation audits after business facts succeed. this class performs controlled sql data access, but it does not authorize the current user or expand application facts, work-item projections, and operation audits into one cross-facade atomic transaction.

entries.name: IsSchemaAvailable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb.isschemaavailable isschemaavailable dotnet-method checks whether both the application and workflow-event tables are accessible. public bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb.isschemaavailable() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb.isschemaavailable portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.businessapplicationdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/businessapplicationdb.cs csharp 检查申请表和流程事件表是否同时可访问。 checks whether both the application and workflow-event tables are accessible. 这是一次可用性探测，不证明后续写入成功，也不执行业务授权；表缺失、元数据查询失败和连接异常均按不可用处理。 this is an availability probe. it guarantees neither a later successful write nor business authorization; missing tables, metadata-query failures, and connection errors are treated as unavailable. 两个受控表均可访问时为，否则为。 true false when both controlled tables are accessible; otherwise. true false

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdb.addcomment-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemcommentcreaterequest addcomment dotnet-method creates a plain-text comment event for a current actor with participation rights without changing item status. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemcommentresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdb.addcomment(aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemcommentcreaterequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdb.addcomment-aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemcommentcreaterequest portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.collaborationitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/collaborationitemdb.cs csharp 为当前有参与权的动作人创建一条不改变事项状态的纯文本评论事件。 creates a plain-text comment event for a current actor with participation rights without changing item status. 评论以独立事件写入，不更新事项事实、当前状态或最近工作流评论投影。管理员可写管理员范围评论；参与者只能写参与者范围评论。 the comment is written as an independent event and does not update the item fact, current status, or latest workflow-comment projection. administrators may write administrator-scope comments; participants may write only participant-scope comments. 评论输入，包含事项、动作人、纯文本内容、可见性范围和可选发生时间；服务端重新校验所有授权相关字段。 comment input containing the item, actor, plain-text content, visibility scope, and optional occurrence time; the server revalidates every authorization-relevant field. 成功时包含事项和新事件标识；校验、授权、schema 或数据库失败时包含可呈现但不泄露内部异常的失败原因。 on success, contains the item and new event identifiers; validation, authorization, schema, or database failures contain a displayable reason without internal exception detail.

entries.name: IsSchemaAvailable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.isschemaavailable isschemaavailable dotnet-method checks whether the current data source can access both the work-item and event tables. public bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.isschemaavailable() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.isschemaavailable portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 检查当前数据源能否同时访问待办表和事件表。 checks whether the current data source can access both the work-item and event tables. 返回值是一次可用性探测，不保证随后写入成功，也不证明当前用户有权读取或处理任何业务对象。表缺失、元数据查询失败或连接异常都可表现为。 false the result is a point-in-time availability probe. it guarantees neither a later successful write nor authorization for the current user to read or handle any business object. missing tables, metadata-query failures, and connection failures may all appear as. false 两个表在探测时均可访问为；否则为。 true false when both tables are accessible at probe time; otherwise. true false

entries.name: EnsureWorkItem
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.ensureworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest ensureworkitem dotnet-method creates a work item for a business object or reuses its newest unfinished work item. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.ensureworkitem(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.ensureworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 为业务对象创建待办，或复用其最新的未完成待办。 creates a work item for a business object or reuses its newest unfinished work item. 调用方仍拥有请求对象；实现可复制、裁剪和补默认值，但不得依赖本方法完成业务授权。复用路径不会承诺刷新既有标题、摘要、指派或到期时间。调用方应根据判断结果，不把可展示消息当作授权或幂等令牌。 the caller retains ownership of the request object. an implementation may copy, trim, and default its values, but this method must not be relied on for business authorization. the reuse path does not promise to refresh an existing title, summary, assignment, or due time. callers should inspectand must not treat its display message as authorization or an idempotency token. 创建参数；当前实现接受空引用并返回失败结果，必填业务键、标题和办理主体由数据层归一化后校验。 creation parameters. the current implementation accepts a null reference and returns a failure result; the data layer normalizes and validates the required business key, title, and assignee. 成功时包含可复用或新建的待办标识；验证、架构或运行失败时返回低敏失败结果。 a low-sensitivity result containing the reused or newly created work-item identifier on success, or a failure for validation, schema, or runtime errors.

entries.name: CompleteBusinessWorkItem
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.completebusinessworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest completebusinessworkitem dotnet-method updates the unfinished work item for a business object to the caller-supplied target status and records an event. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.completebusinessworkitem(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.completebusinessworkitem-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 把业务对象对应的未完成待办更新为调用方指定的目标状态并记录事件。 updates the unfinished work item for a business object to the caller-supplied target status and records an event. 该契约不更新业务对象、不验证状态迁移，也不检查事件类型或目标状态是否来自稳定常量。调用方必须先完成领域动作和授权，并传入受控的与值；重复调用在没有未完成待办时可返回失败。 this contract neither updates the business object, validates a state transition, nor checks that event and target-status values come from the stable constants. callers must first complete and authorize the domain action, then supply controlledandvalues. a repeated call may fail when no unfinished work item remains. 状态更新参数；当前实现接受空引用并返回失败结果，且会复制、裁剪并补齐时间与操作者默认值。 state-update parameters. the current implementation accepts a null reference and returns a failure result, and it copies, trims, and defaults the time and actor values. 成功时包含被更新待办标识；未找到未完成待办、验证、架构或运行失败时返回低敏失败结果。 a low-sensitivity result containing the updated work-item identifier on success, or a failure when no unfinished item is found or validation, schema, or runtime processing fails.

entries.name: GetAdminWorkItems
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getadminworkitems-system.string-system.int32 getadminworkitems dotnet-method reads a bounded, newest-first query snapshot of administration work items. public system.collections.generic.ilist<aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkiteminfo> aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getadminworkitems(string status, int take) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getadminworkitems-system.string-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 读取后台待办的有界、最新优先查询快照。 reads a bounded, newest-first query snapshot of administration work items. 本方法不实施后台页面授权；调用方必须先限制访问。返回列表及其 dto 是可变的时间点投影，不自动反映并发更新。当前实现对架构不可用或查询异常返回空列表，因此空列表不能区分“没有数据”和“读取失败”。 this method does not enforce administration-page authorization; callers must restrict access first. the returned list and dtos are mutable point-in-time projections and do not automatically reflect concurrent updates. the current implementation returns an empty list for unavailable schema or query failures, so an empty result cannot distinguish “no data” from “read failure.” 精确状态筛选；空白表示全部。当前实现只裁剪文本，不校验是否为常量。 exact status filter; blank means all statuses. the current implementation only trims the text and does not validate it againstconstants. 期望最大条数；当前实现对非正数使用 50，并把上限限制为 200。 requested maximum row count; the current implementation uses 50 for non-positive values and caps the count at 200. 最新优先的可变待办投影列表；读取失败时也可为空。 a mutable newest-first list of work-item projections, which may also be empty when reading fails.

entries.name: GetWorkItemsForUser
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getworkitemsforuser-system.int32-system.collections.generic.ienumerable-system.string-system.string-system.int32 getworkitemsforuser dotnet-method reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "my to-do items" aggregation entry. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemqueryresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getworkitemsforuser(int userid, system.collections.generic.ienumerable<string> assignedrolekeys, string status, int take) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getworkitemsforuser-system.int32-system.collections.generic.ienumerable-system.string-system.string-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 读取指派给指定用户或其持有角色键的待办快照，用于前台"我的待办"聚合入口。 reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "my to-do items" aggregation entry. 命中条件为"指派用户标识等于传入用户"或"指派角色键落在传入的受控键集合内"。本方法不解析角色成员关系，键集合由调用方用既有授权能力解析后传入。用户标识非正数且键集合为空时按 fail-closed 返回成功但空的结果，不退化成全量查询。结果显式区分"成功且无命中"与"读取失败"。 a row matches when the assigned user identifier equals the supplied user, or when the assigned role key falls inside the supplied controlled key set. this method does not resolve role membership; the caller resolves the key set with existing authorization capability. when the user identifier is non-positive and the key set is empty, the method fails closed with a successful but empty result instead of degrading to an unrestricted query. the result explicitly separates "succeeded with no matches" from "read failure". 当前门户用户标识；非正数表示不按用户标识命中。 the current portal user identifier; a non-positive value disables matching by user identifier. 当前用户持有的受控角色或权限键集合；可为空。空白项被丢弃，重复项被合并，超出上限的部分被截断。 the controlled role or permission keys held by the current user; may be null. blank entries are discarded, duplicates are merged, and entries beyond the cap are truncated. 精确状态筛选；空白表示仅未完成（）。当前实现只裁剪文本，不校验是否为常量。 exact status filter; blank means unfinished items only (). the current implementation only trims the text and does not validate it against the constants. 期望最大条数；非正数使用 50，上限限制为 200。 requested maximum row count; non-positive values use 50 and the count is capped at 200. 包含成功标记与最新优先待办投影的查询结果；架构不可用或查询异常时返回失败结果且列表为空。 a query result carrying the success flag and the newest-first projections; unavailable schema or query failures yield a failed result with an empty list.

entries.name: GetWorkItemEvents
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getworkitemevents-system.int64-system.int32 getworkitemevents dotnet-method reads a newest-occurrence-first event snapshot for the specified work item. public system.collections.generic.ilist<aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemeventinfo> aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getworkitemevents(long workitemid, int take) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.getworkitemevents-system.int64-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 读取指定待办最近发生优先的事件快照。 reads a newest-occurrence-first event snapshot for the specified work item. 待办标识只用于查询定位，不证明调用方可查看对应业务对象。返回事件是可变历史投影，不能替代当前状态或授权事实。当前实现对非法标识、架构不可用或查询异常均返回空列表。 the work-item identifier is only a query locator and does not prove that the caller may view the associated business object. returned events are mutable historical projections and cannot replace current-state or authorization facts. the current implementation returns an empty list for invalid identifiers, unavailable schema, and query failures. 正数待办标识；非正数返回空列表。 positive work-item identifier; a non-positive value yields an empty list. 期望最大条数；当前实现对非正数使用 20，并把上限限制为 200。 requested maximum row count; the current implementation uses 20 for non-positive values and caps the count at 200. 最近发生优先的可变事件投影列表；非法输入或读取失败时也可为空。 a mutable newest-occurrence-first list of event projections, which may also be empty for invalid input or read failures.

entries.name: HasTable

entries.name: NormalizeCreateRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.normalizecreaterequest-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest normalizecreaterequest dotnet-method normalizes a work-item creation request. private static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.normalizecreaterequest(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.normalizecreaterequest-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcreaterequest portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 标准化审批工作项创建请求。 normalizes a work-item creation request. `"system"` 是**身份缺失时的兜底字面量**，不是真实身份：它只表示"本次创建未记录到具体操作者"， 审计与排查不得据此判定为系统自动执行。该兜底**不替代调用方传递身份的责任** —— 需要可追溯的创建者时调用方必须显式传入，否则审计链在该记录上断掉。 `"system"` is a **fallback literal for a missing identity**, not a real identity: it only means "this creation recorded no specific actor", and audits or troubleshooting must not read it as automatic system execution. the fallback **does not replace the caller's duty to pass identity** — when a traceable creator is required the caller must pass it explicitly, otherwise the audit chain breaks on that record. 调用方提交的原始创建请求，可为空。 the raw creation request from the caller, which may be null. 裁剪长度、补齐默认 utc 时间和系统操作者后的创建请求。 the creation request after trimming lengths and filling default utc time and system actor.

entries.name: NormalizeCompletionRequest
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.normalizecompletionrequest-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest normalizecompletionrequest dotnet-method normalizes a work-item completion request. private static aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.normalizecompletionrequest(aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest request) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb.normalizecompletionrequest-aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemcompletionrequest portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalworkitemdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/portalworkitemdb.cs csharp 标准化审批工作项完成请求。 normalizes a work-item completion request. 调用方提交的原始完成请求，可为空。 the raw completion request from the caller, which may be null. 裁剪长度、补齐默认 utc 时间和系统操作者后的完成请求。 the completion request after trimming lengths and filling default utc time and system actor.

entries.name: UserProfileInfo

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.signin-system.string-system.string signin dotnet-method resolves the sign-in identifier, then validates the submitted password, registration-review status, and p5.2 strong credential. public aspnet.starterkit.portal.portalsigninresult aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.signin(string emailorname, string password) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.signin-system.string-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 解析登录标识并校验输入密码、注册审核状态和 p5.2 强凭据。 resolves the sign-in identifier, then validates the submitted password, registration-review status, and p5.2 strong credential. 方法只返回成功、失败、需重置和安全版本等结果事实，不返回失败原因细节。标识会先归一化并通过解析器处理歧义；profile/注册审核扩展表缺失或读取异常按兼容策略放行，强凭据表可用时优先使用强哈希，存在凭据时禁止回退旧密码列；仅在无该用户强凭据时才允许一次 legacy 兼容升级。调用方仍须负责登录节流、会话/cookie 和页面授权。 the method returns only outcome, reset-required, and security-version facts, not failure details. the identifier is normalized and resolved with ambiguity handling first. missing or unreadable profile/review extension tables follow the compatibility allow path; available strong-credential tables are preferred, and an existing credential forbids fallback to the legacy password column. legacy compatibility upgrade is allowed only when that user has no strong credential. callers remain responsible for throttling, session/cookie issuance, and page authorization. 用户输入的邮箱、登录名称或员工号。 email, sign-in name, or employee code entered by the user. 用户提交的密码输入。 submitted password input. 登录结果；失败时为通用失败对象。 sign-in result; generic failure object on failure.

entries.name: TryUpgradeCredentialCost
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.tryupgradecredentialcost-system.int32-system.string-system.int32-system.nullable-system.datetime-system.nullable-system.datetime tryupgradecredentialcost dotnet-method when a credential's iteration count is below the target cost, rehash it at the new cost inside a transaction while preserving the existing last-verified and legacy-upgraded times. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.tryupgradecredentialcost(int userid, string password, int storediterationcount, system.datetime? lastverifiedutc, system.datetime? legacyupgradedutc) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.tryupgradecredentialcost-system.int32-system.string-system.int32-system.nullable-system.datetime-system.nullable-system.datetime portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 在凭据迭代次数低于目标成本时，于事务内按新成本重哈希，并保留原有的最后验证与 legacy 升级时间。 when a credential's iteration count is below the target cost, rehash it at the new cost inside a transaction while preserving the existing last-verified and legacy-upgraded times. 用户标识。 user identifier. 本次登录已校验通过的明文密码，只在此处交给哈希器。 plain-text password already validated by this sign-in; it is passed to the hasher only here. 凭据中已持久化的迭代次数。 iteration count persisted on the credential. 凭据原有的最后验证时间，必须原样回写。 existing last-verified time of the credential; it must be written back unchanged. 凭据原有的 legacy 升级时间，必须原样回写。 existing legacy-upgraded time of the credential; it must be written back unchanged. 是否实际完成了哈希成本升级。 whether the hashing-cost upgrade was actually performed.

entries.name: Login
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.login-system.string-system.string login dotnet-method sign-in method retained for legacy call sites; new code should prefer. public string aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.login(string emailorname, string password) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.login-system.string-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 兼容旧调用点的登录方法；新代码应优先使用。 sign-in method retained for legacy call sites; new code should prefer. 该兼容入口只把的成功用户名投影为字符串；空字符串同时表示输入失败、账号不可用、密码失败或解析失败，调用方不得依赖原因分类。 this compatibility entry projects only the successful user name from. an empty string represents invalid input, unavailable account, password failure, or resolution failure alike; callers must not depend on a reason classification. 用户输入的邮箱、登录名称或员工号。 email, sign-in name, or employee code entered by the user. 用户提交的密码输入。 submitted password input. 登录成功且允许访问时返回用户名；否则为空字符串。 user name when sign-in succeeds and access is allowed; otherwise an empty string.

entries.name: GetSecurityVersionByUserName
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.getsecurityversionbyusername-system.string getsecurityversionbyusername dotnet-method reads the current security version by user name; returnswhen p5.2 tables are absent. 0 public long aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.getsecurityversionbyusername(string username) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.getsecurityversionbyusername-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 按用户名称读取当前安全版本；缺少 p5.2 表时返回。 0 reads the current security version by user name; returnswhen p5.2 tables are absent. 0 用户登录名称。 user sign-in name. 当前安全版本。 current security version.

entries.name: GetSecurityVersionByUserId
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.getsecurityversionbyuserid-system.int32 getsecurityversionbyuserid dotnet-method reads the current security version by user id; returnswhen p5.2 tables are absent. 0 public long aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.getsecurityversionbyuserid(int userid) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.getsecurityversionbyuserid-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 按用户标识读取当前安全版本；缺少 p5.2 表时返回。 0 reads the current security version by user id; returnswhen p5.2 tables are absent. 0 用户数值标识。 numeric user identifier. 当前安全版本。 current security version.

entries.name: IncrementSecurityVersion
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.incrementsecurityversion-system.int32-system.string incrementsecurityversion dotnet-method increments the security version of the specified user so older auth tickets and role cookies become invalid on the next request. public void aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.incrementsecurityversion(int userid, string reason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.incrementsecurityversion-system.int32-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 递增指定用户的安全版本，使旧身份票据和角色 cookie 在下一次请求失效。 increments the security version of the specified user so older auth tickets and role cookies become invalid on the next request. 用户数值标识。 numeric user identifier. 非敏感变更原因。 non-sensitive change reason.

entries.name: IsLoginAllowed
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.isloginallowed-system.int32 isloginallowed dotnet-method determines whether a user may enter password verification based on registration-review state. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.isloginallowed(int userid) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.isloginallowed-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 按注册审核状态判断用户是否允许进入登录校验。 determines whether a user may enter password verification based on registration-review state. 审核表缺失、用户无审核记录或读取异常沿历史兼容路径放行；该 fail-open 行为只维持迁移兼容，不是强授权保证。 missing review tables, absent user records, and read failures follow the historical compatibility allow path; this fail-open behavior preserves migration compatibility and is not a strong authorization guarantee. 用户数值标识。 the numeric user identifier. 审核状态允许或兼容回退时为。 true when review state allows access or compatibility fallback applies. true

entries.name: IsUserProfileLoginAllowed
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.isuserprofileloginallowed-system.int32 isuserprofileloginallowed dotnet-method determines whether sign-in may continue based on the user's profile status. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.isuserprofileloginallowed(int userid) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.isuserprofileloginallowed-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 按用户 profile 状态判断登录是否可继续。 determines whether sign-in may continue based on the user's profile status. profile 表缺失、状态为空或读取异常按兼容路径放行；只有明确非 active 状态才拒绝。本 helper 不替代认证成功后的页面授权。 missing profile tables, empty status, and read failures follow the compatibility allow path; only an explicit non-active status rejects. this helper does not replace page authorization after authentication. 用户数值标识。 the numeric user identifier. profile 缺失/active/兼容回退时为。 true when the profile is missing, active, or compatibility fallback applies. true

entries.name: UpsertCredential
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.upsertcredential-system.int32-system.string-system.nullable-system.datetime-system.nullable-system.datetime-system.boolean-system.string-system.nullable-system.int32 upsertcredential dotnet-method creates or updates a user's strong-hash credential record. private void aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.upsertcredential(int userid, string password, system.datetime? legacyupgradedutc, system.datetime? lastverifiedutc, bool requiresreset, string resetreason, int? iterationcount = null) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.upsertcredential-system.int32-system.string-system.nullable-system.datetime-system.nullable-system.datetime-system.boolean-system.string-system.nullable-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 创建或更新用户的强哈希凭据记录。 creates or updates a user's strong-hash credential record. 要求凭据和安全状态表同时存在；密码只传给哈希器，持久化哈希、盐、格式和迭代次数，不保存明文。调用方负责在适当事务中提交上下文。 requires both credential and security-state tables. the password is passed only to the hasher; persisted fields are hash, salt, format, and iteration count, never plaintext. the caller is responsible for committing the context in the appropriate transaction.

entries.name: MarkCredentialVerified
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.markcredentialverified-system.int32 markcredentialverified dotnet-method updates the last-verified utc time for a strong credential. private void aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.markcredentialverified(int userid) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.markcredentialverified-system.int32 portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 更新强凭据的最后验证 utc 时间。 updates the last-verified utc time for a strong credential. 凭据表缺失时不执行写入；该记录只用于运维/安全追踪，不改变认证结果或安全版本。 no write occurs when the credential table is absent; the field is for operational/security tracking and does not change authentication outcome or security version.

entries.name: EnsureSecurityState
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.ensuresecuritystate-system.int32-system.string ensuresecuritystate dotnet-method idempotently ensures the user's initial security-version state. private void aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.ensuresecuritystate(int userid, string reason) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.ensuresecuritystate-system.int32-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 幂等补齐用户初始安全版本状态。 idempotently ensures the user's initial security-version state. 仅对正数用户且状态表存在时执行；插入仍以 portal 用户存在为条件，重复调用不覆盖现有版本。 executes only for a positive user identifier when the state table exists; insertion also requires the portal user to exist, and repeated calls do not overwrite an existing version.

entries.name: VerifyLegacyPassword
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.verifylegacypassword-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useritem-system.string verifylegacypassword dotnet-method compares a legacy password digest for a user who has not yet established a strong credential. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.verifylegacypassword(aspnet.starterkit.portal.useritem item, string password) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.verifylegacypassword-aspnet.starterkit.portal.useritem-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 对尚未建立强凭据的旧用户执行一次 legacy 密码摘要比较。 compares a legacy password digest for a user who has not yet established a strong credential. 调用方必须先确认不存在强凭据；空用户、空旧摘要或比较失败均返回 false。该路径只为迁移兼容，不应作为新用户凭据存储方式。 the caller must establish that no strong credential exists first; a null user, empty legacy digest, or mismatch returns false. this path exists only for migration compatibility and must not be used as new-user credential storage.

entries.name: HasCredentialTables
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hascredentialtables hascredentialtables dotnet-method checks whether both strong-credential and security-state tables are available. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hascredentialtables() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hascredentialtables portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 检查强凭据表和安全状态表是否同时可用。 checks whether both strong-credential and security-state tables are available.

entries.name: HasCredentialTable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hascredentialtable hascredentialtable dotnet-method checks whether the strong-credential table is available. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hascredentialtable() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hascredentialtable portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 检查强凭据表是否可用。 checks whether the strong-credential table is available.

entries.name: HasSecurityStateTable

entries.name: HasUserProfileTable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hasuserprofiletable hasuserprofiletable dotnet-method checks whether the user-profile extension table is available. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hasuserprofiletable() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hasuserprofiletable portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 检查用户 profile 扩展表是否可用。 checks whether the user-profile extension table is available.

entries.name: HasEmployeeCodeSignInTables
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hasemployeecodesignintables hasemployeecodesignintables dotnet-method checks whether both employee and binding tables required for employee-code sign-in are available. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hasemployeecodesignintables() dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hasemployeecodesignintables portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 检查员工号登录所需的员工和绑定表是否同时可用。 checks whether both employee and binding tables required for employee-code sign-in are available.

entries.name: HasTable
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hastable-system.string hastable dotnet-method checks whether a controlled security-database table exists. private bool aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hastable(string tablename) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.hastable-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 检查受控安全数据库表是否存在。 checks whether a controlled security-database table exists. 只能来自本类固定表名常量或固定注册表名。 a name that must come from fixed table constants or fixed registration-table names in this class. 表可访问时为；元数据异常时为。 true false when the table is accessible;on metadata errors. true false

entries.name: BuildPasswordPolicyContextTerms
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnet-m-aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.buildpasswordpolicycontextterms-system.string buildpasswordpolicycontextterms dotnet-method provides account-related context terms for password policy checks; callers must not log the returned values. private static string[] aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.buildpasswordpolicycontextterms(params string[] terms) dotnet:m:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb.buildpasswordpolicycontextterms-system.string portal.components.data1 aspnet.starterkit.portal aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb t:aspnet.starterkit.portal.usersdb dotnet hia-document api/portal.components.data1.hia.json src/portal.components.data1/usersdb.cs csharp 为密码策略提供账号相关上下文词；调用方不得记录返回值。 provides account-related context terms for password policy checks; callers must not log the returned values. 用户名、邮箱、员工号、显示名等候选词。 candidate user name, email, employee code, display name, and similar terms. 供策略层只读使用的上下文词数组。 context-term array for read-only policy checks.

entries.name: AccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-accessdenied.aspx-1 accessdenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the static access-denied page uses a themed message block instead of the old fixed-width table. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-accessdenied.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/accessdenied.aspx aspx 静态拒绝访问页采用主题化消息块，避免继续使用旧固定宽度表格。 the static access-denied page uses a themed message block instead of the old fixed-width table.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-diagnosticlogdetail.aspx-1 diagnosticlogdetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p2.4 diagnostic log detail page queries sanitized entries only by event id and does not accept log file paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-diagnosticlogdetail.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/diagnosticlogdetail.aspx aspx p2.4 诊断日志详情页仅按事件编号查询已净化记录，不接受日志文件路径。 the p2.4 diagnostic log detail page queries sanitized entries only by event id and does not accept log file paths.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 2

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 3

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-diagnosticlogdetail.aspx-4 diagnosticlogdetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the detail table presents only fields authorized and sanitized by code-behind; the markup accepts no path or file input beyond the event-id route, and server code remains responsible for sensitive-field redaction. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-diagnosticlogdetail.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/diagnosticlogdetail.aspx aspx 详情表只呈现 code-behind 已授权并净化后的字段；标记层不接收事件编号以外的路径或文件输入，敏感字段的裁剪仍由服务端职责负责。 the detail table presents only fields authorized and sanitized by code-behind; the markup accepts no path or file input beyond the event-id route, and server code remains responsible for sensitive-field redaction.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-diagnosticlogdetail.aspx-5 diagnosticlogdetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment render exception detail in a read-only multiline control; it provides no edit-back capability and does not resubmit exception text as user input. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-diagnosticlogdetail.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/diagnosticlogdetail.aspx aspx 异常详情使用只读多行控件承载展示，不提供回发编辑能力，也不把异常文本重新作为用户输入提交。 render exception detail in a read-only multiline control; it provides no edit-back capability and does not resubmit exception text as user input.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 1

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 3

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
