entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-diagnosticslogs.aspx-5 diagnosticslogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the repeater renders constrained diagnostic entries read-only; `<%#: ... %>` encodes text bindings, and detail links are produced by getdetailurl rather than concatenated in markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-diagnosticslogs.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/diagnosticslogs.aspx aspx repeater 只读展示受限诊断条目；`<%#: ... %>` 负责编码文本绑定，详情链接统一经过 getdetailurl 生成，不在标记层拼接路径。 the repeater renders constrained diagnostic entries read-only; `<%#: ... %>` encodes text bindings, and detail links are produced by getdetailurl rather than concatenated in markup.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-diagnosticslogs.aspx-6 diagnosticslogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment p81.3 空态：仅在"查询成功且零条"时渲染；输入无效分支由代码后置把计数置为 null 抑制，避免把错误说成"暂无日志"。 dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-diagnosticslogs.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/diagnosticslogs.aspx aspx

entries.name: EditAccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-editaccessdenied.aspx-1 editaccessdenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the edit-access-denied page reuses the shared message block while preserving the existing resource text. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-editaccessdenied.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/editaccessdenied.aspx aspx 编辑权限拒绝页复用统一消息块，并保留原有资源文案。 the edit-access-denied page reuses the shared message block while preserving the existing resource text.

entries.name: EditAccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-editaccessdenied.aspx-2 editaccessdenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the edit-denied page reuses resource-based title and explanation, presenting the server-confirmed edit result without disclosing extra details about the protected object. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-editaccessdenied.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/editaccessdenied.aspx aspx 编辑拒绝页复用资源化标题和说明，只呈现服务器确认的编辑权限结果，不泄露被保护对象的额外信息。 the edit-denied page reuses resource-based title and explanation, presenting the server-confirmed edit result without disclosing extra details about the protected object.

entries.name: EditAccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-editaccessdenied.aspx-3 editaccessdenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the portal return link provides only a safe exit path; any later edit attempt remains subject to server checks on the target page. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-editaccessdenied.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/editaccessdenied.aspx aspx 返回门户链接只提供安全的离开路径；是否允许再次进入编辑流程仍由目标页服务器校验。 the portal return link provides only a safe exit path; any later edit attempt remains subject to server checks on the target page.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-1 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p6.3-s4 employee and organization directory list is read-only; creation and editing are handled by dedicated maintenance pages. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx p6.3-s4 员工组织目录页的列表本身只读，新增和编辑交给独立维护页处理。 the p6.3-s4 employee and organization directory list is read-only; creation and editing are handled by dedicated maintenance pages.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-2 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the employee directory page only rebuilds the presentation shell; data reads, creation, and edit entry behavior remain unchanged. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx 员工目录页只重构展示壳，数据读取、新增和编辑入口保持既有行为。 the employee directory page only rebuilds the presentation shell; data reads, creation, and edit entry behavior remain unchanged.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-3 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment page-owned navigation entries: this page deliberately aggregates cross-group entries - system health belongs to admin.ops, user administration to admin.account, and the rest to admin.capability. the renderer is group-scoped and expresses only same-group entries, so it cannot cover these cross-group links and the block stays in the page, localized only. new organization unit, new employee, and bind user/employee are also this page's maintenance actions. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx 页面自有导航入口：本页刻意汇集跨族入口——system health 属 admin.ops 族、user administration 属 admin.account 族，其余属 admin.capability 族；渲染器按族输出、只表达同族入口，无法覆盖这些跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。其中新建组织单元、新建员工、绑定用户／员工同时是本页的维护动作入口。 page-owned navigation entries: this page deliberately aggregates cross-group entries - system health belongs to admin.ops, user administration to admin.account, and the rest to admin.capability. the renderer is group-scoped and expresses only same-group entries, so it cannot cover these cross-group links and the block stays in the page, localized only. new organization unit, new employee, and bind user/employee are also this page's maintenance actions.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-4 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment these filters only construct directory query criteria; the server still normalizes keyword, employee status, binding status, and inactive-organization choices before deciding visible results. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx 筛选字段只构造目录查询条件；关键字、员工状态、绑定状态和停用组织选项仍由服务器规范化并决定可见结果。 these filters only construct directory query criteria; the server still normalizes keyword, employee status, binding status, and inactive-organization choices before deciding visible results.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-5 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment organization rows use encoded read-only bindings and link to server-generated edit urls; the table does not infer organization permissions or relationships on its own. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx 组织行使用编码绑定的只读字段，并把编辑入口指向服务器生成的 url；页面不在表格中自行推断组织权限或关系。 organization rows use encoded read-only bindings and link to server-generated edit urls; the table does not infer organization permissions or relationships on its own.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-6 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment p74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-7 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment employee rows expose edit and binding entries, with binding urls generated only for employee records; encoded output and operation authorization remain owned by the server model and code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx 员工行同时提供编辑和绑定入口，绑定 url 只针对员工记录生成；编码输出与操作授权仍由服务器端模型和 code-behind 负责。 employee rows expose edit and binding entries, with binding urls generated only for employee records; encoded output and operation authorization remain owned by the server model and code-behind.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-8 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 8 dotnet-markup-comment user-employee binding is exposed from employee rows to avoid organization rows referencing a binding url that does not exist. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:8 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx 员工账号绑定以员工行为入口，避免组织行误引用不存在的绑定地址。 user-employee binding is exposed from employee rows to avoid organization rows referencing a binding url that does not exist.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 9
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-9 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 9 dotnet-markup-comment p74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:9 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 10
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx-10 employeedirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 10 dotnet-markup-comment p74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeedirectory.aspx:10 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeedirectory.aspx aspx

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeedit.aspx-1 employeeedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p6.3-s4 minimal employee master-data page does not provide account binding, employee-code login enablement, import, export, or sensitive personal-profile fields. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeedit.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeedit.aspx aspx p6.3-s4 员工主数据最小维护页不提供账号绑定、工号登录启用、导入、导出或敏感个人资料字段。 the p6.3-s4 minimal employee master-data page does not provide account binding, employee-code login enablement, import, export, or sensitive personal-profile fields.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeedit.aspx-4 employeeedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment maxlength on employee fields is only an input ceiling; the server still validates code uniqueness, email format, organization/status combinations, date relationships, and source-system policy. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeedit.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeedit.aspx aspx 员工资料控件的 maxlength 只是输入上限；员工代码唯一性、邮箱格式、组织/状态组合、日期关系和来源系统策略仍由服务端校验。 maxlength on employee fields is only an input ceiling; the server still validates code uniqueness, email format, organization/status combinations, date relationships, and source-system policy.

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx-3 employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment page-owned navigation entries: operation audits belongs to admin.ops while this page belongs to admin.capability. the group-scoped renderer expresses only same-group entries and cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx aspx 页面自有导航入口：operation audits 属 admin.ops 族，而本页入口属 admin.capability 族；渲染器按族输出、只表达同族入口，无法表达该跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。 page-owned navigation entries: operation audits belongs to admin.ops while this page belongs to admin.capability. the group-scoped renderer expresses only same-group entries and cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx-4 employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the status filter expresses only review-list query intent; searchbutton_click remains responsible for parsing, page size, authorization, and empty-result handling. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx aspx 状态筛选只表达审核列表的查询意图；状态值解析、页大小、授权和空结果处理仍由 searchbutton_click 的服务端职责负责。 the status filter expresses only review-list query intent; searchbutton_click remains responsible for parsing, page size, authorization, and empty-result handling.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx-5 employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the repeater renders current, proposed, and review text read-only with encoded bindings so request content is not executed as markup; the server must revalidate request id and status commands. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx aspx repeater 只读呈现当前值、提议值和审核文本，使用编码绑定避免把申请内容当作标记执行；请求编号和状态命令仍需服务端重新校验。 the repeater renders current, proposed, and review text read-only with encoded bindings so request content is not executed as markup; the server must revalidate request id and status commands.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx-6 employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the review note has a length limit but remains administrator input; code-behind validates state transition, request ownership, audit events, and the master-data side-channel rule. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx aspx 审核备注有长度上限但仍是管理员输入；状态转换、请求归属、审计事件和主数据旁路规则由 code-behind 校验。 the review note has a length limit but remains administrator input; code-behind validates state transition, request ownership, audit events, and the master-data side-channel rule.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx-7 employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment p74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row whose wording depends on whether a filter is active (this page preselects the submitted status, so its default view is already filtered); failure paths suppress it by passing a null count so it cannot contradict the error message. the column count (8) matches this table's header. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/employeeprofilecorrectionrequests.aspx aspx p74.3 空态：零条时在表尾渲染"表头 + 提示行"，文案按是否处于筛选态区分（本页默认选中"已提交"，故默认即筛选态）；失败路径由 emptystaterowcount 为 null 抑制，避免与错误提示矛盾。列数（8）与本表表头一致。 p74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row whose wording depends on whether a filter is active (this page preselects the submitted status, so its default view is already filtered); failure paths suppress it by passing a null count so it cannot contradict the error message. the column count (8) matches this table's header.

entries.name: Logoff.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-logoff.aspx-1 logoff.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the logoff page is hosted by the master page but declares no visible server controls; the actual sign-out action is completed by the code-behind during the page lifecycle. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-logoff.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/logoff.aspx aspx 注销页通过母版页承载，但页面自身不声明可见服务器控件；实际退出动作由 code-behind 在页面生命周期内完成。 the logoff page is hosted by the master page but declares no visible server controls; the actual sign-out action is completed by the code-behind during the page lifecycle.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 1

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-2 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the manage-user page only rearranges presentation structure; account updates, registration review, lifecycle commands, and role commands remain controlled by code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx 管理用户页只重排展示结构，账号更新、注册审核、生命周期和角色命令仍由 code-behind 控制。 the manage-user page only rearranges presentation structure; account updates, registration review, lifecycle commands, and role commands remain controlled by code-behind.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 3

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-4 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the p2.3 registration-review status area displays the current state and exposes only minimal approve/reject actions. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx p2.3 注册审核状态区域只展示当前状态，并提供最小批准/拒绝动作。 the p2.3 registration-review status area displays the current state and exposes only minimal approve/reject actions.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 5

entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-6 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the account-status card shows disable/restore buttons only after server authorization; the disable action keeps a browser confirmation, which never replaces server authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx 账号状态卡片仅在服务端授权后显示禁用/恢复按钮；禁用动作额外保留浏览器确认，但确认不替代服务端授权。 the account-status card shows disable/restore buttons only after server authorization; the disable action keeps a browser confirmation, which never replaces server authorization.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 7

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 9

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 12
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-12 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 12 dotnet-markup-comment the email field may serve as contact information or one login identifier input; final resolution remains controlled by the authentication service. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:12 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx 邮箱字段可作为联系信息或登录标识输入之一，最终解析仍由认证服务控制。 the email field may serve as contact information or one login identifier input; final resolution remains controlled by the authentication service.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 13

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 14
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-14 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 14 dotnet-markup-comment the confirm-password field supports client/server consistency validation and is also submitted with a hidden encrypted field. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:14 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx 确认密码字段用于前后台一致性校验，并同样配合隐藏加密字段提交。 the confirm-password field supports client/server consistency validation and is also submitted with a hidden encrypted field.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 15
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-15 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 15 dotnet-markup-comment the role-membership section carries selected roles and current members through postback commands; code-behind rechecks role identity, duplication, authorization, and audit requirements before writing. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:15 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx 角色成员区将可选角色和当前成员作为回发命令载体；角色身份、去重、授权和审计仍由 code-behind 在写入前重新判断。 the role-membership section carries selected roles and current members through postback commands; code-behind rechecks role identity, duplication, authorization, and audit requirements before writing.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 16
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx-16 manageusers.aspx webforms-server-comment 16 dotnet-markup-comment the role name binds with **`<%#:`** (with colon) rather than `<%#`: the former html-encodes before emitting, which is the
  xss baseline for controllable data such as role names — do not regress it to `<%#`. the delete button carries no
  `commandargument`; the role to remove is recovered via the datalist's `datakeyfield="roleid"` in `onitemcommand`, i.e.
  "which row" comes from the datakey and the markup holds no row identifier. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-manageusers.aspx:16 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/manageusers.aspx aspx 角色名用 **`<%#:`**（冒号）而非 `<%#` 绑定：前者会先做 html 编码再输出，是角色名这类可控数据的 xss 防护基线，
  改动时不得退化成 `<%#`。删除按钮不带 `commandargument`，要移除的角色由 `datalist` 的 `datakeyfield="roleid"`
  经 `onitemcommand` 取回 —— 即"删哪一行"由 datakey 决定，标记层不含行标识。 the role name binds with **`<%#:`** (with colon) rather than `<%#`: the former html-encodes before emitting, which is the
  xss baseline for controllable data such as role names — do not regress it to `<%#`. the delete button carries no
  `commandargument`; the role to remove is recovered via the datalist's `datakeyfield="roleid"` in `onitemcommand`, i.e.
  "which row" comes from the datakey and the markup holds no row identifier.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 1

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 2

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 3

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx-1 moduledefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the legacy module-definition page only maintains names and protected deletion; source-path fields keep their read-only safety boundary. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefinitions.aspx aspx 历史模块定义页只维护名称和受保护删除，路径字段保持只读安全边界。 the legacy module-definition page only maintains names and protected deletion; source-path fields keep their read-only safety boundary.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx-2 moduledefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the definition form edits only the friendly name; desktop/mobile source paths remain read-only safety boundaries and the server validates trusted relative ascx paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefinitions.aspx aspx 定义表单只允许友好名称编辑；桌面/移动源路径保持只读安全边界，并由服务器验证受信相对 ascx 路径。 the definition form edits only the friendly name; desktop/mobile source paths remain read-only safety boundaries and the server validates trusted relative ascx paths.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx-3 moduledefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment customvalidator only invokes the server path rule from markup; client-side validation is not treated as path trust or authorization proof. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefinitions.aspx aspx customvalidator 只是触发服务器路径规则的标记入口；它不把客户端校验视为路径信任或授权证明。 customvalidator only invokes the server path rule from markup; client-side validation is not treated as path trust or authorization proof.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx-4 moduledefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment update, cancel, and delete buttons submit only command intent; code-behind decides definition identity, instance references, trusted paths, delete protection, and auditing. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefinitions.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefinitions.aspx aspx 更新、取消和删除按钮只发送命令意图；定义身份、实例引用、受信路径、删除保护和审计仍由 code-behind 决定。 update, cancel, and delete buttons submit only command intent; code-behind decides definition identity, instance references, trusted paths, delete protection, and auditing.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx-1 moduledefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the legacy bridge entry only lists existing definitions and routes users to the trusted module catalog; online manual path entry is not restored. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefs.ascx ascx legacy 桥接入口只展示既有定义并引导到受信任模块目录，不恢复在线手填路径。 the legacy bridge entry only lists existing definitions and routes users to the trusted module catalog; online manual path entry is not restored.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx-2 moduledefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment this entry routes only to the trusted module catalog; the legacy control does not expose high-risk definition-path or assembly inputs. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefs.ascx ascx 此入口只转到受信任的模块目录；不在旧控件中开放定义路径或程序集等高风险输入。 this entry routes only to the trusted module catalog; the legacy control does not expose high-risk definition-path or assembly inputs.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx-3 moduledefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the datalist keeps moduledefid as the command key and retains server events; the display name uses encoded binding so definition metadata is not emitted as markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefs.ascx ascx datalist 使用 moduledefid 作为命令键并保留服务器事件，展示名称采用编码绑定以避免把定义元数据当作标记输出。 the datalist keeps moduledefid as the command key and retains server events; the display name uses encoded binding so definition metadata is not emitted as markup.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx-4 moduledefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment each item exposes only an encoded friendly name and an edit command; definition loading, authorization, and persistence remain decided by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-moduledefs.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/moduledefs.ascx ascx 每个条目仅提供受编码的友好名称和编辑命令，实际定义读取、授权与保存仍由 code-behind 决定。 each item exposes only an encoded friendly name and an edit command; definition loading, authorization, and persistence remain decided by the code-behind.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx-1 modulesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the module-instance settings page only rebuilds the presentation shell and form grouping; instance ownership checks, editor-role persistence, cache-policy writes, and auditing remain controlled by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/modulesettings.aspx aspx 模块实例设置页只重构展示壳和表单分组，实例归属校验、编辑角色保存、缓存策略写入和审计仍由 code-behind 控制。 the module-instance settings page only rebuilds the presentation shell and form grouping; instance ownership checks, editor-role persistence, cache-policy writes, and auditing remain controlled by the code-behind.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx-2 modulesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment page-owned navigation entries: employee directory belongs to admin.capability while this page belongs to admin.modules; the group-scoped renderer cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/modulesettings.aspx aspx 页面自有导航入口：employee directory 属 admin.capability 族，而本页入口属 admin.modules 族；渲染器按族输出、无法表达该跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。 page-owned navigation entries: employee directory belongs to admin.capability while this page belongs to admin.modules; the group-scoped renderer cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx-3 modulesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment instance metadata inputs express only title, seconds, and mobile-compatibility intent; code-behind validates instance ownership, ranges, cache units, and legal values. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/modulesettings.aspx aspx 实例元数据输入只表达标题、秒数和移动兼容意图；实例归属、范围、缓存单位和合法值仍由 code-behind 校验。 instance metadata inputs express only title, seconds, and mobile-compatibility intent; code-behind validates instance ownership, ranges, cache units, and legal values.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx-4 modulesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment module-title multilingual area: the chinese title is the `moduletitle` field above (chinese column and default fallback); only the english column and the "other languages" json column are added here, and both are written only when an administrator fills them in explicitly. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/modulesettings.aspx aspx 模块标题多语言区：中文标题就是上面的 `moduletitle`（中文列兼默认回退列），
    这里只补英文列与"其它语言" json 列，两个字段都只在管理员显式填写时才写入。 module-title multilingual area: the chinese title is the `moduletitle` field above (chinese column and default fallback); only the english column and the "other languages" json column are added here, and both are written only when an administrator fills them in explicitly.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx-5 modulesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the editor-role list only renders selectable role keys; the server rechecks instance membership, write permission, and change auditing. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/modulesettings.aspx aspx 编辑角色列表只呈现可选角色键；角色是否属于当前实例、是否允许写入以及变更审计仍由服务端重新判断。 the editor-role list only renders selectable role keys; the server rechecks instance membership, write permission, and change auditing.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx-6 modulesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the apply button submits the complete module-settings set; applychanges_click owns the transaction, editor-role authorization, cache-policy write, and audit event. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-modulesettings.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/modulesettings.aspx aspx 应用按钮提交整组模块设置，事务、编辑角色授权、缓存策略写入和审计事件均由 applychanges_click 负责。 the apply button submits the complete module-settings set; applychanges_click owns the transaction, editor-role authorization, cache-policy write, and audit event.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx-1 notimplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the not-implemented sample-link page now uses the unified message card as a low-risk landing page for sample-data links; after dynamic theme switching it no longer uses the old outputcache, avoiding cached wrong themes. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/notimplemented.aspx aspx 未实现示例链接页改为统一提示卡，用于样例数据链接的低风险落地页；动态主题切换后不再使用旧 outputcache，避免缓存错误主题。 the not-implemented sample-link page now uses the unified message card as a low-risk landing page for sample-data links; after dynamic theme switching it no longer uses the old outputcache, avoiding cached wrong themes.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx-2 notimplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the server control keeps the title as the sample landing-page identifier; this page does not load an unimplemented module or execute a business command carried by the link. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/notimplemented.aspx aspx 标题由服务器控件保留为样例落地页标识；该页不加载未实现模块，也不执行链接携带的业务命令。 the server control keeps the title as the sample landing-page identifier; this page does not load an unimplemented module or execute a business command carried by the link.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx-3 notimplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the title element is server-controlled and its default text is written by code-behind from resources; a code block must not be placed here, otherwise setting innertext throws because the contents are not literal. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/notimplemented.aspx aspx 标题元素由服务器控制，默认标题由 code-behind 从资源写入；此处不能放代码块，否则设置 innertext 会因"内容非字面"而抛异常。 the title element is server-controlled and its default text is written by code-behind from resources; a code block must not be placed here, otherwise setting innertext throws because the contents are not literal.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx-4 notimplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the body only explains that sample-linked content is not provided, keeping a static-information boundary rather than treating sample data as an available business resource. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/notimplemented.aspx aspx 正文只解释样例链接没有提供内容，保持静态信息边界，不把样例数据当作可用业务资源。 the body only explains that sample-linked content is not provided, keeping a static-information boundary rather than treating sample data as an available business resource.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx-5 notimplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the home link uses the application path and only leaves the landing page; it does not change configuration or business state. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-notimplemented.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/notimplemented.aspx aspx 返回首页链接使用应用路径生成，离开落地页但不改变任何配置或业务状态。 the home link uses the application path and only leaves the landing page; it does not change configuration or business state.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx-1 operationaudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p2.4 read-only operation-audit page queries high-value state changes; ordinary view actions are not audited at this stage and can later be governed by audit-policy settings if needed. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/operationaudits.aspx aspx p2.4 只读运营审计页用于查询高价值状态变更；普通查看行为当前不写审计，相关策略扩展由审计策略配置统一控制。 the p2.4 read-only operation-audit page queries high-value state changes; ordinary view actions are not audited at this stage and can later be governed by audit-policy settings if needed.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx-2 operationaudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the operation-audit page only adjusts the display structure for filters, paging, and the result table; query parsing, paging boundaries, and administrator authorization remain controlled by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/operationaudits.aspx aspx 运营审计页只调整筛选区、分页区和结果表格的展示结构，查询条件解析、分页边界和管理员权限逻辑仍由 code-behind 控制。 the operation-audit page only adjusts the display structure for filters, paging, and the result table; query parsing, paging boundaries, and administrator authorization remain controlled by the code-behind.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx-3 operationaudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the audit filter controls only collect display-query criteria; code-behind remains responsible for parsing, range limits, and administrator authorization for dates, category, action, and target id. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/operationaudits.aspx aspx 审计筛选控件只收集展示查询条件；日期、分类、动作和目标编号的解析、范围限制及管理员授权仍由 code-behind 完成。 the audit filter controls only collect display-query criteria; code-behind remains responsible for parsing, range limits, and administrator authorization for dates, category, action, and target id.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx-4 operationaudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment pager buttons express only previous/next requests without page validation; the server handles audit-result page boundaries and empty-result fallback. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/operationaudits.aspx aspx 分页按钮只表达前后页请求且不触发页面验证；实际审计结果页边界和空结果回退由服务端处理。 pager buttons express only previous/next requests without page validation; the server handles audit-result page boundaries and empty-result fallback.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx-5 operationaudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the repeater only renders audit records and exposes no write or delete action; encoded bindings render text, while the server query layer owns redaction boundaries for summary, actor, and target data. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/operationaudits.aspx aspx repeater 仅呈现审计记录，不提供写入或删除动作；文本字段使用编码绑定，摘要、操作者和目标信息的脱敏边界由服务端查询层负责。 the repeater only renders audit records and exposes no write or delete action; encoded bindings render text, while the server query layer owns redaction boundaries for summary, actor, and target data.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx-6 operationaudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment p81.3 空态：仅在"查询成功且零条"时渲染；输入无效与审计表不可用两个分支由代码后置把计数置为 null 抑制，避免把错误/故障说成"暂无记录"。 dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-operationaudits.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/operationaudits.aspx aspx

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx-1 organizationunitedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p6.3-s4 minimal organization-unit maintenance page only supports single-record create/edit and activation toggles; it does not provide hard delete, import, export, or batch synchronization, avoiding premature expansion of organization-data governance. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/organizationunitedit.aspx aspx p6.3-s4 组织单元最小维护页只支持单条新增/编辑和启停；不提供硬删除、导入、导出或批量同步，避免过早扩大组织数据治理面。 the p6.3-s4 minimal organization-unit maintenance page only supports single-record create/edit and activation toggles; it does not provide hard delete, import, export, or batch synchronization, avoiding premature expansion of organization-data governance.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx-2 organizationunitedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the organization-unit edit page only rebuilds the display shell and form layout; parent-cycle validation, concurrency timestamps, persistence, and auditing remain handled by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/organizationunitedit.aspx aspx 组织单元编辑页只重构展示壳和表单布局，父级循环校验、并发时间戳、保存和审计仍由 code-behind 处理。 the organization-unit edit page only rebuilds the display shell and form layout; parent-cycle validation, concurrency timestamps, persistence, and auditing remain handled by the code-behind.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx-3 organizationunitedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment these hidden fields round-trip the record id and original update timestamp for server-side concurrency and target checks; they are not client-writable authorization sources. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/organizationunitedit.aspx aspx 隐藏字段回传记录 id 和原始更新时间，仅用于服务器并发/目标校验；它们不是客户端可写的授权来源。 these hidden fields round-trip the record id and original update timestamp for server-side concurrency and target checks; they are not client-writable authorization sources.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx-4 organizationunitedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment code, name, parent, order, and active state form one organization-maintenance input; the markup does not decide parent cycles, normalization, or business boundaries. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/organizationunitedit.aspx aspx 代码、名称、父级、排序和启用状态组成单条组织维护输入；父级循环、规范化和业务边界不由标记层判断。 code, name, parent, order, and active state form one organization-maintenance input; the markup does not decide parent cycles, normalization, or business boundaries.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx-5 organizationunitedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the save command enters the existing server persistence and audit flow; cancel only leaves the edit context and does not revoke or forge state on the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-organizationunitedit.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/organizationunitedit.aspx aspx 保存命令进入既有服务器持久化和审计流程，取消只离开当前编辑上下文，不在客户端撤销或伪造状态。 the save command enters the existing server persistence and audit flow; cancel only leaves the edit context and does not revoke or forge state on the client.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-1 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment register.aspx provides the legacy web forms surface for public or invitation registration; the page only collects account, email, employee code, and password input, while uniqueness checks, invitation policy, password handling, and database persistence are handled by registerbtn_click and the usersdb server path. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx register.aspx 为公开或邀请式注册提供旧 web forms 表单；页面只收集账号、邮箱、员工号与密码输入，唯一性校验、邀请策略、密码处理和数据库写入均由 registerbtn_click 及 usersdb 服务器链路完成。 register.aspx provides the legacy web forms surface for public or invitation registration; the page only collects account, email, employee code, and password input, while uniqueness checks, invitation policy, password handling, and database persistence are handled by registerbtn_click and the usersdb server path.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-2 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the outer table preserves the starterkit-era layout contract so the registration page stays aligned with the main content column in legacy themes and narrow fallbacks. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 外层表格保留 starterkit 时代布局契约，避免注册页在旧主题和窄屏回退中脱离主内容列。 the outer table preserves the starterkit-era layout contract so the registration page stays aligned with the main content column in legacy themes and narrow fallbacks.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-3 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the heading is the visible entry cue for this page; the outcome of account creation is still determined by the later server message. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 标题文本是此页面的可见入口提示；账号创建结果仍以后续服务器消息为准。 the heading is the visible entry cue for this page; the outcome of account creation is still determined by the later server message.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-4 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the legacy horizontal rule is only a visual separator and does not express validation, authorization, or workflow state. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 旧式水平线只承担视觉分隔作用，不表达验证、授权或流程状态。 the legacy horizontal rule is only a visual separator and does not express validation, authorization, or workflow state.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-5 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the user information area groups postback fields; each server control id is the stable contract used by the backend to read and validate the registration request. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 用户信息区域按回发字段组织输入；每个服务器控件的 id 是后端读取和验证注册请求的稳定契约。 the user information area groups postback fields; each server control id is the stable contract used by the backend to read and validate the registration request.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-6 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment registration fields and validators construct a one-time account request; uniqueness, invited employee-code policy, normalization, and account persistence remain server-side. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 注册字段和验证器只构造一次性账号申请；唯一性、邀请员工号策略、规范化和账户写入仍由服务器完成。 registration fields and validators construct a one-time account request; uniqueness, invited employee-code policy, normalization, and account persistence remain server-side.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-7 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment the name field carries the requested user name; markup only requires a non-empty value, with normalization, duplicate checks, and persistence handled server-side. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx name 字段承载注册用户名；标记层只要求非空，规范化、重复检查和持久化在服务器端完成。 the name field carries the requested user name; markup only requires a non-empty value, with normalization, duplicate checks, and persistence handled server-side.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-8 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 8 dotnet-markup-comment public registration only requires a non-empty value here; stricter user-name format rules should be governed through system settings. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:8 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 公开注册只在此处强制必填；更严格的用户名格式策略应通过系统设置统一治理。 public registration only requires a non-empty value here; stricter user-name format rules should be governed through system settings.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 9
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-9 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 9 dotnet-markup-comment the email field stores the registration contact address; page validators only cover basic format and presence, and cannot replace server-side trust or follow-up usage policy. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:9 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx email 字段用于注册联系地址；页面校验只覆盖基本格式和必填，邮箱可信度与后续使用策略不能由客户端验证替代。 the email field stores the registration contact address; page validators only cover basic format and presence, and cannot replace server-side trust or follow-up usage policy.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 10
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-10 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 10 dotnet-markup-comment employeecode is the required binding hint for enterprise invitation registration; ordinary self-registration does not require it by default, and the enabled state is switched by server policy. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:10 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx employeecode 在企业临时邀请注册中作为必填绑定线索；普通自注册路径默认不强制，启用状态由服务器策略切换。 employeecode is the required binding hint for enterprise invitation registration; ordinary self-registration does not require it by default, and the enabled state is switched by server policy.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 11
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-11 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 11 dotnet-markup-comment the password and confirmation ciphertext fields only support pre-submit protection and remain client-posted data; the server must revalidate matching, policy, and secure storage. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:11 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 密码与确认密码的隐藏密文字段仅用于提交前保护，仍属于客户端回传；服务器必须重新验证匹配、策略和安全存储。 the password and confirmation ciphertext fields only support pre-submit protection and remain client-posted data; the server must revalidate matching, policy, and secure storage.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 12
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-12 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 12 dotnet-markup-comment the confirmation password field only supports consistency checks for this postback; matching validation occurs at the page layer, and the server must still re-confirm that plaintext or ciphertext input reflects the same user intent. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:12 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx 确认密码字段只为本次回发提供一致性检查；匹配验证发生在页面层，服务器仍需重新确认明文/密文输入对应同一用户意图。 the confirmation password field only supports consistency checks for this postback; matching validation occurs at the page layer, and the server must still re-confirm that plaintext or ciphertext input reflects the same user intent.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 13
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-13 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 13 dotnet-markup-comment registerbtn_click is the server entry for account creation and failure messaging; message reports the server result and cannot be used by markup to claim registration success. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:13 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx registerbtn_click 是账号创建与失败提示的服务器入口；message 只能反馈服务器结果，不能由页面标记宣称注册成功。 registerbtn_click is the server entry for account creation and failure messaging; message reports the server result and cannot be used by markup to claim registration success.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 14
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-register.aspx-14 register.aspx webforms-server-comment 14 dotnet-markup-comment the message label only displays the registration result or error returned by the server; it does not store sensitive input or synchronize client-side state. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-register.aspx:14 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/register.aspx aspx message 标签只显示服务器返回的注册结果或错误提示，不保存敏感输入，也不承担客户端状态同步职责。 the message label only displays the registration result or error returned by the server; it does not store sensitive input or synchronize client-side state.

entries.name: Roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-roles.ascx-1 roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the legacy role entry preserves real create, rename, delete, and membership management behavior while continuing to synchronize legacy semicolon-delimited authorization strings. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-roles.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/roles.ascx ascx 旧角色入口保留真实创建、改名、删除和成员管理行为，并继续同步旧分号授权字符串。 the legacy role entry preserves real create, rename, delete, and membership management behavior while continuing to synchronize legacy semicolon-delimited authorization strings.

entries.name: Roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-roles.ascx-2 roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment adding a role is a persistence entry point and still uses addrole_click for server-side creation, naming constraints, and authorization boundaries. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-roles.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/roles.ascx ascx 新增角色是写库入口，仍通过 addrole_click 执行服务器端创建、命名约束和授权边界。 adding a role is a persistence entry point and still uses addrole_click for server-side creation, naming constraints, and authorization boundaries.

entries.name: Roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-roles.ascx-3 roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the datalist keeps roleid as the command key and retains role-row events; the name uses encoded binding, while edit and delete must be rechecked by the server for target and authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-roles.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/roles.ascx ascx datalist 以 roleid 作为命令键并保留角色行事件；显示名称采用编码绑定，编辑和删除必须由服务器重新确认目标与权限。 the datalist keeps roleid as the command key and retains role-row events; the name uses encoded binding, while edit and delete must be rechecked by the server for target and authorization.

entries.name: Roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-roles.ascx-4 roles.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the edit template allows renaming or entering membership management, while deletion protection, legacy semicolon-authorization synchronization, and save results remain decided by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-roles.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/roles.ascx ascx 编辑模板允许改名或进入成员管理，但角色删除保护、旧分号授权同步和保存结果仍由 code-behind 决定。 the edit template allows renaming or entering membership management, while deletion protection, legacy semicolon-authorization synchronization, and save results remain decided by the code-behind.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-1 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the role-membership page maintains user membership for the selected portal role; role definitions themselves remain managed by legacy admin entries such as roles and moduledefinitions. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 角色成员页用于维护选定门户角色下的用户成员关系；角色定义本身仍由旧 roles/moduledefinitions 等后台入口维护。 the role-membership page maintains user membership for the selected portal role; role definitions themselves remain managed by legacy admin entries such as roles and moduledefinitions.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-2 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the role-membership page only adjusts the admin display structure; membership add/remove behavior still uses the original datalist commands, user dropdown, and code-behind, avoiding changes to legacy authorization-string synchronization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 角色成员页只调整后台展示结构，成员增删仍由原 datalist 命令、下拉用户列表和 code-behind 控制，避免改动旧授权字符串同步逻辑。 the role-membership page only adjusts the admin display structure; membership add/remove behavior still uses the original datalist commands, user dropdown, and code-behind, avoiding changes to legacy authorization-string synchronization.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-3 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the title element is server-controlled and its text is written by code-behind using a resource format string; a code block must not be placed here, otherwise setting innertext throws because the contents are not literal. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 标题元素由服务器控制，文案由 code-behind 用资源格式串写入；此处不能放代码块，否则设置 innertext 会因"内容非字面"而抛异常。 the title element is server-controlled and its text is written by code-behind using a resource format string; a code block must not be placed here, otherwise setting innertext throws because the contents are not literal.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-4 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the historical windows-user creation entry remains as invisible markup reference; this stage keeps it disabled to avoid bypassing portal registration, approval, and user-employee binding flows. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 历史 windows 用户创建入口仍保留为不可见标记参考；当前阶段不启用该机制，避免绕过门户注册、审核和账号员工绑定流程。 the historical windows-user creation entry remains as invisible markup reference; this stage keeps it disabled to avoid bypassing portal registration, approval, and user-employee binding flows.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-5 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the user dropdown only supplies candidate user keys for the current role; code-behind must revalidate user existence, role authorization, and duplicate membership before adding. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 用户下拉列表只提供当前角色的候选用户键；添加命令必须由 code-behind 重新校验用户存在性、角色授权和重复成员状态。 the user dropdown only supplies candidate user keys for the current role; code-behind must revalidate user existence, role authorization, and duplicate membership before adding.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-6 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the member datalist renders current members read-only with encoded text binding; the server decides the role/user relationship and audit result for a removal command. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 成员 datalist 只读展示当前成员并使用编码绑定文本；删除命令的角色/用户关系和审计结果由服务端决定。 the member datalist renders current members read-only with encoded text binding; the server decides the role/user relationship and audit result for a removal command.

entries.name: SecurityRoles.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx-7 securityroles.aspx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment the save-role-changes button only triggers server-side membership synchronization; administrator authorization, duplicates, concurrency, and legacy authorization-string compatibility are not implemented by markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-securityroles.aspx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/securityroles.aspx aspx 保存角色变更按钮只触发服务端成员同步；管理员授权、重复项、并发和旧授权字符串兼容逻辑不由标记层实现。 the save-role-changes button only triggers server-side membership synchronization; administrator authorization, duplicates, concurrency, and legacy authorization-string compatibility are not implemented by markup.

entries.name: SiteSettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx-1 sitesettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment basic site settings still use the legacy control to persist the portal title and edit-button visibility policy; before the unified system-settings ui takes over, this control only receives admin-visual compatibility treatment. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/sitesettings.ascx ascx 站点基础设置仍由旧控件保存门户标题和编辑按钮显示策略；系统设置总 ui 覆盖前，本控件先完成后台视觉兼容治理。 basic site settings still use the legacy control to persist the portal title and edit-button visibility policy; before the unified system-settings ui takes over, this control only receives admin-visual compatibility treatment.

entries.name: SiteSettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx-2 sitesettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the server writes the status message to report site-settings persistence; the page does not treat client text as proof of success. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/sitesettings.ascx ascx 状态消息由服务器写入，用于反馈站点设置保存结果；页面不把客户端文本当作成功证明。 the server writes the status message to report site-settings persistence; the page does not treat client text as proof of success.

entries.name: SiteSettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx-3 sitesettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment site title and edit-button visibility form the legacy portal metadata input; normalization, authorization, and compatibility policy remain decided by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/sitesettings.ascx ascx 站点标题和编辑按钮可见性组成旧门户元数据输入；规范化、权限和兼容策略仍由 code-behind 决定。 site title and edit-button visibility form the legacy portal metadata input; normalization, authorization, and compatibility policy remain decided by the code-behind.

entries.name: SiteSettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx-4 sitesettings.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment apply_click submits settings to the existing persistence flow; the markup provides only the command entry and does not implement saving or rollback. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-sitesettings.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/sitesettings.ascx ascx apply_click 负责将设置提交到既有持久化流程；标记层只提供命令入口，不实现保存或回滚。 apply_click submits settings to the existing persistence flow; the markup provides only the command entry and does not implement saving or rollback.

entries.name: SystemHealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx-1 systemhealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p2.2 read-only system health page only displays check results, the settings-registry summary, and a recheck entry point; it does not provide automated repair, configuration writes, or command execution. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/systemhealth.aspx aspx p2.2 只读系统健康页仅展示检查结果、设置 registry 摘要和重新检测入口，不在页面上提供自动修复、配置写入或命令执行能力。 the p2.2 read-only system health page only displays check results, the settings-registry summary, and a recheck entry point; it does not provide automated repair, configuration writes, or command execution.

entries.name: SystemHealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx-2 systemhealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the admin page-level layout sample preserves server-control bindings and repeater data sources, only rebuilding the page shell, summary cards, and table semantics so the code-behind health-check flow is not changed. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/systemhealth.aspx aspx 后台页级布局样板保留服务器控件绑定和 repeater 数据源，只重构页面壳、摘要卡片和表格语义，避免影响 code-behind 健康检查流程。 the admin page-level layout sample preserves server-control bindings and repeater data sources, only rebuilding the page shell, summary cards, and table semantics so the code-behind health-check flow is not changed.

entries.name: SystemHealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx-3 systemhealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment summary cards only present the overall status and check time produced by the code-behind; recheck triggers read-only checks and does not repair or write configuration. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/systemhealth.aspx aspx 摘要卡片只呈现 code-behind 生成的总体状态和检查时间；重新检测按钮重新触发只读检查，不提供修复或配置写入。 summary cards only present the overall status and check time produced by the code-behind; recheck triggers read-only checks and does not repair or write configuration.

entries.name: SystemHealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx-4 systemhealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the health-check repeater displays category, summary, detail, and event id through encoded bindings; detail is diagnostic output and must not be treated as an executable command by the page layer. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/systemhealth.aspx aspx 健康检查 repeater 以编码绑定展示类别、摘要、详情和事件 id；详情是诊断输出，不应被页面层当作可执行命令。 the health-check repeater displays category, summary, detail, and event id through encoded bindings; detail is diagnostic output and must not be treated as an executable command by the page layer.

entries.name: SystemHealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx-5 systemhealth.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment settings-registry rows expose sensitivity, online-editability, and restart requirements; these labels reflect server metadata and cannot bypass configuration-write policy. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-systemhealth.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/systemhealth.aspx aspx 设置 registry 行同时标出敏感性、在线可编辑和重启要求；这些标签只反映服务器元数据，不能绕过配置写入策略。 settings-registry rows expose sensitivity, online-editability, and restart requirements; these labels reflect server metadata and cannot bypass configuration-write policy.

entries.name: TabLayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx-1 tablayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment only the page presentation is rebuilt; all webforms control ids, events, and custom attributes are preserved to keep the legacy ordering logic intact. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tablayout.aspx aspx 只重构页面外观，保留所有 webforms 控件 id、事件和自定义属性以维持旧排序逻辑。 only the page presentation is rebuilt; all webforms control ids, events, and custom attributes are preserved to keep the legacy ordering logic intact.

entries.name: TabLayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx-2 tablayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment page-owned navigation entries: security roles is still the legacy control host page and the registry entry core.admin.roles targets roles.ascx rather than this page, so the renderer cannot express that link; this page also belongs to admin.modules and the renderer is group-scoped, so the block stays in the page and is localized only. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tablayout.aspx aspx 页面自有导航入口：security roles 仍是旧控件宿主页，registry 中的 core.admin.roles 指向 roles.ascx、目标并不相同，故该链接无法由渲染器表达；且本页入口属 admin.modules 族、渲染器按族输出，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。 page-owned navigation entries: security roles is still the legacy control host page and the registry entry core.admin.roles targets roles.ascx rather than this page, so the renderer cannot express that link; this page also belongs to admin.modules and the renderer is group-scoped, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

entries.name: TabLayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx-3 tablayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment these fields carry tab metadata, role authorization, and mobile visibility; change events remain handled by the code-behind, with the server deciding the final state. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tablayout.aspx aspx 这些字段承载 tab 元数据、角色授权和移动端可见性；变更事件仍交由 code-behind 处理并由服务器决定最终状态。 these fields carry tab metadata, role authorization, and mobile visibility; change events remain handled by the code-behind, with the server deciding the final state.

entries.name: TabLayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx-4 tablayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment tab-name multilingual area: the chinese name is the `tabname` field above (the chinese column and default fallback, so it is not entered twice); only the english column and the "other languages" json column are added here. the json column's sample text comes from a resource key so culture names are not hard-coded in markup. both inputs reuse `tabsettings_change`, sharing the existing change → save path. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tablayout.aspx aspx 页签名多语言区：中文名就是上面的 `tabname`（中文列兼默认回退列，不重复输入），
    这里只补英文列与"其它语言"json 列。json 列的示例文案来自资源键，避免把文化名写死在标记层。
    两个输入都挂 `tabsettings_change`，与既有字段共用同一条变更 → 保存链路。 tab-name multilingual area: the chinese name is the `tabname` field above (the chinese column and default fallback, so it is not entered twice); only the english column and the "other languages" json column are added here. the json column's sample text comes from a resource key so culture names are not hard-coded in markup. both inputs reuse `tabsettings_change`, sharing the existing change → save path.

entries.name: TabLayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx-5 tablayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment module creation selects a type from the server-provided definition list and submits a title for the current tab instance; client values are not trusted paths or permissions. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tablayout.aspx aspx 新增模块只从服务器提供的定义列表取类型，标题作为当前 tab 的模块实例名称提交，不能把客户端值视为受信任路径或权限。 module creation selects a type from the server-provided definition list and submits a title for the current tab instance; client values are not trusted paths or permissions.

entries.name: TabLayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx-6 tablayout.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the three listboxes and their command bars together express module pane membership and order; move, edit, and delete actions enter the server state machine through the existing callbacks. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tablayout.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tablayout.aspx aspx 三个 listbox 及其命令栏共同表达模块所在 pane 和顺序；移动、编辑、删除操作均通过既有事件回调进入服务器状态机。 the three listboxes and their command bars together express module pane membership and order; move, edit, and delete actions enter the server state machine through the existing callbacks.

entries.name: Tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
