entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx-1 tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the legacy tab administration control preserves real ordering, deletion, and creation behavior; screenshot matrices only open the page and do not click these database-writing buttons. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tabs.ascx ascx 旧 tab 管理控件保留真实排序、删除和创建行为；截图矩阵只打开页面，不点击这些写库按钮。 the legacy tab administration control preserves real ordering, deletion, and creation behavior; screenshot matrices only open the page and do not click these database-writing buttons.

entries.name: Tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx-2 tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment adding a tab is a persistence entry point and still uses addtab_click for server-side creation and authorization checks. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tabs.ascx ascx 新增 tab 是写库入口，仍通过原 addtab_click 回调执行服务器端创建与权限检查。 adding a tab is a persistence entry point and still uses addtab_click for server-side creation and authorization checks.

entries.name: Tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx-3 tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the list receives tab order and ids from portaltabs; the selected item is only the target of later server commands and does not directly determine authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tabs.ascx ascx 列表由 portaltabs 数据源提供 tab 顺序和 id；选中项只作为后续服务器命令的目标，不直接决定权限。 the list receives tab order and ids from portaltabs; the selected item is only the target of later server commands and does not directly determine authorization.

entries.name: Tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx-4 tabs.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment ordering, editing, and deletion share the legacy callbacks; deletion is constrained by the code-behind's core-tab protection, and the page hint cannot replace server validation. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-tabs.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/tabs.ascx ascx 排序、编辑和删除共用旧事件回调；删除语义受 code-behind 的核心 tab 保护约束，页面提示不能替代服务器校验。 ordering, editing, and deletion share the legacy callbacks; deletion is constrained by the code-behind's core-tab protection, and the page hint cannot replace server validation.

entries.name: ThemeSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx-1 themesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p3.1 theme selection page: administrators can only select deployed themes that pass manifest validation; package upload and online style editing are not provided. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/themesettings.aspx aspx p3.1 主题选择页：管理员仅能选择已部署且通过 manifest 校验的主题，不提供包上传或在线样式编辑。 p3.1 theme selection page: administrators can only select deployed themes that pass manifest validation; package upload and online style editing are not provided.

entries.name: ThemeSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx-2 themesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the theme settings page only adjusts the presentation structure; theme writes and audit recording remain in code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/themesettings.aspx aspx 主题设置页只调整展示结构，主题写入和审计仍由 code-behind 处理。 the theme settings page only adjusts the presentation structure; theme writes and audit recording remain in code-behind.

entries.name: ThemeSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx-3 themesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the global-theme dropdown only supplies keys for deployed themes; server code owns authorization, manifest trust, and database writes for apply/reset commands. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/themesettings.aspx aspx 全局主题下拉列表只提供已部署主题键；应用和重置命令的权限、manifest 信任与数据库写入仍由服务端处理。 the global-theme dropdown only supplies keys for deployed themes; server code owns authorization, manifest trust, and database writes for apply/reset commands.

entries.name: ThemeSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx-4 themesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment tablist postback only loads the selected tab's override values; the server must not trust client-selected tab identity, theme keys, or clear scope. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/themesettings.aspx aspx tablist 的自动回发只用于加载当前页签覆盖值；页签身份、主题键和覆盖清除范围不能由客户端选择直接信任。 tablist postback only loads the selected tab's override values; the server must not trust client-selected tab identity, theme keys, or clear scope.

entries.name: ThemeSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx-5 themesettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment tab-theme apply/clear buttons only trigger code-behind commands; fallback policy, authorization, auditing, and persistence transactions are not implemented by markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-themesettings.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/themesettings.aspx aspx 页签主题应用/清除按钮只触发 code-behind 命令；回退策略、权限、审计和持久化事务不由标记层实现。 tab-theme apply/clear buttons only trigger code-behind commands; fallback policy, authorization, auditing, and persistence transactions are not implemented by markup.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-1 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p6.3-s5 single binding maintenance page between a portal account and an employee record. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx p6.3-s5 门户账号与员工单条绑定维护页。 p6.3-s5 single binding maintenance page between a portal account and an employee record.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-2 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the binding page only rebuilds the presentation shell; binding, unbinding, security-version refresh, and audit logic remain in code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx 绑定页只重构展示壳，绑定、解绑、安全版本刷新和审计逻辑仍由 code-behind 处理。 the binding page only rebuilds the presentation shell; binding, unbinding, security-version refresh, and audit logic remain in code-behind.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-3 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment page-owned navigation entries: user administration belongs to admin.account while this page belongs to admin.capability; the group-scoped renderer cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only. manageuserlink has its visibility and target decided by code-behind, so only its text is localized here. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx 页面自有导航入口：user administration 属 admin.account 族，而本页入口属 admin.capability 族；渲染器按族输出、无法表达该跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。manageuserlink 由 code-behind 决定可见性与目标，此处只本地化其文案。 page-owned navigation entries: user administration belongs to admin.account while this page belongs to admin.capability; the group-scoped renderer cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only. manageuserlink has its visibility and target decided by code-behind, so only its text is localized here.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-4 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment activebindingid is only a postback carrier for server state and can be modified by the client; unbinding and version checks must not trust this hidden field. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx activebindingid 只是服务端状态的回发载体，客户端可修改其值；绑定结束和版本校验不能信任该隐藏字段。 activebindingid is only a postback carrier for server state and can be modified by the client; unbinding and version checks must not trust this hidden field.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-5 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment user, employee, and reason inputs have markup-level length limits, while code-behind still validates format, existence, uniqueness, current binding, and audit requirements. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx 用户、员工和原因输入受标记层长度上限约束，但格式、存在性、唯一性、当前绑定和审计要求仍由 code-behind 校验。 user, employee, and reason inputs have markup-level length limits, while code-behind still validates format, existence, uniqueness, current binding, and audit requirements.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-6 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the bind and end-binding buttons only trigger server commands; browser confirmation reduces accidental actions but does not replace administrator authorization, concurrency-version, or transactional-audit checks. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx 绑定和结束绑定按钮只触发服务端命令；浏览器确认仅降低误操作，不替代管理员授权、并发版本和事务审计检查。 the bind and end-binding buttons only trigger server commands; browser confirmation reduces accidental actions but does not replace administrator authorization, concurrency-version, or transactional-audit checks.

entries.name: UserEmployeeBindingEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx-7 useremployeebindingedit.aspx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment the end-binding button previously hardcoded chinese confirmation text, which showed chinese even in an english ui; the whole statement now comes from a resource (the value must stay a valid js statement with single-quoted text so the markup attribute is not broken). dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-useremployeebindingedit.aspx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/useremployeebindingedit.aspx aspx 结束绑定按钮的 onclientclick 原先硬编码中文确认文案，英文界面下会显示中文；现整体取自资源（该资源值必须保持为合法的 js 语句，且消息文本使用单引号，避免破坏标记属性）。 the end-binding button previously hardcoded chinese confirmation text, which showed chinese even in an english ui; the whole statement now comes from a resource (the value must stay a valid js statement with single-quoted text so the markup attribute is not broken).

entries.name: Users.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-users.ascx-1 users.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the legacy user entry preserves explicit administrator post behavior and does not create users when the page is merely opened. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-users.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/users.ascx ascx 旧用户入口保留显式管理员 post 行为；不在页面打开时创建用户。 the legacy user entry preserves explicit administrator post behavior and does not create users when the page is merely opened.

entries.name: Users.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-users.ascx-2 users.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the add-user button is an explicit administrator persistence entry point and still uses adduser_click for server-side placeholder creation and authorization boundaries. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-users.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/users.ascx ascx 新增用户按钮是显式管理员写库入口，继续通过 adduser_click 执行服务器端占位账号创建与授权边界。 the add-user button is an explicit administrator persistence entry point and still uses adduser_click for server-side placeholder creation and authorization boundaries.

entries.name: Users.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-users.ascx-3 users.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the dropdown uses userid as the server target key and email as display text; the selected item alone does not prove that the administrator may operate on that account. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-users.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/users.ascx ascx 下拉列表以 userid 作为服务器目标键、email 作为展示文本；选中项不能单独证明当前管理员可操作该账号。 the dropdown uses userid as the server target key and email as display text; the selected item alone does not prove that the administrator may operate on that account.

entries.name: Users.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-users.ascx-4 users.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment edit and delete commands use the legacy callbacks; deletion is an irreversible-risk action, so the server must recheck target, authorization, and reference state. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-users.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/users.ascx ascx 编辑和删除命令沿用旧回调；删除是不可逆风险动作，服务器必须重新确认目标、权限和引用状态。 edit and delete commands use the legacy callbacks; deletion is an irreversible-risk action, so the server must recheck target, authorization, and reference state.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-1 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p12.3 lightweight work-item admin entry: the first version is a read-only central view without workflow designer or reassignment; p21.3 also projects collaboration-item work entries here. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx p12.3 轻量待办后台入口：第一版只读集中查看，不提供流程设计器或转办；p21.3 起同时承接协同事项待办投影。 p12.3 lightweight work-item admin entry: the first version is a read-only central view without workflow designer or reassignment; p21.3 also projects collaboration-item work entries here.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-2 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment page-owned navigation entries: operation audits belongs to admin.ops while this page belongs to admin.capability; the group-scoped renderer cannot express cross-group links, so the block stays in the page and is localized only (the correction-requests entry now exists in the registry). dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx 页面自有导航入口：operation audits 属 admin.ops 族，而本页入口属 admin.capability 族；渲染器按族输出、无法表达跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化（资料更正请求的 registry 入口已补齐）。 page-owned navigation entries: operation audits belongs to admin.ops while this page belongs to admin.capability; the group-scoped renderer cannot express cross-group links, so the block stays in the page and is localized only (the correction-requests entry now exists in the registry).

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-3 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment status-filter options are created by code-behind from the stable status contract during the initial load; this markup layer carries only the authorized page control state and neither reads the database nor interprets state transitions. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx 状态筛选项由 code-behind 在首次加载时从稳定状态契约建立；标记层只承载已授权页面的控件状态，不直接读取数据库或解释状态迁移。 status-filter options are created by code-behind from the stable status contract during the initial load; this markup layer carries only the authorized page control state and neither reads the database nor interprets state transitions.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-4 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment searchbutton_click refreshes the work-item projection for the current status filter; the button triggers a query and does not let the client change work-item state. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx searchbutton_click 依据当前状态筛选刷新待办投影；按钮只触发查询，不代表客户端可以改变工作项状态。 searchbutton_click refreshes the work-item projection for the current status filter; the button triggers a query and does not let the client change work-item state.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-5 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the server writes result and schema-status messaging to resultlabel; the text is not client proof of data existence, authorization, or transition success. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx resultlabel 由服务器写入结果和 schema 状态提示；提示文本不构成数据存在、权限或迁移成功的客户端证明。 the server writes result and schema-status messaging to resultlabel; the text is not client proof of data existence, authorization, or transition success.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-6 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment work-item data is bound by code-behind after the permission gate; this markup layer neither queries nor concatenates business data directly. the backend clears the repeater and shows controlled messaging for empty collections and unavailable schema. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx 待办数据由已通过权限门禁的 code-behind 绑定；此标记层不直接查询或拼接业务数据。空集合和 schema 不可用状态由后端清空 repeater 并显示受控提示。 work-item data is bound by code-behind after the permission gate; this markup layer neither queries nor concatenates business data directly. the backend clears the repeater and shows controlled messaging for empty collections and unavailable schema.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-7 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment display values use `<%#:` encoded binding so work-item title, summary, and assignment text are not emitted as raw html. the business entry binds only the fixed local allowlisted url generated by code-behind; it neither displays nor concatenates businessid, and unknown kinds are server-mapped to the placeholder page. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx 展示值使用 `<%#:` 编码绑定，避免待办标题、摘要和分派文字作为原始 html 输出。业务入口只绑定 code-behind 生成的固定本地白名单 url；不展示或拼接 businessid，未知类型已在服务器映射到占位页。 display values use `<%#:` encoded binding so work-item title, summary, and assignment text are not emitted as raw html. the business entry binds only the fixed local allowlisted url generated by code-behind; it neither displays nor concatenates businessid, and unknown kinds are server-mapped to the placeholder page.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-8 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 8 dotnet-markup-comment the item template only presents encoded fields and the fixed local business entry generated by code-behind; the page neither derives urls from businessid nor performs writes. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:8 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx 单项模板只呈现 code-behind 生成的编码字段与固定本地业务入口；页面不从 businessid 推导 url，也不执行写操作。 the item template only presents encoded fields and the fixed local business entry generated by code-behind; the page neither derives urls from businessid nor performs writes.

entries.name: WorkItems.aspx webforms-server-comment 9
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx-9 workitems.aspx webforms-server-comment 9 dotnet-markup-comment p74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-admin-workitems.aspx:9 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/admin/workitems.aspx aspx

entries.name: Default.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.aspx-1 default.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the portal root endpoint is hosted by the master page, but this page only performs browser-type routing; the desktop or mobile target is chosen by the code-behind. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.aspx aspx 门户根入口通过母版页承载，但页面自身只负责浏览器类型分流；桌面/移动目标由 code-behind 决定。 the portal root endpoint is hosted by the master page, but this page only performs browser-type routing; the desktop or mobile target is chosen by the code-behind.

entries.name: Default.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.aspx-2 default.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment this markup layer does not display business data or declare input controls; it preserves the legacy web forms home endpoint so redirect rules are not scattered into static links or client script. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.aspx aspx 此标记层不展示业务数据，也不声明输入控件；它保留旧 web forms 首页入口，避免把重定向规则散落到静态链接或客户端脚本。 this markup layer does not display business data or declare input controls; it preserves the legacy web forms home endpoint so redirect rules are not scattered into static links or client script.

entries.name: Default.master webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.master-1 default.master webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the default master keeps the desktop banner control. starting with p7.4, it hosts the modern portal shell; further componentization or configurability of the banner remains future work.
 internal deferred-item registration (four-way split: **external pending — workstream not started**) — basis: componentizing the banner first needs a design contract for shell components and a theme-layering conclusion, neither of which exists in this cycle, so it is registered only.
 owner: the theme/shell workstream. re-entry condition: a shell-component plan starts and covers the banner. until then keep the fixed reference and do not change the markup structure. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.master:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master aspnet-master 默认 master 固定引用桌面 banner 控件；p7.4 起它承载现代门户外壳，banner 的进一步组件化或可配置化属于后续专题。
 内部延期项登记（四分法：**外部 pending——专题未启动**）——判定依据：banner 组件化需要先有外壳组件的设计契约与主题分层结论，本周期不具备该输入，故只登记不处置。
 所有者：主题/外壳专题。再入条件：门户外壳组件化方案启动并覆盖 banner 时。再入前保持固定引用，不改标记结构。 the default master keeps the desktop banner control. starting with p7.4, it hosts the modern portal shell; further componentization or configurability of the banner remains future work.
 internal deferred-item registration (four-way split: **external pending — workstream not started**) — basis: componentizing the banner first needs a design contract for shell components and a theme-layering conclusion, neither of which exists in this cycle, so it is registered only.
 owner: the theme/shell workstream. re-entry condition: a shell-component plan starts and covers the banner. until then keep the fixed reference and do not change the markup structure.

entries.name: Default.master webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.master-2 default.master webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the page title remains a legacy fixed value. native web forms theme loading attaches theme css during the page lifecycle, so the master markup does not concatenate it manually. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.master:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master aspnet-master 页面标题仍沿用历史固定值；主题 css 由 web forms 原生 theme 在页面生命周期中装载，不在 master 标记中手动拼接。 the page title remains a legacy fixed value. native web forms theme loading attaches theme css during the page lifecycle, so the master markup does not concatenate it manually.

entries.name: Default.master webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.master-3 default.master webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment portalmasterpage writes controlled theme and tab classes to this body before rendering. markup must not concatenate external resources, so it does not bypass the trusted deployment boundary of theme and module packages. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.master:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master aspnet-master portalmasterpage 在渲染前为此 body 写入受控主题和 tab class；标记层不得直接拼接外部资源，避免绕过主题包和模块包的受信任部署边界。 portalmasterpage writes controlled theme and tab classes to this body before rendering. markup must not concatenate external resources, so it does not bypass the trusted deployment boundary of theme and module packages.

entries.name: Default.master webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.master-4 default.master webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4 moved the shell to div markup while retaining the single server form and web forms postback, preserving the legacy control lifecycle. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.master:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master aspnet-master p7.4 主壳层已改为 div 结构；仍保留单一 server form 与 web forms postback，避免破坏旧控件生命周期。 p7.4 moved the shell to div markup while retaining the single server form and web forms postback, preserving the legacy control lifecycle.

entries.name: Default.master webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.master-5 default.master webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment portal pages, administration pages, and legacy module pages all provide main content through this placeholder; theme styles should treat it as a stable compatibility entry point. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.master:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master aspnet-master 门户页、后台页和旧模块页都通过此占位符提供主体内容；主题样式应围绕该稳定入口做兼容。 portal pages, administration pages, and legacy module pages all provide main content through this placeholder; theme styles should treat it as a stable compatibility entry point.

entries.name: Default.master webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-default.master-6 default.master webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the footer copyright lives **inside** the main shell so it automatically follows each theme's own sidebar offset and
  width without hard-coding a column width in css (sidebar widths differ across themes), keeping it aligned under all
  eight themes. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-default.master:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/default.master aspnet-master 页脚版权置于主壳层**之内**：这样它自动跟随各主题自身的侧栏偏移与宽度，无需在样式里硬编码列宽
  （不同主题的侧栏宽度并不一致），从而在 8 套主题下都对齐。 the footer copyright lives **inside** the main shell so it automatically follows each theme's own sidebar offset and
  width without hard-coding a column width in css (sidebar widths differ across themes), keeping it aligned under all
  eight themes.

entries.name: DesktopDefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx-1 desktopdefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the desktop portal page reads the current tab layout configuration, dynamically instantiates module user controls, and injects them into the matching pane containers. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx aspx 桌面门户页负责读取当前 tab 的布局配置，动态实例化各模块用户控件，并注入到对应栏位容器中。 the desktop portal page reads the current tab layout configuration, dynamically instantiates module user controls, and injects them into the matching pane containers.

entries.name: DesktopDefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx-2 desktopdefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4 uses modern pane containers; css provides modern enhancement and basic block fallback for old browsers. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx aspx p7.4 使用现代分栏容器；css 提供现代浏览器增强与旧浏览器基本块级回退。 p7.4 uses modern pane containers; css provides modern enhancement and basic block fallback for old browsers.

entries.name: DesktopDefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx-3 desktopdefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment left module pane; code-behind shows it only when the current tab has left-pane modules. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx aspx 左侧模块容器；仅在当前 tab 配置了左侧模块时由 code-behind 显示。 left module pane; code-behind shows it only when the current tab has left-pane modules.

entries.name: DesktopDefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx-4 desktopdefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment main content pane, the default target for most legacy and business modules. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx aspx 主内容模块容器，是多数旧模块和业务模块的默认落点。 main content pane, the default target for most legacy and business modules.

entries.name: DesktopDefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx-5 desktopdefault.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment right module pane; it preserves the legacy three-pane portal contract while themes decide the actual presentation. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopdefault.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopdefault.aspx aspx 右侧模块容器；保留旧门户三栏布局契约，并由主题决定实际展现。 right module pane; it preserves the legacy three-pane portal contract while themes decide the actual presentation.

entries.name: Announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx-1 announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the announcement-edit entry and themed title; action visibility is decided by the server edit context. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/announcements.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件承载公告编辑入口和主题化标题；动作是否可见由服务器编辑上下文决定。 the shared module-title control hosts the announcement-edit entry and themed title; action visibility is decided by the server edit context.

entries.name: Announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx-2 announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the title control points only to the existing editannouncements page; announcement binding and active-record filtering remain with code-behind and the data service. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/announcements.ascx ascx 标题控件只连接既有 editannouncements 页面；公告数据绑定和有效记录筛选仍由 code-behind 与数据服务负责。 the title control points only to the existing editannouncements page; announcement binding and active-record filtering remain with code-behind and the data service.

entries.name: Announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx-3 announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the announcements list keeps datalist binding while rendering through themed item markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/announcements.ascx ascx 公告列表保留 datalist 数据绑定，输出改为主题化条目结构。 the announcements list keeps datalist binding while rendering through themed item markup.

entries.name: Announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx-4 announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the announcement list disables viewstate and uses encoded binding for title and body; a legacy read-more value is not emitted as a clickable address merely because it exists. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/announcements.ascx ascx 公告列表关闭 viewstate，标题和正文使用编码绑定；旧记录的更多链接不因存在值就自动输出为可点击地址。 the announcement list disables viewstate and uses encoded binding for title and body; a legacy read-more value is not emitted as a clickable address merely because it exists.

entries.name: Announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx-5 announcements.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the read-more link appears only after the server navigation policy passes; invalid addresses stay hidden instead of echoing raw legacy values to the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-announcements.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/announcements.ascx ascx 更多链接只有在服务器导航策略通过时显示；非法地址保持隐藏，不把原始历史值回显给客户端。 the read-more link appears only after the server navigation policy passes; invalid addresses stay hidden instead of echoing raw legacy values to the client.

entries.name: Contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx-1 contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p81.3 空态需要引用共享渲染器。ascx 标记**不进 msbuild**（构建/单测/xml 三道门禁都看不见）， dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/contacts.ascx ascx

entries.name: Contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx-2 contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the contact-edit entry and themed title; action visibility remains a server-side edit-context decision. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/contacts.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件承载联系人编辑入口和主题化标题；动作是否可见仍由服务器编辑上下文决定。 the shared module-title control hosts the contact-edit entry and themed title; action visibility remains a server-side edit-context decision.

entries.name: Contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx-3 contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment contacts still render as a data table, with the shared portal table wrapper providing themed scrolling and borders. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/contacts.ascx ascx 联系人仍按数据表格呈现，外层使用统一门户表格容器承载主题滚动和边框。 contacts still render as a data table, with the shared portal table wrapper providing themed scrolling and borders.

entries.name: Contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx-4 contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the current module data service binds the contact list with viewstate disabled; name, role, and phone fields use encoded binding, and client rows are not trusted as edit or data sources. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-contacts.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/contacts.ascx ascx 联系人列表由当前模块数据服务绑定并关闭 viewstate；姓名、角色和电话等字段使用编码绑定，客户端行不作为编辑或数据来源。 the current module data service binds the contact list with viewstate disabled; name, role, and phone fields use encoded binding, and client rows are not trusted as edit or data sources.

entries.name: Contacts.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
