entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editcontacts.aspx-2 editcontacts.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment name, role, and contact fields form contact-profile input; length, requiredness, normalization, and final persistence remain server-side. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editcontacts.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editcontacts.aspx aspx 姓名、角色和联系方式组成联系人资料输入；长度、必填、规范化和最终持久化仍由服务器处理。 name, role, and contact fields form contact-profile input; length, requiredness, normalization, and final persistence remain server-side.

entries.name: EditContacts.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editcontacts.aspx-3 editcontacts.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment email, contact1, and contact2 carry contact text only; format, privacy handling, and output encoding are not assumed or relaxed by markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editcontacts.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editcontacts.aspx aspx email、contact1 和 contact2 仅承载联系信息文本；格式、隐私处理和输出编码不由标记层假定或放宽。 email, contact1, and contact2 carry contact text only; format, privacy handling, and output encoding are not assumed or relaxed by markup.

entries.name: EditContacts.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editcontacts.aspx-4 editcontacts.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment update, cancel, and delete enter the existing contact persistence flow; the buttons do not bypass authorization, current-record checks, or deletion protection. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editcontacts.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editcontacts.aspx aspx update/cancel/delete 进入既有联系人持久化流程；按钮不绕过权限、当前记录校验或删除保护。 update, cancel, and delete enter the existing contact persistence flow; the buttons do not bypass authorization, current-record checks, or deletion protection.

entries.name: EditDocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx-1 editdocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4.2-d rebuilds the document editor shell while keeping legacy webforms events. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editdocs.aspx aspx p7.4.2-d 文档编辑页改为主题化表单外壳，并保留旧 webforms 事件模型。 p7.4.2-d rebuilds the document editor shell while keeping legacy webforms events.

entries.name: EditDocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx-2 editdocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the browse address is a path and scheme security boundary; markup only collects text, while the server must validate local-relative and http/https targets. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editdocs.aspx aspx 浏览地址是路径/协议安全边界的输入；标记层只收集文本，服务器必须验证站内相对地址和 http/https 目标。 the browse address is a path and scheme security boundary; markup only collects text, while the server must validate local-relative and http/https targets.

entries.name: EditDocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx-3 editdocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the upload area combines the upload option, file input, and server policy hint; filename, size, type, storage location, and overwrite behavior cannot be decided by the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editdocs.aspx aspx 上传区域由 upload 选项、文件输入和服务器策略提示组成；文件名、大小、类型、落盘位置和覆盖行为不能由客户端决定。 the upload area combines the upload option, file input, and server policy hint; filename, size, type, storage location, and overwrite behavior cannot be decided by the client.

entries.name: EditDocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx-4 editdocs.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment update, cancel, and delete enter the existing document state flow; database storage is currently disabled, so a page option cannot be treated as an enabled capability. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editdocs.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editdocs.aspx aspx update/cancel/delete 进入既有文档状态流程；数据库存储选项当前禁用，不能把页面勾选当作已启用能力。 update, cancel, and delete enter the existing document state flow; database storage is currently disabled, so a page option cannot be treated as an enabled capability.

entries.name: EditEvents.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx-1 editevents.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the event edit page uses the shared themed form while preserving existing validation, postback, and delete events. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editevents.aspx aspx 事件编辑页使用统一主题化表单，保留既有校验、回发和删除事件。 the event edit page uses the shared themed form while preserving existing validation, postback, and delete events.

entries.name: EditEvents.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx-2 editevents.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment event title, description, and where/when fields form event content input; required validators provide form feedback while the server still normalizes and authorizes. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editevents.aspx aspx 事件标题、描述和 where/when 字段构成事件内容输入；必填验证只提供表单反馈，服务器仍需规范化和授权。 event title, description, and where/when fields form event content input; required validators provide form feedback while the server still normalizes and authorizes.

entries.name: EditEvents.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx-3 editevents.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment expirefield validators express the page format contract; date interpretation, time zone, expiry policy, and save result remain server-decided. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editevents.aspx aspx expirefield 的日期校验表达当前页面格式契约；日期解释、时区、过期策略和保存结果仍由服务器决定。 expirefield validators express the page format contract; date interpretation, time zone, expiry policy, and save result remain server-decided.

entries.name: EditEvents.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx-4 editevents.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment update, cancel, and delete use the existing event handlers for event persistence; the buttons do not change authorization or bypass deletion protection. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editevents.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editevents.aspx aspx update/cancel/delete 通过既有事件处理器进入事件持久化流程；按钮本身不改变权限或绕过删除保护。 update, cancel, and delete use the existing event handlers for event persistence; the buttons do not change authorization or bypass deletion protection.

entries.name: EditHtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx-1 edithtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4.2-e rebuilds the trusted html settings page with a themed form while keeping the raw-html security boundary in permissions, audit trails, and future governance. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/edithtml.aspx aspx p7.4.2-e 将受信任 html 配置页改为主题化表单；原始 html 的安全边界仍由权限、审计和未来治理机制共同承担。 p7.4.2-e rebuilds the trusted html settings page with a themed form while keeping the raw-html security boundary in permissions, audit trails, and future governance.

entries.name: EditHtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx-2 edithtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the desktop raw-html input is restricted to trusted administrators; validaterequest=false preserves legacy postback compatibility and does not replace permission, audit, or content governance. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/edithtml.aspx aspx 桌面原始 html 输入是受信任管理员边界；validaterequest=false 只满足旧回发兼容，不能替代权限、审计和内容治理。 the desktop raw-html input is restricted to trusted administrators; validaterequest=false preserves legacy postback compatibility and does not replace permission, audit, or content governance.

entries.name: EditHtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx-3 edithtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment allows trusted administrators to enter raw html. ordinary request validation must remain disabled here, otherwise the legacy web forms postback cannot save real html fragments. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/edithtml.aspx aspx 允许受信任管理员输入原始 html；这里必须保持普通请求验证关闭，否则旧 web forms 回发无法保存真实 html 片段。 allows trusted administrators to enter raw html. ordinary request validation must remain disabled here, otherwise the legacy web forms postback cannot save real html fragments.

entries.name: EditHtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx-4 edithtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment mobile summary and detail are legacy-compatibility fields; their optionality and display fallback are decided by the server content model. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/edithtml.aspx aspx 移动端摘要和详情是旧数据兼容字段；它们的可选性和展示回退由服务器内容模型决定。 mobile summary and detail are legacy-compatibility fields; their optionality and display fallback are decided by the server content model.

entries.name: EditHtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx-5 edithtml.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment update and cancel enter the existing save or leave flows; the buttons do not implement html sanitization, authorization, or rollback on the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-edithtml.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/edithtml.aspx aspx update/cancel 分别进入既有保存或离开流程；按钮不在客户端实现 html 清洗、权限判断或回滚。 update and cancel enter the existing save or leave flows; the buttons do not implement html sanitization, authorization, or rollback on the client.

entries.name: EditImage.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx-1 editimage.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4.2-e rebuilds the image settings page with a themed form while keeping the current application-or-http(s) image url boundary. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editimage.aspx aspx p7.4.2-e 将图片配置页改为主题化表单，并保留站内或 http(s) 图片地址边界。 p7.4.2-e rebuilds the image settings page with a themed form while keeping the current application-or-http(s) image url boundary.

entries.name: EditImage.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx-2 editimage.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment src accepts only application-local or http(s) image locations allowed by the compatibility policy; the preview is display feedback and does not replace server-side source validation. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editimage.aspx aspx src 只接受当前兼容策略允许的站内或 http(s) 图片地址；预览面板是展示反馈，不替代服务器来源校验。 src accepts only application-local or http(s) image locations allowed by the compatibility policy; the preview is display feedback and does not replace server-side source validation.

entries.name: EditImage.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx-3 editimage.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment width and height are optional but must be interpreted by the server as non-negative integers; empty values, ranges, and save results are not decided by the client or css. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editimage.aspx aspx 宽高字段可选但必须按服务器约束解释为非负整数；空值、范围和保存结果不由客户端或 css 决定。 width and height are optional but must be interpreted by the server as non-negative integers; empty values, ranges, and save results are not decided by the client or css.

entries.name: EditImage.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx-4 editimage.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment update and cancel enter the existing server flow for image settings; the buttons do not change source trust, dimension validation, or authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editimage.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editimage.aspx aspx update/cancel 进入图片配置的既有服务器流程；按钮不改变来源信任、尺寸校验或权限。 update and cancel enter the existing server flow for image settings; the buttons do not change source trust, dimension validation, or authorization.

entries.name: EditLinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx-1 editlinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the link edit page is aligned with the p7 themed form style while preserving existing validation, postback, and delete events. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editlinks.aspx aspx 链接编辑页统一到 p7 表单视觉，并保留既有校验、回发和删除事件。 the link edit page is aligned with the p7 themed form style while preserving existing validation, postback, and delete events.

entries.name: EditLinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx-2 editlinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment title, url, and mobile url are navigation-target inputs; markup only collects values, while the server must validate scheme, host, local paths, and authorization boundaries. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editlinks.aspx aspx 标题、url 和移动端 url 是导航目标输入；标记层只收集值，协议、主机、站内路径和权限边界必须由服务器验证。 title, url, and mobile url are navigation-target inputs; markup only collects values, while the server must validate scheme, host, local paths, and authorization boundaries.

entries.name: EditLinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx-3 editlinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment description and vieworder preserve the legacy display model; integer validation limits form shape, while order range and persistence conflicts remain server-side. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editlinks.aspx aspx description 和 vieworder 维持旧显示模型；整数验证只限制表单格式，排序范围和持久化冲突仍由服务器处理。 description and vieworder preserve the legacy display model; integer validation limits form shape, while order range and persistence conflicts remain server-side.

entries.name: EditLinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx-4 editlinks.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment update, cancel, and delete enter the existing server flow for the link record; the buttons do not parse urls, change ordering, or bypass delete authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editlinks.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editlinks.aspx aspx update/cancel/delete 进入链接记录的既有服务器流程；按钮不自行解析 url、改变排序或绕过删除权限。 update, cancel, and delete enter the existing server flow for the link record; the buttons do not parse urls, change ordering, or bypass delete authorization.

entries.name: EditXml.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx-1 editxml.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4.2-e rebuilds the xml/xsl settings page with a themed form while deployed resources must still be provided by trusted deployment. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editxml.aspx aspx p7.4.2-e 将 xml/xsl 配置页改为主题化表单；资源仍必须由受信任部署提供。 p7.4.2-e rebuilds the xml/xsl settings page with a themed form while deployed resources must still be provided by trusted deployment.

entries.name: EditXml.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx-2 editxml.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment xml/xsl inputs maintain references only to trusted deployment resources; this page provides no upload, online editing, external url, or arbitrary physical-path capability. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editxml.aspx aspx xml/xsl 输入只维护受信部署目录内的资源引用；本页不提供上传、在线编辑、外部 url 或任意物理路径能力。 xml/xsl inputs maintain references only to trusted deployment resources; this page provides no upload, online editing, external url, or arbitrary physical-path capability.

entries.name: EditXml.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx-3 editxml.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server normalizes xmldatasrc and xsltransformsrc within the application virtual-path boundary; a textbox value is not proof that an external resource is trusted. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editxml.aspx aspx xmldatasrc 与 xsltransformsrc 由服务器规范化并限制在应用虚拟路径边界；文本框值不是外部资源信任证明。 the server normalizes xmldatasrc and xsltransformsrc within the application virtual-path boundary; a textbox value is not proof that an external resource is trusted.

entries.name: EditXml.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx-4 editxml.aspx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment saving normalizes this value to a virtual path inside the current application, avoiding external urls or arbitrary physical paths. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editxml.aspx aspx 保存时会规范化为当前应用内虚拟路径，避免写入外部 url 或任意物理路径。 saving normalizes this value to a virtual path inside the current application, avoiding external urls or arbitrary physical paths.

entries.name: EditXml.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx-5 editxml.aspx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment update and cancel enter the existing xml/xsl settings flow; the buttons do not bypass deployment-path validation, authorization, or error reporting. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-editxml.aspx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/editxml.aspx aspx update/cancel 进入既有 xml/xsl 设置流程；按钮不绕过部署路径验证、权限或错误提示。 update and cancel enter the existing xml/xsl settings flow; the buttons do not bypass deployment-path validation, authorization, or error reporting.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-1 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p6.4 first business module sample: employees only confirm their currently bound low-sensitivity profile data; no upload, script, or external resource capability is provided. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx p6.4 首批业务模块样板：员工只确认自己当前绑定的低敏资料，不提供上传、脚本或外部资源。 p6.4 first business module sample: employees only confirm their currently bound low-sensitivity profile data; no upload, script, or external resource capability is provided.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-2 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment title semantics (added in w87): as in enterprisecapabilityworkbench — the module renders its own title div, so
    role="heading" and aria-level="1" are set explicitly; attributes only, no class change, no visual change. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx 标题语义（w87 补）：同 enterprisecapabilityworkbench —— 模块自带标题 div，显式补
    role="heading" 与 aria-level="1"，只加属性不改 class，视觉零变化。 title semantics (added in w87): as in enterprisecapabilityworkbench — the module renders its own title div, so
    role="heading" and aria-level="1" are set explicitly; attributes only, no class change, no visual change.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-3 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server decides panel visibility from the current identity and active binding; the markup only provides a host and does not grant confirmation permission. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx 资料面板的可见性由服务器根据当前身份和在职绑定决定；标记层只提供承载区域，不授予确认权限。 the server decides panel visibility from the current identity and active binding; the markup only provides a host and does not grant confirmation permission.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-4 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment profile fields use a block grid so business modules do not continue the old table-based layout. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx 资料字段使用块级网格，避免业务模块继续保留旧表格布局。 profile fields use a block grid so business modules do not continue the old table-based layout.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-5 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment field values bind from the current user's server-side profile view and follow display encoding rules; the page does not accept a client employee identifier to choose the confirmation target. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx 字段值由当前用户的服务器端资料视图绑定并按展示规则编码；页面不接收客户端员工标识来决定要确认的对象。 field values bind from the current user's server-side profile view and follow display encoding rules; the page does not accept a client employee identifier to choose the confirmation target.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-6 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment since p74.2 the employment-status field uses this module's own key employeeprofileconfirm_labelemploymentstatus; it previously borrowed the correction module's list-column title, which is a **semantic borrow** (a list column title standing in for employment status) that made either side's wording change break the other. the value stays "状态", so this is pure key-ownership cleanup; renaming it to a clearer "在职状态" is a visible wording change and is registered as a separate candidate. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx p74.2 起"在职状态"改用本模块自有键 employeeprofileconfirm_labelemploymentstatus：此前借用资料更正模块的"状态列"标题，属**语义借用**（用列表列标题表达在职状态），任一方改文案都会误伤对方。文案值保持"状态"不变，属纯键归属整理；把文案改为更明确的"在职状态"属可见文案变化，另作候选登记。 since p74.2 the employment-status field uses this module's own key employeeprofileconfirm_labelemploymentstatus; it previously borrowed the correction module's list-column title, which is a **semantic borrow** (a list column title standing in for employment status) that made either side's wording change break the other. the value stays "状态", so this is pure key-ownership cleanup; renaming it to a clearer "在职状态" is a visible wording change and is registered as a separate candidate.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx-7 employeeprofileconfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment the confirm button only triggers confirmbutton_click; the server handles permission, target binding, and idempotent outcome, so the button itself does not mean the profile was written. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofileconfirm-employeeprofileconfirm.ascx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofileconfirm/employeeprofileconfirm.ascx ascx 确认按钮只触发 confirmbutton_click；是否允许确认、目标绑定和幂等结果由服务器处理，按钮本身不代表资料已写入。 the confirm button only triggers confirmbutton_click; the server handles permission, target binding, and idempotent outcome, so the button itself does not mean the profile was written.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-1 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the p74.3 empty-state renderer lives in the aspnet.starterkit.portal namespace while web.config imports only resources globally: markup that references that type must import this namespace explicitly, otherwise the **runtime compilation** of the ascx reports cs0103 (an msbuild build does not validate ascx files). dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx p74.3 空态渲染器位于 aspnet.starterkit.portal 命名空间，而 web.config 只全局导入 resources：标记层若引用该类型必须显式导入本命名空间，否则**运行期编译**报 cs0103（msbuild 构建不会校验 ascx）。 the p74.3 empty-state renderer lives in the aspnet.starterkit.portal namespace while web.config imports only resources globally: markup that references that type must import this namespace explicitly, otherwise the **runtime compilation** of the ascx reports cs0103 (an msbuild build does not validate ascx files).

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-2 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment p6.4.3 business module sample: employees submit low-sensitivity field-level correction requests; no attachment, script, or external resource capability is provided. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx p6.4.3 业务模块样板：员工提交低敏字段级更正请求，不提供附件、脚本或外部资源。 p6.4.3 business module sample: employees submit low-sensitivity field-level correction requests; no attachment, script, or external resource capability is provided.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-3 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment title semantics (added in w87): as in enterprisecapabilityworkbench — the module renders its own title div, so
    role="heading" and aria-level="1" are set explicitly; attributes only, no class change, no visual change. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx 标题语义（w87 补）：同 enterprisecapabilityworkbench —— 模块自带标题 div，显式补
    role="heading" 与 aria-level="1"，只加属性不改 class，视觉零变化。 title semantics (added in w87): as in enterprisecapabilityworkbench — the module renders its own title div, so
    role="heading" and aria-level="1" are set explicitly; attributes only, no class change, no visual change.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-4 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the current profile snapshot renders in a field grid; the submission area keeps the original control ids and events to preserve code-behind binding and postback compatibility. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx 当前资料快照用字段网格展示；提交区仍保留原控件 id 和事件，以维持 code-behind 绑定和回发兼容。 the current profile snapshot renders in a field grid; the submission area keeps the original control ids and events to preserve code-behind binding and postback compatibility.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-5 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the correction form carries only a server-generated field allowlist and bounded low-sensitivity text; maxlength improves interaction, while normalization, authorization, and sensitive-field boundaries remain owned by code-behind and the data service. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx 更正表单只承载服务器生成的字段白名单和有界低敏文本；maxlength 约束改善交互，但规范化、授权与敏感字段边界仍由 code-behind 和数据服务负责。 the correction form carries only a server-generated field allowlist and bounded low-sensitivity text; maxlength improves interaction, while normalization, authorization, and sensitive-field boundaries remain owned by code-behind and the data service.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-6 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the submit button only enters the submitbutton_click postback flow; it does not modify employee master data directly, because the server rechecks identity, employee binding, field allowlist, and write result. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx 提交按钮只进入 submitbutton_click 回发流程；它不直接修改员工主数据，当前身份、员工绑定、字段白名单和写入结果均由服务器重新确认。 the submit button only enters the submitbutton_click postback flow; it does not modify employee master data directly, because the server rechecks identity, employee binding, field allowlist, and write result.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-7 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 7 dotnet-markup-comment the recent-request list shows a bounded server-returned snapshot with encoded fields; it is a status hint, not proof that employee master data changed or review completed. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:7 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx 最近请求列表只展示服务器返回的有限快照，字段使用编码绑定；列表是状态提示，不等同于员工主数据已修改或审核已完成。 the recent-request list shows a bounded server-returned snapshot with encoded fields; it is a status hint, not proof that employee master data changed or review completed.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx-8 employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 8 dotnet-markup-comment p74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row, centered and muted. it lives in the footertemplate because a repeater still renders header and footer with zero rows, and the renderer returns an empty string when rows exist so no branch is needed. the column count (5) matches this table's header. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest-employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx:8 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest/employeeprofilecorrectionrequest.ascx ascx p74.3 空态：零条时在表尾渲染"表头 + 提示行"，整行居中且弱化。放在 footertemplate 内，因为 repeater 在零条时仍渲染表头与表尾；有数据时渲染器返回空串，无需分支。列数（5）与本表表头一致。 p74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row, centered and muted. it lives in the footertemplate because a repeater still renders header and footer with zero rows, and the renderer returns an empty string when rows exist so no branch is needed. the column count (5) matches this table's header.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx-1 events.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the event-edit entry and themed title; action visibility is decided by the server edit context. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/events.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件承载事件编辑入口和主题化标题；动作是否可见由服务器编辑上下文决定。 the shared module-title control hosts the event-edit entry and themed title; action visibility is decided by the server edit context.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx-2 events.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the title control points only to the existing editevents page; list binding, expiry filtering, and permission decisions remain with code-behind and the data service. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/events.ascx ascx 标题控件只连接既有 editevents 页面；列表绑定、过期筛选和权限判断仍由 code-behind 与数据服务负责。 the title control points only to the existing editevents page; list binding, expiry filtering, and permission decisions remain with code-behind and the data service.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx-3 events.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment datalist binding and edit navigation are preserved while only the themed event-item markup is rebuilt. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/events.ascx ascx 保留 datalist 绑定和编辑入口，只重构每条事件的主题化展示结构。 datalist binding and edit navigation are preserved while only the themed event-item markup is rebuilt.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx-4 events.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the event list disables viewstate and renders events returned for the current module; title, time/place, and summary use encoded binding so content is not emitted as markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/events.ascx ascx 事件列表关闭 viewstate 并展示数据服务返回的当前模块事件；标题、时间地点和摘要使用编码绑定，避免把正文当作标记输出。 the event list disables viewstate and renders events returned for the current module; title, time/place, and summary use encoded binding so content is not emitted as markup.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx-5 events.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment each edit link is visible only when iseditable is true and keeps the current itemid; button visibility does not grant client-side write authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-events.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/events.ascx ascx 每条编辑链接仅在 iseditable 为真时可见，并沿用当前 itemid；按钮可见不代表客户端获得写入授权。 each edit link is visible only when iseditable is true and keeps the current itemid; button visibility does not grant client-side write authorization.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx-1 htmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the edit entry and themed title; whether the action is rendered remains a server-side permission decision. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/htmlmodule.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件负责承载编辑入口和主题化标题；其是否输出动作仍由服务器权限上下文决定。 the shared module-title control hosts the edit entry and themed title; whether the action is rendered remains a server-side permission decision.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx-2 htmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the edit address points only to the existing html editor; the markup does not route general-user input or external resources into the trusted-html rendering path. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/htmlmodule.ascx ascx 编辑地址只连接到既有 html 编辑页，标记层不把普通用户输入或外部资源接入受信任 html 渲染路径。 the edit address points only to the existing html editor; the markup does not route general-user input or external resources into the trusted-html rendering path.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx-3 htmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment raw html is still injected by code-behind under the trusted-admin boundary; this markup only supplies the themed display container. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/htmlmodule.ascx ascx 原始 html 仍由 code-behind 按受信任管理员边界注入，这里只提供主题化展示容器。 raw html is still injected by code-behind under the trusted-admin boundary; this markup only supplies the themed display container.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx-4 htmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment htmlholder is only the server container for trusted code-behind content; without a valid record it stays empty and does not disclose raw configuration values to the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-htmlmodule.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/htmlmodule.ascx ascx htmlholder 只是 code-behind 注入受信任内容的服务器容器；没有有效记录时保持空容器，不向客户端泄露原始配置值。 htmlholder is only the server container for trusted code-behind content; without a valid record it stays empty and does not disclose raw configuration values to the client.

entries.name: ImageModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-imagemodule.ascx-1 imagemodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the image-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-imagemodule.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/imagemodule.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件承载受服务器权限控制的图片编辑入口；标记层不自行授予编辑能力。 the shared module-title control hosts the image-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself.

entries.name: ImageModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-imagemodule.ascx-2 imagemodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the media container hosts only image output normalized by the navigation policy; code-behind hides invalid addresses instead of echoing raw settings. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-imagemodule.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/imagemodule.ascx ascx 媒体容器只承载经过导航策略归一化的图片输出；非法地址由 code-behind 隐藏图片，不回显原始设置。 the media container hosts only image output normalized by the navigation policy; code-behind hides invalid addresses instead of echoing raw settings.

entries.name: ImageModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-imagemodule.ascx-3 imagemodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server writes the image url and optional dimensions from module settings; the markup does not process uploads, external-link allow lists, or binary resources. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-imagemodule.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/imagemodule.ascx ascx 图片地址和可选尺寸均由服务器从模块设置写入控件；标记层不处理上传、外链白名单或二进制资源。 the server writes the image url and optional dimensions from module settings; the markup does not process uploads, external-link allow lists, or binary resources.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx-1 links.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the link-edit entry and themed title; action visibility remains a server-side permission decision. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/links.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件承载链接编辑入口和主题化标题；动作是否可见仍由服务器权限上下文决定。 the shared module-title control hosts the link-edit entry and themed title; action visibility remains a server-side permission decision.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx-2 links.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the title control uses the in-site editlinks page to repair legacy links; the markup does not contain save or authorization logic. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/links.ascx ascx 标题控件使用站内 editlinks 页面作为修复旧链接的入口，标记层不直接承载保存或授权逻辑。 the title control uses the in-site editlinks page to repair legacy links; the markup does not contain save or authorization logic.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx-3 links.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment standard links render as a themed link group; editing still routes through the existing editlinks page. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/links.ascx ascx 普通链接以主题化链接组呈现；编辑入口仍走既有 editlinks 页面。 standard links render as a themed link group; editing still routes through the existing editlinks page.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx-4 links.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the current module data service binds the link list; titles and descriptions follow display-output rules, and client items are not trusted as edit targets or url sources. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/links.ascx ascx 链接列表由当前模块数据服务绑定；标题和说明按展示输出规则处理，客户端项不作为编辑目标或 url 信任来源。 the current module data service binds the link list; titles and descriptions follow display-output rules, and client items are not trusted as edit targets or url sources.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx-5 links.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the edit address uses an in-site itemid path only in the iseditable context; browse urls must pass navigation policy, with invalid legacy values falling back to encoded text. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-links.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/links.ascx ascx 编辑地址只在 iseditable 上下文使用站内 itemid 路径；浏览地址必须通过导航策略，非法旧值回退为编码文本。 the edit address uses an in-site itemid path only in the iseditable context; browse urls must pass navigation policy, with invalid legacy values falling back to encoded text.

entries.name: ModuleProbe.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-moduleprobe-moduleprobe.ascx-1 moduleprobe.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment p3.2 is a read-only deployment-package verification sample; it writes no business data and exposes no script, upload, or external-link entry. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-moduleprobe-moduleprobe.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/moduleprobe/moduleprobe.ascx ascx p3.2 只读模块包验证样例：不写入业务数据，不提供脚本、上传或外链入口。 p3.2 is a read-only deployment-package verification sample; it writes no business data and exposes no script, upload, or external-link entry.

entries.name: ModuleProbe.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-moduleprobe-moduleprobe.ascx-2 moduleprobe.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the table only presents server-provided package, module, placement, theme-scope, and render-time diagnostics; these values are not client-editable configuration. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-moduleprobe-moduleprobe.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/moduleprobe/moduleprobe.ascx ascx 表格字段只呈现服务器提供的包、模块、放置、主题范围和渲染时间诊断值，不把它们当作客户端可修改配置。 the table only presents server-provided package, module, placement, theme-scope, and render-time diagnostics; these values are not client-editable configuration.

entries.name: ModuleProbe.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-moduleprobe-moduleprobe.ascx-3 moduleprobe.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment all labels are encoded read-only results; the probe page provides no callback, persistence, or navigation side effect. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-moduleprobe-moduleprobe.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/moduleprobe/moduleprobe.ascx ascx 所有 label 均为编码后的只读结果，探针页面不提供回调、保存或导航副作用。 all labels are encoded read-only results; the probe page provides no callback, persistence, or navigation side effect.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx-1 quicklinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the quick-links module renders as a compact link group while preserving the add entry and existing data binding. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/quicklinks.ascx ascx 快捷链接模块以紧凑链接组呈现，保留新增入口和原有数据绑定。 the quick-links module renders as a compact link group while preserving the add entry and existing data binding.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx-2 quicklinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment p8.3 connects the quick-links local header to the shared module title/action contract without duplicating the outer module title. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/quicklinks.ascx ascx p8.3 让快捷链接自有头部接入统一模块标题/动作区契约，避免与外层模块标题重复。 p8.3 connects the quick-links local header to the shared module title/action contract without duplicating the outer module title.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx-3 quicklinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server decides action-area visibility from roles and module-edit context; hiding or showing a button does not replace backend authorization. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/quicklinks.ascx ascx 动作区是否可见由服务器角色和模块编辑上下文决定；隐藏或显示按钮都不替代后端授权检查。 the server decides action-area visibility from roles and module-edit context; hiding or showing a button does not replace backend authorization.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx-4 quicklinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the current module's data service binds the link list with viewstate disabled; titles use encoded binding, and addresses must pass the server navigation policy before becoming browse links. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/quicklinks.ascx ascx 链接列表由当前模块的数据服务绑定且关闭 viewstate；标题使用编码绑定，地址必须经过服务器导航策略后才能进入浏览链接。 the current module's data service binds the link list with viewstate disabled; titles use encoded binding, and addresses must pass the server navigation policy before becoming browse links.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx-5 quicklinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the edit link gets an edit address only when the current module is editable; invalid or disallowed legacy addresses fall back to encoded text without external-navigation side effects. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-quicklinks.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/quicklinks.ascx ascx 编辑链接仅在当前模块可编辑时生成编辑地址；无效或不允许的旧地址回退为编码文本，不产生外部导航副作用。 the edit link gets an edit address only when the current module is editable; invalid or disallowed legacy addresses fall back to encoded text without external-navigation side effects.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx-1 signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the sign-in control collects the login identifier, password, and remember-me option, then lets the code-behind forms-authentication flow validate credentials, issue tickets, or display failure messages. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/signin.ascx ascx 登录控件负责采集登录标识、口令和记住登录选项，并通过 code-behind 的表单认证流程完成校验、票据写入和失败提示。 the sign-in control collects the login identifier, password, and remember-me option, then lets the code-behind forms-authentication flow validate credentials, issue tickets, or display failure messages.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx-2 signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment p7.4 uses a real form layout and button for sign-in instead of legacy image buttons. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/signin.ascx ascx p7.4 登录区改为真实表单布局和 button，不再使用旧图片按钮。 p7.4 uses a real form layout and button for sign-in instead of legacy image buttons.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx-3 signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server control receives the login identifier and passes it to the existing authentication flow; the page does not decide account existence or authorization on the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/signin.ascx ascx 登录标识由服务器控件接收并进入既有认证流程；页面不在客户端判断账号是否存在或具备权限。 the server control receives the login identifier and passes it to the existing authentication flow; the page does not decide account existence or authorization on the client.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx-4 signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the password input and hidden ciphertext field support pre-submit protection; the hidden field is still client-posted data, so final validation, failure handling, and ticket issuance must remain server-side. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/signin.ascx ascx 密码输入和隐藏密文字段共同服务于提交前保护；隐藏字段仍是客户端回传值，最终校验、失败处理和票据签发必须由服务器完成。 the password input and hidden ciphertext field support pre-submit protection; the hidden field is still client-posted data, so final validation, failure handling, and ticket issuance must remain server-side.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx-5 signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment this line states an existing fact only (the help module already says a forgotten password must be reset by a platform
    administrator); it carries no request parameter or dynamic content. the wording comes from a resource key with a chinese
    and an english version, so it follows the interface language.
    note: a resource expression is only allowed inside a **server control attribute** — in a text position asp.net raises
    httpparseexception — so an asp:literal carries it here rather than writing <%$ %> into the markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/signin.ascx ascx 这一行只陈述既有事实（帮助模块已写明"忘记密码请联系平台管理员重置"），不含任何请求参数或动态内容；
    文案由资源键提供，中英各一份，界面语言切换时随之切换。
    注意：资源表达式只能出现在**服务器控件属性**里（文本节点位置会被 asp.net 判为 httpparseexception），
    故这里用 asp:literal 承载，而不是把 <%$ %> 直接写在文本里。 this line states an existing fact only (the help module already says a forgotten password must be reset by a platform
    administrator); it carries no request parameter or dynamic content. the wording comes from a resource key with a chinese
    and an english version, so it follows the interface language.
    note: a resource expression is only allowed inside a **server control attribute** — in a text position asp.net raises
    httpparseexception — so an asp:literal carries it here rather than writing <%$ %> into the markup.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx-6 signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment the sign-in button enters loginbtn_click, while the registration link is shown only when the code-behind explicitly enables it; authentication results and redirects cannot be forged by the markup. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-signin.ascx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/signin.ascx ascx 登录按钮进入 loginbtn_click，注册链接仅在 code-behind 明确开放时显示；认证结果和跳转不能由标记层伪造。 the sign-in button enters loginbtn_click, while the registration link is shown only when the code-behind explicitly enables it; authentication results and redirects cannot be forged by the markup.

entries.name: ViewDocument.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-viewdocument.aspx-1 viewdocument.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the document-view endpoint disables themes and master-page wrapping to preserve the legacy web forms behavior where the code-behind writes the download response directly. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-viewdocument.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/viewdocument.aspx aspx 文档查看入口禁用主题和母版包装，保留 code-behind 直接写出下载响应的旧 web forms 行为。 the document-view endpoint disables themes and master-page wrapping to preserve the legacy web forms behavior where the code-behind writes the download response directly.

entries.name: ViewDocument.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-viewdocument.aspx-2 viewdocument.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment this markup layer contains no server controls or business display region; document identity, authorization, path resolution, and response headers are handled at the code-behind boundary. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-viewdocument.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/viewdocument.aspx aspx 此标记层不包含服务器控件或业务展示区域；文件标识、权限、路径解析和响应头均由 code-behind 边界处理。 this markup layer contains no server controls or business display region; document identity, authorization, path resolution, and response headers are handled at the code-behind boundary.

entries.name: XmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-xmlmodule.ascx-1 xmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the shared module-title control hosts the xml-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-xmlmodule.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/xmlmodule.ascx ascx 共享模块标题控件承载受服务器权限控制的 xml 编辑入口；标记层不自行授予编辑能力。 the shared module-title control hosts the xml-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself.

entries.name: XmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-xmlmodule.ascx-2 xmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the xml container provides an output area only for in-application resources that pass trusted-deployment path checks; invalid configuration receives a neutral server-side notice. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-xmlmodule.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/xmlmodule.ascx ascx xml 容器只为已通过受信任部署路径校验的站内资源提供输出区域；无效配置由服务器给出中性提示。 the xml container provides an output area only for in-application resources that pass trusted-deployment path checks; invalid configuration receives a neutral server-side notice.

entries.name: XmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmodules-xmlmodule.ascx-3 xmlmodule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment code-behind sets documentsource and transformsource only after path and file-existence checks; the markup accepts neither client paths nor remote resources. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmodules-xmlmodule.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmodules/xmlmodule.ascx ascx documentsource 和 transformsource 由 code-behind 在路径和文件存在性验证后设置；标记层不接受客户端路径或远程资源。 code-behind sets documentsource and transformsource only after path and file-existence checks; the markup accepts neither client paths nor remote resources.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx-1 desktopmoduletitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the module-title control displays each portal module title and, when an edit page is configured and the current user has edit permission, shows the module action entry. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmoduletitle.ascx ascx 模块标题控件负责显示门户模块标题，并在配置了编辑页且当前用户具备编辑权限时显示模块动作入口。 the module-title control displays each portal module title and, when an edit page is configured and the current user has edit permission, shows the module action entry.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx-2 desktopmoduletitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment p8.3 splits module headers into title and action areas so modules can gradually share one semantic contract. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmoduletitle.ascx ascx p8.3 将模块标题正式拆为标题区和动作区，其他模块可逐步复用同一套语义契约。 p8.3 splits module headers into title and action areas so modules can gradually share one semantic contract.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx-3 desktopmoduletitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server control supplies the module title with its own viewstate disabled; the page only presents the current module context. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmoduletitle.ascx ascx 模块标题由服务器控件提供并关闭自身 viewstate，页面只呈现当前模块上下文。 the server control supplies the module title with its own viewstate disabled; the page only presents the current module context.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx-4 desktopmoduletitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the server decides action-area visibility from edit-page configuration and current permission; client styling or markup cannot override it. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx:4 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmoduletitle.ascx ascx 动作区是否可见由服务器根据编辑页配置和当前权限决定，不能由客户端样式或标记覆盖。 the server decides action-area visibility from edit-page configuration and current permission; client styling or markup cannot override it.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx-5 desktopmoduletitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 5 dotnet-markup-comment the edit link keeps the server-generated target and permission decision; without a valid edit page it must not be treated as usable navigation. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopmoduletitle.ascx:5 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopmoduletitle.ascx ascx 编辑链接沿用服务器生成的目标和权限判断；没有有效编辑页时不应把它当作可用导航。 the edit link keeps the server-generated target and permission decision; without a valid edit page it must not be treated as usable navigation.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx-1 desktopportalbanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment desktopportalbanner is the shared header control for desktop portal pages; the site name, user bar, and tab list all come from server-side portal configuration and identity context, while markup only renders the legacy web forms template. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopportalbanner.ascx ascx desktopportalbanner 是每个桌面门户页面共享的页眉控件；站点名称、用户栏和 tab 列表均来自服务器端门户配置与身份上下文，标记层只负责按旧 web forms 模板输出。 desktopportalbanner is the shared header control for desktop portal pages; the site name, user bar, and tab list all come from server-side portal configuration and identity context, while markup only renders the legacy web forms template.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx-2 desktopportalbanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment the brand mark is a static asset shipped with the code (src/portal/images/portal-logo.png); it comes from no
    database and accepts no request parameter. its alternative text names the project, while the brand text follows
    immediately, so the image carries no additional meaning. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopportalbanner.ascx ascx 品牌标识为随代码发布的静态资源（src/portal/images/portal-logo.png），不经数据库、不接受请求参数。
    替代文本给出项目标识；品牌文字紧随其后，故该图不承担额外语义。 the brand mark is a static asset shipped with the code (src/portal/images/portal-logo.png); it comes from no
    database and accepts no request parameter. its alternative text names the project, while the brand text follows
    immediately, so the image carries no additional meaning.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx-3 desktopportalbanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the server context generates the welcome text, logoff link, and portal entries in the user bar; the page does not infer identity or session state on its own. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopportalbanner.ascx ascx 用户栏中的欢迎文本、注销链接和门户入口由服务器上下文生成；页面不自行推断当前身份或会话状态。 the server context generates the welcome text, logoff link, and portal entries in the user bar; the page does not infer identity or session state on its own.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx-4 desktopportalbanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 4 dotnet-markup-comment the former "documentation" button pointed at `/admin/notimplemented.aspx` — a not-implemented placeholder —
  a dead link inside the public chrome, now removed. a documentation entry should be re-added only once the

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.searchText:
hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx-6 desktopportalbanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 6 dotnet-markup-comment a regular tab item renders the server-bound name and url; the template presents navigation and does not treat bound values as client-side authorization decisions. the url is now produced by a code-behind method because a <%= %> code block is not allowed inside a server-control attribute in web forms. each item also emits a hidden disabled element that the tab gate can reveal for administrators together with the blocked reason; because it defaults to hidden it emits no html at all while the gate is off.
    the name likewise goes through a code-behind method (`buildtabdisplayname`): tab names now support chinese / english / other-languages columns, so binding the chinese column directly would produce reverse mixing in english uis. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-desktopportalbanner.ascx:6 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/desktopportalbanner.ascx ascx 普通 tab 项输出服务器绑定的名称与 url；模板只呈现导航，不把绑定值当作客户端权限判断。url 改由 code-behind 方法生成，避免在服务器控件属性中使用 <%= %> 代码块（web forms 不允许）。每项同时输出一个默认隐藏的禁用态元素，供 tab 门控在管理员可见时替换显示并携带阻断原因；默认隐藏使其在门控关闭时完全不输出 html。
    名称同样走 code-behind 方法（`buildtabdisplayname`）：页签名已支持中/英/其它语言三列，直接绑定中文列会让英文界面出现反向混排。 a regular tab item renders the server-bound name and url; the template presents navigation and does not treat bound values as client-side authorization decisions. the url is now produced by a code-behind method because a <%= %> code block is not allowed inside a server-control attribute in web forms. each item also emits a hidden disabled element that the tab gate can reveal for administrators together with the blocked reason; because it defaults to hidden it emits no html at all while the gate is off.
    the name likewise goes through a code-behind method (`buildtabdisplayname`): tab names now support chinese / english / other-languages columns, so binding the chinese column directly would produce reverse mixing in english uis.

entries.name: GenericErrorPage.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-genericerrorpage.aspx-1 genericerrorpage.aspx webforms-server-comment 1 dotnet-markup-comment the generic error page is the exception-convergence endpoint; it only displays a low-sensitivity event identifier so stack traces, paths, or request details are not sent to the client. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-genericerrorpage.aspx:1 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/genericerrorpage.aspx aspx 通用错误页是异常收敛出口；页面只显示低敏事件编号，避免把堆栈、路径或请求细节输出给客户端。 the generic error page is the exception-convergence endpoint; it only displays a low-sensitivity event identifier so stack traces, paths, or request details are not sent to the client.

entries.name: GenericErrorPage.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-genericerrorpage.aspx-2 genericerrorpage.aspx webforms-server-comment 2 dotnet-markup-comment this page does not use the master page, ensuring the error path can still render a minimal html response when theme, navigation, or module initialization fails. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-genericerrorpage.aspx:2 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/genericerrorpage.aspx aspx 此页不使用母版页，确保错误路径在主题、导航或模块初始化失败时仍能渲染一份最小 html 响应。 this page does not use the master page, ensuring the error path can still render a minimal html response when theme, navigation, or module initialization fails.

entries.name: GenericErrorPage.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.searchText: hia-document:dotnetdoc-markup-comment-src-portal-genericerrorpage.aspx-3 genericerrorpage.aspx webforms-server-comment 3 dotnet-markup-comment the panel text is now resource-driven: it previously used entity-encoded hard-coded chinese, which made the error page display chinese even in the english ui and conflicted with the localization goal. entity encoding is no longer needed because the copy now lives in a utf-8 resource file with an encoding declaration. the event id still comes from a server-side expression, and visual styling stays minimal and inline to avoid depending on external theme assets. dotnetdoc:markup-comment:src-portal-genericerrorpage.aspx:3 dotnet hia-document markup/portal.hia.json src/portal/genericerrorpage.aspx aspx 面板文本改为资源驱动：原先使用实体编码的硬编码中文，导致英文界面下错误页仍显示中文（与本地化目标冲突）。实体编码不再必要，因为文案已移入 utf-8 且带编码声明的资源文件。事件编号仍由服务端表达式输出；视觉样式保持内联最小化，避免依赖外部主题资产。 the panel text is now resource-driven: it previously used entity-encoded hard-coded chinese, which made the error page display chinese even in the english ui and conflicted with the localization goal. entity encoding is no longer needed because the copy now lives in a utf-8 resource file with an encoding declaration. the event id still comes from a server-side expression, and visual styling stays minimal and inline to avoid depending on external theme assets.
